title: Fleet Planner
description:
Job Summary
The Fleet Planner is responsible for planning and coordinating freight movement to meet customer
commitments while maximizing the efficient utilization of company assets and driver capacity. This
position also manages local drivers to assist planning productivity. This position proactively plans freight
assignments, balances operational priorities, and works to keep company equipment within designated
freight lanes whenever practical. The Fleet Planner ensures loads are assigned in a safe, efficient,
compliant, and cost-effective manner while considering customer requirements, operational objectives,
and driver needs. Success in this role requires strong decision-making, attention to detail, collaboration
across departments, and the ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced transportation environment.
Essential Job Functions
• Plan and assign freight to maximize equipment utilization while meeting customer service
expectations.
• Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of assigned customers, freight lanes, shippers,
consignees, and operational requirements to effectively pre-plan freight.
• Manage local driver fleet to increase productivity and driver utilization.
• Work with fright brokers to secured loads when needed to move company equipment.
• Coordinate with Account Managers, Driver Managers, and Operations to ensure freight is planned
efficiently and customer commitments are met.
• Evaluate routing decisions, including deadhead mileage, and escalate exceptions when
appropriate.
• Ensure all load assignments comply with applicable federal, state, local, and company
regulations, including Hours of Service requirements.
• Review load rates, fuel surcharges, and accessorial charges for accuracy and alignment with
company pricing guidelines.
• Plan high-security freight to minimize theft exposure while maintaining operational efficiency.
• Monitor driver Hours of Service and operational availability to assign freight safely and
compliantly.
• Coordinate load rescheduling, relays, and load transfers to improve service, maximize driver
productivity, and meet operational needs.
• Ensure freight opportunities are distributed fairly and consistently across company drivers.
• Communicate complete and accurate load information to drivers, Driver Managers, Account
Managers, and other stakeholders.
• Support customers and drivers by providing routing information, directions, and operational
assistance as needed.
• Collaborate with other Fleet Planners and Operations personnel to provide workload coverage
and maintain continuity across fleets
• Participate in weekend coverage rotations and adjust work schedules as needed to support
customer and operational requirements.
• Assist in afterhours questions/issues regarding fleets assigned.
• Complete required regulatory and company training, including Hours of Service and hazardous
materials training, as applicable.

Summary of Job Duties:

This position is responsible for working assigned work queues while following related policies and procedures. Under general supervision, The Associate Clinical Billing Specialist will complete responsibilities in Cash Posting, Cash Control, Credit, and Data Entry/Scanning. The Associate Clinical Billing Specialist is responsible for timely and accurate posting of payments and adjustments to all patient accounts from multiple sources; will interpret the explanation of benefits (EOB) and balance transfer money to the secondary insurance or patient liability; scan and index all supporting documentation for manually posted payments; perform in depth research on payments and/or adjustments resulting in a credit balance or undistributed funds. This position is accountable for daily balancing and tracking of cash and adjustment posting, and will balance summary activity in the patient accounting system, reconcile unapplied cash accounts, and post denial information; research missing payments with payers or clearinghouse to ensure all monies are claimed and posted; review credits on insurance and patient accounts to determine whether refunds are required. The Associate Clinical Billing specialist must be detail oriented and possess basic mathematical skills, above average communication skills, and exceptional attention to detail.

*****This position works on-site*******


Qualifications:

  • High School diploma/GED plus 2 (two) years of experience in a healthcare revenue cycle-related function or an equivalent combination or education and experience OR
  • Bachelor's Degree OR High School diploma plus (4) four years equivalent combination of education and experience in a healthcare revenue cycle related function.


Additional Information:

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Identify credit balance accounts through system reports and online work lists/work queues
  • Receive request for refunds; research accounts for potential refund and adjust contractual allowances as needed.
  • Collects documentation and complete analysis to determine whether a refund is appropriate; process refunds timely.
  • Research patient’s account history and apply patient overpayment to any outstanding patient balances(s).
  • Attach supporting documentation upon receipt of processed refunds, prepare for distribution, and balance to the patient accounting system and the accounts payable system.
  • Review and resolve undistributed payments.
  • Follow up on unpaid claims; verify patient demographics, insurance information/eligibility, non-coding charge information, and update accounts.
  • Maintain working knowledge of payer groups and most current billing practices and regulations.
  • Run eligibility on patients, verify insurance and request outside records.
  • Post payments and adjustments to accounts in the patient accounting system.
  • Interpret EOBs and transfer remaining patient and secondary insurance liability to appropriate accounts.
  • Translate payor denial codes to UAMS standard denial codes and enter on patient account.
  • Balance all payments and transactions on a daily basis; research unidentified cash and post.
  • Report overpayments or refunds when identified during the payment posting process.
  • Resolve undistributed payments; research payments, transfers funds and posts adjustments.
  • Distribute payments within the patient accounting system and research payments received.
  • Investigate recoupments, interest payments and miscellaneous payments.
  • Claim payments, complete Records of Deposit, and split funds to balance with other departments, reconciling bank reports, EFTs, insurance checks, personal payments, and Point of Service payments.
  • Prepare batches for manual payment posting and ensure all money is accounted for and allocated.
  • Research payments and interact with insurance carriers and other agencies.
  • Work effectively in a team environment, coordinating workflow and supporting a productive and efficient environment.
  • Demonstrate integrity and critical thinking skills and actively contribute to the success of the organization.
  • Attends insurance carrier –provided training as needed.
  • Performs other duties and responsibilities as needed.

title: IT Executive
description:

You are expected to independently manage scoped operational workstreams, identify recurring user pain points, and lead service improvements through data, documentation, automation, and close collaboration with internal teams and managed service partners.

You will report to Manager II, Country IT (MY) and Manager II, Country IT (MY) will base it onsite in our Petaling Jaya office.

  • Partner with managed service vendors to review escalations, track service performance, and ensure timely preventive and corrective actions are carried out.

  • Work with other GTS teams and business stakeholders to resolve cross-functional issues and represent end-user operational needs in service or product discussions.

  • Lead small to medium operational improvement plans, including asset lifecycle accuracy, onboarding and offboarding readiness, endpoint compliance, self-service enablement, and process standardisation.

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • Demonstrated ability to independently own and deliver scoped operational workstreams, tasks, or projects with minimal supervision.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate operational data and user feedback into practical improvements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across vendors, technical teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Experience with IT service management, asset management, endpoint or workplace tooling, or cloud productivity environments.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining service quality, accuracy, and follow-through.
  • Exhibit digital and AI proficiency by leveraging automation, data analytics, or AI-driven resources to enhance output quality and operational speed, all while maintaining strict standards for security, data privacy, and precision.

Good to have:

  • Good knowledge of cloud applications and modern workplace technologies such as Google Workspace, Jamf and Omnissa Workspace ONE.
  • Experience in handling IT operational improvement projects or regional coordination work.
  • Experience creating clear SOPs, user guides, process documentation, or self-service support content.
  • Exposure to workflow automation, scripting, dashboarding, or AI-assisted support practices would be an addition.

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Inventory Planning Specialist
description:
This role serves as a key member of the Inventory Planning team, responsible for maintaining inventory availability across Stratas' distribution network through proactive inventory analysis, deployment planning, and cross-functional coordination. The Inventory Planning Specialist independently identifies inventory risks, develops recommendations, and partners with manufacturing, transportation, customer service, and sales to optimize inventory performance while minimizing customer service disruptions.

This role combines analytical problem-solving with cross-functional collaboration and offers an excellent opportunity for a supply chain professional to develop expertise in inventory planning, distribution, and supply chain operations. Successful candidates are naturally curious, proactive, and motivated to identify opportunities for improvement rather than simply react to issues as they arise.

A successful candidate will:

• Take ownership of inventory challenges and drive issues to resolution.

• Anticipate inventory risks and proactively recommend solutions.

• Build strong working relationships with manufacturing sites, warehouses, and business partners.

• Continuously look for opportunities to improve processes and reporting.

• Thrive in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

• Demonstrate initiative, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Inventory Coordination & Reporting

  • Analyze inventory trends and identify potential shortages, excess inventory, or deployment risks before they impact operations.
  • Investigate inventory discrepancies and partner with warehouse, manufacturing, internal sales and supply chain teams to determine root causes and corrective actions.
  • Support inventory tracking and visibility across Stratas facilities and 3PL locations

Distribution & Order Coordination

  • Create, schedule, and process distribution orders (DOs) between Stratas facilities and third-party warehouses
  • Own visibility of inventory transfers and proactively resolve delays, exceptions, or inventory balancing issues.
  • Communicate daily with manufacturing sites, warehouses, and 3PL partners regarding inventory availability and order status
  • Coordinate inventory deployment activities to support customer demand, promotions, new product launches, and seasonal requirements.

Cross-Functional Support

  • Serve as a point of contact for inventory and distribution-related questions from internal teams
  • Communicate inventory concerns, order delays, and distribution updates to appropriate stakeholders
  • Work closely with Sales, Customer Service, Transportation, Manufacturing, and Operations teams to support business needs
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives related to inventory management and distribution operations

Process & Documentation

  • Support updates to standard operating procedures and work instructions
  • Ensure timely and accurate data entry and transaction processing
  • Assist with audits, reporting requests, and inventory-related projects as needed

Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Analytics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or related field preferred. Equivalent experience in logistics, supply chain, inventory management, or business operations may be considered.

Related Experience: 1–3 years of experience in supply chain, inventory planning, logistics, operations analysis, project management, business analytics, or related fields. Recent graduates with internships, co-op experience, or demonstrated analytical project work are encouraged to apply.

Equipment/Software Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.

Experience with ERP systems such as Infor M3, SAP, or similar business systems preferred. Experience running and maintaining reports preferred.

Competencies

  • Organization & Time Management: Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Attention to Detail: Maintains accuracy in transactions, reporting, and inventory records
  • Problem Solving: Uses data and sound judgment to identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and implement effective solutions.
  • Customer Focus: Responds promptly and professionally to internal and external requests
  • Teamwork: Collaborates effectively across departments and with external partners
  • Initiative: Naturally asks questions, investigates trends, and uses data to support decisions and recommendations.

Physical: Typical activities may include prolonged periods of sitting or standing, using a computer, and occasional movement within the workplace. May require lifting or moving items up to 25 pounds.

Sensory: Requires clear verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with team members and others. Active listening and attention to detail are essential.

title: Project Manager – Data Migration & Business Change (Underwriting/Pricing)
description:
About the Role

This is a hybrid role sitting within the Underwriting function in the Technical Transformation team, combining data engineering expertise with business change management capability. The successful candidate will play a critical role in a wider application transformation programme, ensuring the Underwriting/Pricing data mart requirements are clearly defined and that data continues to flow successfully into the data marts throughout and after the transition. In addition, they will support the UW function’s longer-term migration to a new target data platform.

The application transformation programme is already up and running for several months, with a recent scope change regarding chain of implementation/execution roll-out.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and document the requirements for the current pricing data mart as part of the application transformation.

  • Ensure data is successfully fed back into the pricing data marts during and after the migration.

  • Ingest data files into the Pricing Datamart, covering claims data, policy and product data, third-party administrator data, and ad-hoc file uploads.

  • Validate incoming data upon delivery, checking for completeness, accuracy, and conformance to expected formats before loading into the Datamart.

  • Identify, investigate, and resolve data quality issues, escalating delivery problems where necessary.

  • Clean and transform raw source data to meet Pricing Datamart standards and ensure consistency across data sets.

  • Write, maintain, and optimise SQL and Python scripts to support ingestion, transformation, and validation workflows.

  • Support the existing pricing team by ensuring timely, accurate, and reliable data availability within the Datamart.

title: Sr. BI Developer
description:
Halvik Corp delivers a wide range of services to 13 executive agencies and 15 independent agencies. Halvik is a highly successful WOB business with more than 50 prime contracts and 500+ professionals delivering Digital Services, Advanced Analytics, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Cyber Security and Cutting-Edge Technology across the US Government. Be a part of something special!

Position Overview

Halvik is seeking a Senior BI Developer to support a high-visibility federal data modernization program at the U.S. Department of Transportation. This program is migrating thousands of reports from Oracle Data Warehouse / OBIEE into Tableau dashboards connected to a Databricks platform.

The Senior BI Developer will build complex Tableau workbooks, dashboards, and visualizations against published data sources designed by the data architects. A significant part of the conversion workflow leverages AI-generated report scaffolds as starting points - the Senior BI Developer will review, refine, and finalize these into production-quality reports. For reports that require creative visualization design or complex Tableau techniques, the Senior BI Developer will perform direct development and serve as the Tableau quality authority.

The ideal candidate is a strong Tableau practitioner with a sharp eye for data visualization - someone who understands not just how to build reports, but how to display information effectively for different audiences and data patterns. Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate prior work through a portfolio or live reproduction of sample dashboards.

Core Responsibilities

  • Develop complex Tableau workbooks, dashboards, and interactive features against published Tableau data sources built on Databricks gold-layer tables.
  • Review and refine AI-generated Tableau report scaffolds to produce production-quality output that faithfully reproduces legacy business logic.
  • Propose and implement the most effective visualization type based on the data pattern, audience, and use case. Bring creative visualization design to the migration, not just functional reproduction of legacy layouts.
  • Apply Tableau performance best practices and own Tableau-side performance tuning.
  • Validate report fidelity by comparing Tableau output to legacy OBIEE reports, ensuring accuracy in calculations, aggregations, filters, and business logic.
  • Review and approve junior BI Developer output before reports advance to QA and UAT. Enforce visualization standards, naming conventions, and quality gates.
  • Publish workbooks to Tableau Server/Cloud and verify successful rendering, data refresh, and access controls. Manage extract schedules and connection configurations for production reports.
  • Collaborate with the Data Architect on TDS design feedback, surfacing cases where data source structures create development friction, performance issues, or visualization limitations from the report-builder perspective.
  • Mentor junior BI Developers on Tableau best practices.
  • Contribute to migration playbooks, visualization standards documentation, and knowledge transfer materials. Participate in stakeholder demos, sprint reviews, and Agile ceremonies.

Minimum Requirements

  • BS degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.
  • 7+ years of hands-on Tableau development experience, including complex dashboards, published data sources, calculated fields, parameters, table calculations, performance tuning, and Tableau Server publishing.
  • Solid SQL skills.
  • Understanding of data warehouse concepts - dimensional models, fact and dimension tables, star schemas, data marts
  • Effective working in Agile delivery environments with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Expertise

  • Experience with BI platform migrations (OBIEE-to-Tableau, Cognos-to-Tableau, or similar legacy-to-modern conversions).
  • Experience using AI/LLM tools in a professional development workflow - code generation, data analysis, documentation, or report scaffolding.
  • Familiarity with Tableau APIs.
  • Python fundamentals for scripting, automation, or data manipulation.
  • Experience working in a federal government IT environment.
  • Familiarity with OBIEE RPD structure, subject areas, presentation layers, or BI Catalog - useful but not required.

Company-supported medical, dental, vision, life, STD, and LTD insurance
Benefits include 11 federal holidays and PTO
Eligible employees may receive performance-based incentives in recognition of individual and/or team achievements.
401(k) with company matching

description:
Patient Navigator Job Description

Saving Lives with Early Detection HALO Precision Diagnostics (HALO Dx)

At HALO Diagnostics (HALO Dx), we recognize that every patient is unique. Our mission is to deliver early detection and precision-focused healthcare to help prevent and conquer the most impactful diseases. Through specialized care and advanced diagnostic tools, we make a measurable difference in patient outcomes.

From Vascular and Interventional Radiology to Orthopedic and Sports Medicine, Neuroradiology, and Whole-Body Imaging, our radiologists are highly trained to diagnose and, in many cases, treat a wide range of conditions using minimally invasive and precision-driven approaches.

Position

Patient Navigator (Patient Support & Phlebotomy) – Hereditary Cancer Testing

📍 Location: Castle Rock, CO
🕗 Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
💼 Employment Type: Full-Time | In-Person

Bilingual in English/Spanish preferred

About the Role

The Patient Navigator (Patient Support & Phlebotomy) plays a critical role in guiding patients through key stages of their genetic testing and diagnostic journey. This position provides patient education, care coordination, and phlebotomy support while working closely with a multidisciplinary clinical team to deliver a seamless, compassionate, and high-quality patient experience.

In addition to competitive compensation, this position offers a comprehensive benefits package and stock options within a fast-growing healthcare technology organization.

Position Overview

The Patient Navigator supports patients undergoing hereditary cancer genetic testing through a combination of patient navigation, clinical coordination, partner site support, and specimen collection. This role serves as a primary point of contact for patients and partner sites, helping guide individuals through education, scheduling, specimen collection, and follow-up while ensuring an exceptional patient experience.

You will work closely with clinicians and operational teams to ensure high-quality care and efficient workflows across all partner locations. This role is built on HALO Dx's Navigator Pillars, which guide how we care for patients, support partners, and execute daily work.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Navigation & Communication

  • Guide patients through the hereditary cancer genetic testing process from start to finish.

  • Provide clear, compassionate education on testing, procedures, and next steps.

  • Serve as the primary patient contact to ensure a supportive and informed experience.

  • Conduct structured patient consultations to ensure clarity, accuracy, and consistency.

Clinic Integration & Partner Relationships

  • Build strong relationships with partner site staff, providers, and clinical teams.

  • Act as a trusted extension of partner clinics and support daily workflow integration.

  • Adapt to changing clinic needs, schedules, and priorities while maintaining service quality.

Workflow Ownership & Follow-Up

  • Own patient cases, scheduling, follow-ups, and workflow coordination.

  • Proactively identify and resolve barriers to patient testing or completion.

  • Ensure timely callbacks and consistent communication with patients and partners.

Clinical Support & Operational Execution

  • Perform venipuncture and collect blood specimens for genetic testing.

  • Ensure proper patient identification, labeling, handling, and transport of specimens.

  • Follow all clinical protocols, safety standards, and compliance requirements.

  • Maintain accurate documentation in EMR/EHR systems.

Knowledge & Compliance

  • Build expertise in genetic testing workflows, insurance processes, and patient eligibility.

  • Support insurance verification and authorization processes as needed.

  • Ensure HIPAA compliance and accurate data entry.

  • Confidently answer patient questions regarding testing and next steps.

Patient Experience & Problem Solving

  • Create a welcoming, professional, and supportive environment for patients.

  • Respond to patient concerns with empathy and clarity.

  • Identify and help resolve barriers such as scheduling, insurance, or workflow issues.

  • Support creative solutions to improve patient completion and outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • Nationally certified phlebotomist with strong venipuncture skills.

  • Minimum of 2 years of clinical experience (front office or back office).

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience with insurance verification and prior authorizations.

  • Current BLS certification.

  • Experience with diagnostic or genetic specimen collection.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation (if travel is required).

Preferred Qualifications

  • CMA or RMA certification.

  • 2+ years of experience in an outpatient clinic or patient service center setting.

  • Experience in genetics, oncology, women's health, or specialty diagnostics.

  • Experience with EMR/EHR systems and strong documentation skills.

  • Prior high-touch patient-facing healthcare experience.

  • Healthcare students or candidates pursuing clinical careers are encouraged to apply.

Make a meaningful impact in patients' lives through early detection and advanced diagnostics.

Enjoy a consistent weekday schedule with no weekends, nights, or holidays.

title: Women's Health Consultant
description:
Too many women spend years being told their pain is normal. They wait a long time for a diagnosis, cycle through treatments that do not work for them, and often end up managing debilitating symptoms on their own. At Montu, we see these patients every day. Many arrive with exhausted conventional options for conditions like endometriosis, PMDD and menopausal symptoms, and for a significant number, medical cannabis is the first treatment that has genuinely improved their quality of life.

We are looking for Women's Health Consultants to join us on a permanent basis. This is real clinical work with real outcomes. You will be assessing and managing patients who have often been dismissed elsewhere, and you will see the difference your care makes.

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring medical cannabis as a treatment option for women's health conditions. Our multidisciplinary model means nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks, so your time is spent where it matters most: with patients.

Medical cannabis is still an emerging field in the UK, and we will be honest with you: it is not for every clinician. It requires an open mind, a willingness to work with evolving evidence, and a genuine interest in listening to patients whose symptoms have not fitted neatly into conventional pathways. If that sounds like you, you will find this work rewarding in a way that is increasingly rare in medicine.

What will you be doing?

  • Provide high quality care for patients seeking pain management for Women’s health conditions through medical cannabis treatment.

  • Lead management of symptoms for women’s health conditions such as:

  • Menstrual issues (pain, heavy periods, irregular cycles)

  • PMDD (Irritability and anger, Anxiety, Fatigue ,Depressed mood)

  • PMS (Bloating, Mood swings, Breast tenderness)

  • Menopausal/perimenopausal symptoms (hot flushes, sleep disturbance, mood changes, joint pain, vaginal dryness, libido changes

  • Fertility or reproductive health

  • Pelvic pain (endometriosis, fibroids, PCOS, ovarian cysts, PID)

  • Bone or joint health (osteoporosis, arthritis, chronic pain)

  • Sleep problems (insomnia, restless sleep)

  • Mood or mental health (anxiety, low mood, irritability, stress)

  • Chronic pain (including migraines, back pain, nerve pain, pelvic pain)

  • Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management.

  • Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices.

  • Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards.

  • Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists.

  • Participate in ongoing training and professional development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBMPs).

What do you need?

  • Full GMC Registration & MRCOG qualification

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification ideally in

  • On the GMC Specialist Register

  • Has acquired or is working towards a Pain qualification

  • Demonstrated interest in Medical cannabis therapies

  • Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + 8 bank holidays

  • Private Healthcare

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

title: IT Security Specialist
description:
What is the job?

Montu UK is entering an exciting new phase in its security journey: creating an independent, future-ready architecture for the UK and Europe. We’re moving beyond shared APAC infrastructure to establish our own tenants, controls and security ecosystem -built specifically for the unique demands of our rapidly growing UK and EU operations.

Australia has already developed a mature security architecture; this role is an opportunity to take that strong foundation and shape it for an entirely different regulatory and operational landscape. You’ll build security around requirements including CQC, GPhC, MHRA, Home Office controlled drugs, UK GDPR and NHS DSPT, while supporting an expanding estate that includes our Winnersh Triangle site, EU tenant separation and continued European growth.

This is not a governance-only role focused on auditing, reporting or writing policies - we already have dedicated teams owning that work. We need a hands-on security builder: someone who can design, implement and operate meaningful controls, solve complex technical challenges and strengthen our security capabilities from the inside.

You’ll work directly alongside the IT Manager as a close collaborator on both strategy and delivery, with the Support Analyst and HiLabs Ireland contact forming your wider working circle. You’ll be part of the team building and delivering the architecture -not standing outside it and checking the work.

Given the regulatory responsibility Montu carries, sound judgement and trustworthiness are essential - but so is momentum. We value practical progress over perfection: someone who can implement a strong, effective control today, learn from it and continue improving it, rather than spend months developing a flawless policy that never makes it into practice.

What will you be doing?

This is a delivery role. Representative work already in flight or on the near-term roadmap:

  • Endpoint & identity security engineering - contributing to the CrowdStrike AU→UK CID migration (Intune-deployed, scripted), Entra ID configuration for the new EU/UK tenant, and Intune/MDM policy build-out.

  • Network security delivery - hands-on work on Netskope deployment for SaaS/web steering, Tailscale ACL and zero-trust access design, and FortiGate/UniFi security configuration for the Winnersh Triangle site.

  • Site security build - working the physical/technical security side of the Winnersh Triangle stand-up: access control (Paxton), CCTV, structured cabling security, vendor delivery oversight (we're mid-RFP with Safeguard Systems and FTL Secure Solutions) - this is real vendor and project management, not paperwork.

  • Compliance-as-engineering - turning ISO 27001 and Cyber Essentials Plus requirements into actual implemented controls rather than just gap-analysis documents; supporting DSPT evidence with real technical artefacts.

  • Incident response & monitoring - building out our detection and response capability as it matures, being a genuine first responder rather than a policy author.

  • Vendor & pentest liaison - working with our security partners (e.g. Klaatu IT Security) on delivery, not just contract admin - reviewing findings and personally driving remediation.

  • Documentation that's useful, not performative - technical runbooks, architecture diagrams, and control evidence that the team actually uses, versus policy for policy's sake.

You'll be a second pair of hands and a second brain on all of this - someone the IT Manager can hand a problem to and trust it gets solved, not just assessed.

What do you need?

The mindset matters more than the checklist:

  • You'd rather fix the thing than write a memo about the thing.

  • You see security as an enabler of the business (clinicians, pharmacy, patients) rather than a department of "no."

  • You're comfortable being hands-on in Intune, a firewall config, or a script at 4pm and in a vendor negotiation or compliance conversation at 10am.

  • You work well in a very small, very autonomous team - this is not an environment with layers of process to hide behind; you'll need to be self-directed.

  • You’ll need to “muck-in” with the team if the need arises for any & all technology issues.

Technical experience (ideally several of the following):

  • Endpoint protection platforms (CrowdStrike, Sophos, or similar EDR/XDR)

  • Microsoft Entra ID / Intune, and modern zero-trust access tooling (Tailscale, Netskope, Cloudflare Zero Trust, or similar)

  • Network security fundamentals (FortiGate or similar UTM/firewall, VLAN segmentation, secure site network design)

  • ISO 27001 and/or Cyber Essentials Plus - from an implementation angle, not just an audit angle

  • Working knowledge of UK GDPR and healthcare-adjacent regulatory environments (CQC, NHS DSPT, GPhC, MHRA) - or a fast learner who can pick this up with support

  • Scripting/automation (PowerShell, Python, or similar) for security tooling and deployment

  • Comfort working with regulated, patient-data-adjacent systems

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience in a healthcare, pharmacy, or life sciences environment

  • Experience helping a business separate from a parent company's IT estate (tenant migrations, identity separation)

  • CREST, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent - valued but not gatekept on; we care more about what you've built than the letters after your name

What this role is not:

  • Not a compliance-only or audit-only function

  • Not a "security says no" gatekeeper role

  • Not a large-team, heavily hierarchical environment - this is scrappy, fast-moving, and hands-on

  • Not someone who hands work back to the IT Manager to implement - you implement it

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

title: Projectmanager
description:
Jouw energie in de plus

De energietransitie vraagt om slimme oplossingen, samenwerking en daadkracht. Als projectmanager hoogspanning werk je aan projecten die essentieel zijn voor een betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig energiesysteem. Je brengt mensen, techniek en belangen samen en zorgt ervoor dat complexe projecten succesvol worden gerealiseerd.

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt?

  • Je werkt aan projecten met een investeringswaarde tot €50 miljoen en enkele tot €100 miljoen.

  • Je levert een zichtbare bijdrage aan de energietransitie in Nederland.

  • Je krijgt volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en impact te maken binnen een ervaren team.

Werk om trots op te zijn

Je werkt aan uitdagende hoogspanningsprojecten, zoals nieuwe stations, uitbreidingen van het elektriciteitsnet, tracéwerken en grote klantaansluitingen. Samen met collega's, aannemers en stakeholders zorg je ervoor dat projecten van initiatief tot oplevering soepel verlopen.


Jouw kracht ligt in het creëren van verbinding: je brengt verschillende disciplines samen, houdt overzicht en zorgt ervoor dat iedereen dezelfde koers blijft volgen. Zo draag je direct bij aan een toekomstbestendig elektriciteitsnet voor de generaties na ons.

Een dag als projectmanager

  • Je werkt samen met aannemers, engineers en andere betrokkenen aan de ontwikkeling van een hoogspanningsstation en zorgt dat iedereen aangehaakt blijft bij de projectdoelstellingen.

  • Je vertaalt risico's, financiën en planning naar heldere keuzes en ondersteunt het projectteam bij het realiseren van resultaten.

  • Je onderhoudt contacten met klanten, gemeenten en interne stakeholders en weet verschillende belangen op een constructieve manier samen te brengen.

  • Je creëert een omgeving waarin samenwerking centraal staat en waarin uitdagingen tijdig worden besproken en opgelost.

Hier laad jij van op

Alle financiële arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rij, weet je meteen waar je aan toe bent:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van maximaal €8.500,- (bij 40 uur), 24,5 vakantiedagen en pensioenopbouw bij ABP waarbij wij 70% van de premie betalen.

  • Bovenop je salaris ontvang je een persoonlijk budget van 24% (inclusief 8% vakantiegeld). Jij kiest wat je met het budget doet: bijvoorbeeld extra salaris of (tot max. 35,5) verlofdagen. In onze rekentool zie je hoe het werkt.

  • Jaarlijks € 700,- (bruto) om te besteden aan je eigen energie, bijvoorbeeld voor je sportabonnement of je nieuwe sportkleding.


Daar komt dit nog bovenop:

  • Jouw ontwikkeling staat centraal: events bezoeken met collega’s, meedoen aan kennissessies, trainingen en opleidingen volgen. Zo haal jij het beste uit jezelf.

  • Reizen naar kantoor doe je met de OV-vrijregeling. Dat is een ov-kaart die je ook in je vrije tijd kan gebruiken. Of met de flexibele reisregeling, waarbij je zelf kiest, combineert en varieert hoe je naar je werk reist en een extra vergoeding krijgt als je met de fiets komt.

  • Moderne thuiswerkfaciliteiten en een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,40 per dag.


Vol energie vooruit met het team binnen de Keten Projecten

Je komt terecht in een team van projectprofessionals binnen Zakelijk Complex: Hoogspanning. Een team waarin collega's elkaar graag helpen, kennis delen en samen successen vieren. De ervaring en achtergronden binnen het team zijn divers, maar de gezamenlijke ambitie is hetzelfde: bijdragen aan een duurzaam en betrouwbaar energiesysteem. Je krijgt veel ruimte om zelfstandig te werken, terwijl er altijd collega's zijn om mee te sparren of van te leren. Je werkt op locatie Utrecht, vanuit huis en projectlocatie.

Met deze kwaliteiten groei jij hier verder

Je vindt het leuk om mensen en belangen met elkaar te verbinden en weet overzicht te houden binnen complexe projecten. Je communiceert helder, neemt initiatief en werkt graag samen aan duurzame resultaten.

Herken jij jezelf grotendeels in onderstaande punten? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

  • Je hebt een afgeronde hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in (technische) bedrijfskunde.

  • Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van complexe multidisciplinaire projecten.

  • Je voelt je thuis in een technische omgeving en bent nieuwsgierig naar ontwikkelingen binnen de energietransitie.

  • Je werkt graag samen met verschillende partijen en weet mensen mee te nemen in veranderingen.

Zet de stap naar jouw volgende uitdaging

We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten.


Dit is nog goed om te weten:

title: Jobba som Distributör i Karlskrona
description:
Att vara distributör är ett självständigt arbete med många fördelar. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår att dela ut tidningar, paket, post, reklam och samhällsinformation till alla typer av boenden och företag.

Distributionen sker utomhus på natten. Det är ett fysiskt krävande arbete med högt tempo, många trappuppgångar och med varierande väderlek. För utdelningen använder vi företagsbilar eller elmopeder beroende på geografi. Du bör bo i eller nära det område där du arbetar.

Arbetstiden är schemalagd någon gång mellan kl. 23.00 och 07.00. Den faktiska arbetstiden kan variera från natt till natt. Vid försening kan arbetet pågå till 07:30 på vardagar och 08:30 på helger.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är ansvarsfull, passar tider och har en hög servicekänsla. Bland våra distributörer finns studenter, pensionärer, entreprenörer och andra som vill ha en huvudsaklig eller extra inkomst. Mångfalden är vi stolta över.

Krav - för att kunna jobba hos oss måste du:

  • Vara minst 18 år
  • Ha goda kunskaper i svenska eller engelska
  • Inneha ett personnummer eller samordningsnummer
  • Inneha ett giltigt arbetstillstånd
  • Trivas med att arbeta natt
  • Klara av fysiskt krävande arbete utomhus
  • B-körkort

****

Information om rekryteringsprocessenSom ett led i vårt arbete mot en så rättvis och fördomsfri rekryteringsprocess som möjligt, har vi i denna process valt att samarbeta med Hubert.ai. Om du väljer att skicka in en ansökan kommer du att bjudas in till in en chatt-baserad intervju med vår virtuella rekryteringsassistent Hubert.

Vi på Point logistik är experter på last-mile-distribution och finns i Borås–Sjuhärad, Växjö–Kronoberg, Kalmar, Karlskrona–Blekinge samt Kristianstad–Östra Skåne. Vårt huvuduppdrag är att dela ut tidningar. I vårt distributionsnät erbjuder vi företag tjänster för leverans av tidskrifter, post och paket. Tillsammans med Early Bird, ett bolag som ägs av Sveriges största mediehus, når vi fram med leveranser hem till människor i hela landet.

Vi vill vara de lokala hjältarna som hjälper e-handlare att överleva och förenklar vardagen för de många människorna. Vi är också den lokala partnern som hjälper andra att lyckas och kan vår omgivning.

Vår vision är att ge människor en bättre start på dagen. Det är också en vision som spinner vidare på vår ägare mediekoncernen Gota Media AB:s ambition om att vara med och skapa ett bättre samhälle. En dag börjar bra när brevlådan fylls med förväntningar, överraskningar, viktiga försändelser i form av tidningar, post och paket. För distributörer kan en dag börja bra när ditt deltidsarbete hos Point skapar möjligheter!

title: Tiimivastaava-sairaanhoitaja, Esperi Hoivakoti Riihelä
description:
Hei sairaanhoitaja! Haluatko työskennellä osana lämminhenkistä työyhteisöä, jossa pääset kehittämään ammattitaitoasi sekä kerryttämään arvokasta työkokemusta? Haemme nyt tiimivastaava-sairaanhoitajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Esperi Hoivakoti Riihelään, Pöytyälle. Lue tehtävästä lisää alta ja hae meille nyt!

Tällainen on meidän hoivakotimme

Hoivakoti Riihelässä tarjoamme ympärivuorokautista hoivaa ikäihmisille sekä muistisairaille. Sijaitsemme luonnonläheisellä alueella Pöytyällä, jonka avaralla piha-alueella nautimme yhteisistä kesäpäivistä kahvikupposen äärellä. Riihelässä on kaksi ryhmäkotia: Kuusela sekä Koivula. Tässä tehtävässä työskentelet pääosin ryhmäkoti Koivulassa, joka tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista ikääntyneille vammautuneille ja vammaisille. Riihelässä on lämmin ja ammattitaitoinen porukka. Työkaverisi ovat reippaita ja rentoja, ja meillä tehdään yhteistyötä varmistaen joustavan työarjen. Yhteinen tavoitteemme on Suomen onnellisimmat asukkaat!

Tiimivastaavan työ meillä

Tiimivastaava-sairaanhoitajana sinulla on laaja ja monipuolinen toimenkuva, jossa pääset takuulla hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät sairaanhoidollinen työ, asukaslähtöinen hoiva ja arjen organisointi. Huolehdit ryhmäkotisi hoivan laadusta, osallistut hoitotyöhön, vastaat lääkehoidosta sekä tuet tiimiäsi arjen sujuvuudessa. Teet myös tiivistä yhteistyötä oman esihenkilösi ja tiimisi lisäksi lääkärin, fysioterapeutin sekä toisen ryhmäkodin tiimivastaavan kanssa. Työ sisältää yksikön toiminnan kehittämistä. Tiimivastaavan tehtävässä meillä Riihelässä saat varmasti arvokasta ja monipuolista työkokemusta!

Työsuhteen tiedot

Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. Työtä on arkisin klo 7-15. Toivomme uutta työkaveria mahdollisimman pian, mutta sovimme aloituksesta tarkemmin kanssasi!

Palkka

Palkkauksessa noudatamme yksityistä sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta. Tiimivastaavan pohjapalkka on kokemuslisistä riippuen palkkaluokan G24D mukaisesti 2 811,09 - 3 071,09 €/kk (1.9.2026 alkaen). Lisäksi maksamme tiimivastaavan lisää 200€/kk sekä yksikkökohtaista lisää 60€/kk, kun sinulla on lääkeluvat suoritettuna.

Nyt pohdit varmasti, voitko sinä hakea tehtävää?

Toivomme sinulta:

- sairaanhoitajan tutkintoa

- kokemusta ikääntyneiden hoivasta ja erinomaisia organisointitaitoja

- voimassa olevia lääkelupia, hygieniapassia sekä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa

- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

- positiivista ja aktiivista otetta

Pyydämme lisäksi rikosrekisterilain mukaisen rikosrekisteriotteen nähtäväksi.

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?

- Rauhallisen työympäristön

- Monipuoliset työsuhde-edut (mm. ePassin virike-etu, työmatkaetu, Cityshopparin alennukset)

- Mahdollisuudet kouluttautua työn ohessa, esim. lähiesihenkilötyön ammattitutkinnon kautta

- Oivan polun kohti esihenkilötyöstä - tästä kokemuksesta on sinulle varmasti hyötyä!

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä? Mahtavaa!

Lähetä hakemuksesi 20.8. mennessä ja kerro meille itsestäsi! Toimithan pikimmiten, sillä käymme hakemuksia läpi ja aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana.

Haluatko kuulla lisää tehtävästä? Lisätietoja antaa yksikönjohtaja Tiina Ritolehto (yhteydenotot ark. 9-15), puh. 050 341 6939 // tiina.ritolehto@esperi.fi


Esperi Hoivakoti Riihelä

Esperi on suomalainen asumispalveluita tarjoava valtakunnallinen yritys. Työllistämme yli 7200 sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattilaista, ja Esperi-koteja löytyy yli 100 paikkakunnalta ympäri Suomen. Kodeissamme asuu ikäihmisiä, mielenterveyskuntoutujia sekä vammaispalvelun asiakkaita. Hoitotyötä teemme asukaslähtöisesti ja laadukkaasti. Korkea asukastyytyväisyys (50 NPS) on ylpeytemme aihe. Tule kokemaan itse, minkälaista meillä on olla töissä! Kaikki avoimet työtehtävämme löydät [täältä](https://esperi.fi/tyopaikat/avoimet-tyopaikat/).

Puhelin: 050 341 6939 Sähköposti: tiina.ritolehto@esperi.fi Sijainti: Kiviaidantie 4

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?

* Ammattitaitoasi vastaavan palkkauksen
* Apua ja tukea työssä tarvittavien korttien ja koulutusten hankkimiseen.
* Luotettavan työpaikan, jossa kaikki työsuhteeseen liittyvät asiat hoituvat oppikirjan mukaan
* Mahdollisuuden kehittyä alan töissä osaavassa seurassa
* Mukavat työkaverit ja osaavan esihenkilön

Tässä vielä muutama syy, miksi sinun kannattaa valita Lisäpalvelu:

1. Meillä saat työnhakijana ja -tekijänä aidosti henkilökohtaista palvelua. Tapaat meidät kasvotusten jo työnhakuvaiheessa. Kun työllistyt kauttamme, saat meiltä nimetyn yhteyshenkilön, joka auttaa sinua kaikissa työsuhteeseen liittyvissä asioissa.
2. Rakennusalan asiakaskuntamme on todella monipuolinen. Siksi pystymme tarjoamaan laajan kattauksen erilaisia tehtäviä, joista löytyy jokaiselle jotakin.
3. Ison asiakaskuntamme ansiosta töitä on tarjolla jatkuvasti, ja yhden työkeikan päättyessä voitkin osaamisesi mukaan työllistyä pian seuraavalle työmaalle.
4. Pidämme kiinni sovituista asioista ja teemme sen, mitä lupaamme. Sinä voit keskittyä työntekoon, koska me hoidamme puolestasi ylimääräisen byrokratian.



Kuulostaako hyvältä? Hienoa, haluamme kuulla sinusta pian!

Jos saimme sinut kiinnostumaan ja haluaisit liittyä Lisäpalvelun porukkaan, laita meille hakemus tulemaan mahdollisimman pian!



Jäikö sinulle kysyttävää? Toni Puhakka kertoo sinulle mielellään lisää. Hänet tavoitat arkisin klo.9-15 numerosta 0444 932 869 tai sähköpostilla osoitteesta toni.puhakka@lisapalvelu.net <mailto:toni.puhakka@lisapalvelu.net>





Lisäpalvelu on vuonna 2002 perustettu valtakunnallisesti toimiva joustavia henkilöstöratkaisuja tarjoava kotimainen yritys. Lisäpalvelu-konserni on tunnettu luotettavuudesta ja pitkäaikaisista asiakassuhteista niin työnantajien kuin -tekijöiden keskuudessa. Työllistämme vuosittain yli 3 000 työntekijää, ja olemme vahva toimija monella alalla: tarjoamme töitä mm. ravintola-, rakennus-, teollisuus-, kunnossapito-, logistiikka-, toimisto-, siivous- ja kaupan aloilla. Olemme Suomen kymmenen suurimman henkilöstöpalvelualan yrityksen joukossa, ja kuulumme Henkilöstöpalveluyritysten liittoon (HPL).



Haluamme tehdä töihin menon sinulle helpoksi: kauttamme voit työllistyä parhaimmillaan jo seuraavana päivänä. Tarjoamme jatkuvasti töitä erilaisiin elämäntilanteisiin, ja kauttamme tehty vuokratyö on ollut monelle työntekijällemme reitti vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.



Hae meille, niin etsitään yhdessä juuri sinulle mielekäs työ!

title: Consultant Dermatologist
description:
Job Description:

Consultant Dermatologist

Location: Stratum Clinic Wimbledon (SW20 0LW)

Contract Type: Self Employed

Hours: Minimum 8 hours weekly

Salary: Percentage Spilt

We make health happen

At Bupa Dermatology, our ambition is to build the UK’s leading dermatology network. Across our growing family of private clinics, our expert teams are committed to transforming lives through exceptional, personalised care, helping patients achieve the best possible outcomes for their skin health.

We take pride in our strong reputation in the field. At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to exceptional outcomes, continuous improvement, and a supportive and fulfilling work environment.

Bupa is a Level 2 Disability Confident Employer. This means we aim to offer an interview/assessment to every disabled applicant who meets the minimum criteria for the role. We’ll make sure you are treated fairly and offer reasonable adjustments as part of our recruitment process to anyone that needs them.

title: Citizen Experience Product Design Officer
description:
• Hours: 37 hours per week (full time)
  • Contract: 24 months
  • Salary: Grade 8 - £39,153 - £41,772
  • Location: Sheffield (This is a hybrid role with a minimum of 3 days per week in the office)
South Yorkshire Mayoral Combined Authority is working to build a wealthier, healthier, happier and safer South Yorkshire, where everyone has the opportunity to stay near and go far.

As our Citizen Experience Product Design Officer, you will help shape the products, interfaces and touchpoints people use when they interact with SYMCA. You will turn our discovery and service improvement work into clear, practical, inclusive and beautifully designed solutions that help people find information, understand services and get things done with confidence.

We believe good design should do more than work well. It should feel considered, welcoming and something people can take pride in using. Because every interaction matters, from a website or app to a timetable, sign or information screen. Good design helps people feel confident. Great design helps people feel valued. Beauty is worth striving for.

The Citizen Experience team works across SYMCA, and with partners and communities, to make services more citizen-centred, accessible and joined up. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to initiatives across a wide variety of public services in South Yorkshire, including the South Yorkshire People's Network.

Applications must be accompanied by a cover letter to detail how you meet the criteria as detailed within the role profile. (please see role profile attached). Please note, all applications should be made directly via our careers portal.

Please also provide, or include a link to, a portfolio showing examples of your design work. We're particularly interested in seeing how you approach a brief, develop ideas and use your design process to create practical, user-centred solutions. We'd also like to understand how you've balanced usability, accessibility and aesthetic quality to create experiences that people genuinely value.

You will provide a specialist product, interface and service touchpoint design service for SYMCA. Your work will help citizens access, navigate and use services more easily, whether that's through a digital interface, physical environment, printed information or wayfinding system.

You will take briefs, user insight, service requirements and organisational priorities and turn them into practical concepts, prototypes and design outputs. You will test ideas, gather feedback and refine designs so that solutions are accessible, usable and ready to move from concept into delivery. You'll also help make sure products and touchpoints form part of a coherent wider experience for citizens.

At SYMCA, we believe people deserve public services that are not only easy to use, but thoughtfully designed. We want to create experiences that are clear, attractive and intuitive. Experiences that reduce stress, build confidence and inspire pride in public transport and public services. Whether you're designing a digital journey, a printed timetable, a wayfinding system or an information display, you'll help create products and touchpoints that people trust, understand and value.

This role covers a broad range of design activity, and you will work across a wide variety of channels and touchpoints to produce concepts and prototypes. Your work will provide a foundation for operational delivery and graphic design teams to produce final outputs.

For further information, please see the attached role profile.
You will be a practical, creative and user-centred designer who wants services to work better for people. You care about usability and accessibility, but you also understand the value of beauty. You believe great design can make everyday experiences simpler, clearer and more enjoyable, and that public services should be every bit as thoughtfully designed as the best products people use elsewhere in their lives.

You may come from product design, UI/UX, digital interaction design, service design or another relevant design background. What matters is that you can think clearly about how people interact with services and turn that understanding into effective design solutions.

You'll be confident exploring ideas, creating prototypes and developing concepts grounded in evidence and real user needs. You'll know when to challenge a brief, when to simplify, and when a design needs something more to make it genuinely useful, engaging and memorable.

You'll also recognise that every interaction is part of a bigger picture. A website, a sign, a timetable, a customer journey or a physical environment should all feel like part of the same experience.

We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who cares deeply about people and great design. Someone who wants to make services easier to use, but also believes public services can be clearer, warmer and more beautiful. If you have the creativity, curiosity, attention to detail and design mindset to help improve everyday life across South Yorkshire, we'd love to hear from you.
All colleagues have access to a Local Government Pension Scheme and the chance to be part of an organisation where you can really make a difference. Located in Sheffield City Centre, we are well-placed for transport links and encourage employees to take advantage of the active travel facilities. Work/life balance is extremely important to us here at SYMCA with our recognised family/friendly policies, genuine work flexibility, recognition, and shared success.

In addition to the above, some of our benefits include -

Holiday Entitlement – From 28 to 36 days annual leave entitlement (depending on length of service) plus bank holidays. Pro-rata for part time colleagues.

Annual Leave Purchase Scheme – The ability to purchase up to a further 15 days per year in additional to your normal annual leave

Hybrid working – Our offices are a space where we come together and collaborate. Most of our roles are offered on a hybrid basis with the exception of some support roles being onsite full time. Please note, unless specified within the job advert, we cannot accommodate remote working contracts.

Flexible Hours Scheme – Most roles within SYMCA work under the Flexi-Scheme which allows office-based employees’ flexibility and discretion over their working hours. Under the scheme employees can accrue a defined amount of credit or debit of working hours, and to take time-off in the form of Flexi-Leave or banked Annual Leave.

Rewarding You - Reducing everyday expenses through discounts, benefits, financial advice, wellbeing solutions and more with Reward Gateway and Cycle-to-Work schemes.

Training on the job - Support with upskilling skills through on-the-job training and qualifications

Professional Membership Fees – Where membership to Professional bodies is applicable to your role, SYMCA will reimburse your membership fees where applicable and following approval by Line Management.

Diversity at South Yorkshire Combined Mayoral Authority

Our workforce is made up of a diverse community, where we all belong and feel part of something bigger. We are committed to equality of opportunity and welcome applications from individuals, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion and/or belief.

All employees are eligible to request Flexible Working arrangements from day one of employment as such all requests will be considered subject to operation requirements.

Where candidates share disabilities within the application process, if they demonstrate that they meet all essential criteria from the Role Profile within their application, they will automatically be invited to interview.

If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout the process, please contact recruitment@southyorkshire-ca.gov.uk or include within your application form detailing the adjustment and how it will assist in managing any barriers.

title: Research Analyst - Macro Oils
description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.


For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.


Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.


By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.


This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.


Wood Mackenzie
Intelligence Connected



Wood Mackenzie Brand Video

Wood Mackenzie Values

  • Inclusive – we succeed together
  • Trusting – we choose to trust each other
  • Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
  • Future Focused – we accelerate change
  • Curious – we turn knowledge into action

Role Purpose

Wood Mackenzie is a leading provider of data, analytics and insights for the energy, chemicals, metals and mining sectors. We help companies, financial institutions and governments make better strategic decisions by combining industry expertise, proprietary data and advanced analytical capabilities.

Within this context, the Macro Oils Team delivers market-leading research, forecasts and data products that help clients understand oil market dynamics and navigate an evolving energy landscape. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to both our research and technical capabilities, supporting the analysis, data infrastructure, models and tools that underpin our products and client solutions. Working closely with analysts, modellers and product teams, you will help ensure our research remains accurate, scalable and impactful while supporting the continued development of our analytical and technology platforms.

Main Responsibilities

We are looking for an Analyst to join our Global Analyst Team within the Macro Oils Team. This role combines industry research and market analysis with technical ownership of key data, modelling and automation workflows that underpin our research products. The successful candidate will be expected to:

  • Analyse asset, market and industry developments across the commodities and markets they cover, generating short- and long-term forecasts.
  • Gather, validate and interpret industry data to support Wood Mackenzie's market-leading research and analytical products.
  • Connect and build relationships with clients and industry participants to inform analysis and strengthen market understanding.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Energy and Natural Resources to develop integrated market views and insights.
  • Produce high-quality written analysis on industry developments, including topics such as the Energy Transition, oil-petrochemical integration and sustainability.
  • Contribute to client-facing presentations, discussions and research outputs.

Your application should showcase your enthusiasm for the sectors we cover and demonstrate your ability in the following areas, which we require daily at Wood Mackenzie.

  • Research and data gathering – we identify and gather intelligence that feeds our industry expertise. We need inquisitive and passionate people with a keen eye for detail.
  • Analysis - we provide market-leading research using this data/intelligence and form opinions for, and tell stories to, our customers. We need people with natural curiosity with the potential to become experts in their field and with the ability to articulate – both verbally and in writing – clear, insightful analysis.
  • Internal engagement – we work with colleagues across the Wood Mackenzie business to deliver a compelling, integrated view of the natural resources sector to customers through our cutting-edge products. For this, we need people who are as comfortable working collaboratively as they are independently and who have excellent interpersonal skills.
  • External engagement – we proactively connect with our customers and contacts in the industries we serve, adding value and promoting the Wood Mackenzie brand. This requires people with the potential to become industry experts who have intellectual curiosity, passion, and excellent presentation skills.
  • Continuous improvement – at Wood Mackenzie, we are committed to transforming the way we power our planet. The energy transition is here and this impacts our customer base and how we serve them. We need colleagues with a change mindset, who are flexible, growth-orientated and proactive. This includes being open to explore new AI opportunities.
  • AI literacy and critical thinking – comfortable leveraging AI and advanced analytics to enhance research and processes, while exercising sound judgement, validating outputs and understanding the limitations and risks of automated solutions.

About You

You are an engineer or economist. You will have relevant experience, skills or knowledge that you can apply to the role, allowing you to contribute to our research from day one. Your existing knowledge will enhance our coverage as you develop your career.

  • Keen interest in commodity market dynamics - as someone with a keen interest in commodity market dynamics, you want to understand how these markets impact the natural resources industry and our everyday lives.
  • Analytical mindset and eye for detail - your analytical mindset and attention to detail have been honed through academic and/or work experience. You're comfortable collecting and interpreting data, articulating your findings clearly, and seeking to enhance your knowledge by asking thoughtful questions. You have experience with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, which helps you present your findings in a visually compelling way.
  • Highly adaptive team player - you thrive in fast-paced environments and are excited about the opportunity to work cross-functionally on a variety of tasks. You can work independently or as part of a team, generating ideas and striving to be the best in class.
  • Excellent communication skills - Your strong command of English, both written and spoken, allows you to communicate effectively in the globalised commodity market. Fluency in an additional language would be advantageous.

Expectations

  • Growth mindset - taking the initiative to learn new skills, seeking out feedback and coaching, and actively applying what has been learned in the workplace.
  • Change agility - maintaining high performance through disruption and change.
  • We are a hybrid working company and the successful applicant will be expected to be physically present in the office at least 2 days per week to foster and contribute to a collaborative environment, but this may be subject to change in the future.
  • This is a full-time role expected to work early mornings to accommodate collaboration with Europe time-zones.

Equal Opportunities


We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. title: IT PRIEŽIŪROS SPECIALISTĖ (-AS) (MONITORINGO KOMANDOJE)
description:
Šiuo metu ieškome naujos (-o) komandos narės (-io) Kontaktų centro komandoje. Šioje pozicijoje būsi atsakinga (-as) už IT paslaugų monitoringą, incidentų valdymą ir klientų konsultavimą. Manai, mums pakeliui? Tuomet laukiame tavęs savo komandoje!

Take YOUR part in #EnergySmart!

Prisidėsi prie saugios ir žalios energetikos ekosistemos kūrimo:

  • Stebint ir analizuojant bendrovės IT infrastruktūros bei paslaugų veikimą naudojant monitoringo sistemas;
  • Analizuojant monitoringo įspėjimus (alerts / triggers), identifikuojant incidentus ir inicijuojant jų sprendimą pagal nustatytus procesus;
  • Registruojant, klasifikuojant ir sprendžiant klientų kreipinius IT paslaugų valdymo sistemoje;
  • Vykdant proaktyvų paslaugų veikimo stebėjimą, identifikuojant pasikartojančias problemas ir inicijuojant jų prevenciją;
  • Konsultuojant klientus dėl teikiamų IT paslaugų veikimo ar sutrikimų;
  • Nuotoliniu būdu konsultuojant klientus dėl „Ignitis“ elektromobilių įkrovimo stotelių veikimo ir padedant spręsti įkrovimo sutrikimus.

Darbas pamaininiu grafiku. Už darbą nakties metu taikomas 1,5 karto didesnis apmokėjimas.

  • Aukštasis arba aukštesnysis išsilavinimas IT srityje (gali būti paskutinių kursų studentė (-as));
  • Patirtis IT infrastruktūros, tinklų, serverių ar telekomunikacijų srityje;
  • Patirtis dirbant su IT monitoringo sistemomis (pvz., Zabbix, Grafana ar pan.);
  • IT incidentų valdymo principų žinios ir gebėjimas analizuoti sistemos sutrikimų priežastis;
  • Gebėjimas dirbti savarankiškai, greitai reaguoti į incidentus ir efektyviai planuoti savo darbą;
  • Geri komunikacijos įgūdžius ir gebėjimas aiškiai perteikti techninę informaciją;
  • Geros anglų kalbos žinios (žodžiu ir raštu).
  • Papildomų naudų paketą pasirenkant: pensijų kaupimą, sveikatos draudimą ar kitą naudą iš pasirenkamų naudų sąrašo MELP programėlėje;
  • Atitinkantį patirtį bei kompetencijas atlygį, bei kintamą finansinį paskatinimą priklausantį nuo pasiektų rezultatų;
  • Papildomas apmokamas dienas: sveikatinimuisi, trumpalaikės ligos atveju, savanorystei, už sukauptą darbo stažą;
  • Naujokei (-ui) pritaikytą įvedimo į organizaciją programą, ekskursijas ir bičiulės (-io) palaikymą;
  • Dėmesį fizinei ir emocinei sveikatai: gerovės mentorių iniciatyvas ir psichologinę pagalbą, tinklinio ir krepšinio komandas ir t.t.;
  • Galimybę įsitraukti į vidinę iniciatyvą GROW akademija – tapti lektoriais arba dalyvauti mokymuose;
  • Galimybę prisidėti prie energetikos transformacijos, siekiant sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energijos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms.

Kviečiame prisijungti prie augančios tarptautinės komandos. Ją sudaro išmaniajai energetikai atsidavę specialistai, kuriuos vienija bendras tikslas – sukurti 100% saugią ir žalią energetikos ekosistemą dabarties ir ateities kartoms. O būdas tai pasiekti – tikrai ne laukti tinkamo laiko. Mes tikime, kad energija veikti įsikrauname patys. Suvienyti prasmės. Geriausi ten, kur svarbu. Prisiimame iššūkius. Drąsūs atrasti ir keistis. Tai mūsų vertybinės nuostatos, drauge jos kuria energiją, kuri yra visko, ką mes darome, varomoji jėga. Energiją, kuri virsta mūsų pasirinkimais. Jei ir tu vadovaujiesi šiomis vertybinėmis nuostatomis – lauksime savo komandoje!

Siekdami strateginių tikslų padidinti lyčių balansą „Ignitis grupėje“, pareigų pavadinimus darbo skelbimuose nurodome pirmiausia moteriškos giminės galūne.

„Ignitis grupė“ yra lygias galimybes užtikrinanti darbovietė, kurioje laukiami visi kandidatai, nediskriminuojant jų dėl rasės, religijos, lyties, seksualinės orientacijos ar lyties tapatybės, amžiaus, negalios ar dėl kitų su darbo vykdymu tiesiogiai nesusijusių požymių.

description:

Elisan yritysmyynnissä sinua odottaa motivoiva ja innostava työyhteisö, säännölliset työajat ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva työsuhde. Pääset osaksi ratkaisumyynnin loistavaa tiimiä, tarjoamaan B2B-asiakkaille parhaimpia laite- ja palveluratkaisuita. Kyseessä on tavoitteellinen myyntityö, jossa omalla tekemisellä sinulla on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa työhösi. Ennen kaikkea tarjoamme työpaikan, jossa saat olla oma itsesi.

Yritysmyynnissä tulet tekemään monipuolista työtä alan ammattilaisten kanssa tiiviissä yhteistyössä. Pääset tehtävässä tutustumaan Elisan laajaan tuote- ja palvelutarjontaan ja sitä kautta auttamaan eri alojen yrityksiä liiketoiminnan kehittämisessä. Työtehtäviisi kuuluu PK-yritysten parissa tehtävä uusasiakashankinta sekä nykyisten asiakkaiden asiakassuhteiden hoito. Asiakkaat ovat kotimaisia yrityksiä, joten työtehtävässä pärjäämiseen vaaditaan sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Englannin osaaminen on eduksesi.

Arvostamme aikaisempaa kokemusta ja osaamista myyntityöstä, erityisesti operaattorialalta. Sinun ei kuitenkaan tarvitse olla vielä valmis yritysmyynnin ammattilainen, sillä koulutamme sinusta sellaisen! Tärkeintä on aito kiinnostus ja motivaatio asiakasta ja myyntityötä kohtaan sekä tavoitteellinen asenne ja halu onnistua.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Kattavan kehityspolun yritysmyynnin ammattilaiseksi sekä loistavat etenemismahdollisuudet. Työt alkavat palkallisella perehdytysjaksolla, jonka jälkeen työurasi jatkuu valmentavan esihenkilötyön tukemana. Huippumyyjillä on tie auki myös suurasiakasmyynnin pariin. Sinun mielenkiintosi kohteet ohjaavat uraasi.
- Mahtavan työilmapiirin ja avuliaat kollegat. Esihenkilösi lisäksi tiimin tuki ja apu on lähelläsi. Meillä viihdytään ja Elisa on useasti tullut valituksi Suomen parhaiden työpaikkojen joukkoon Great Place to Work -tutkimuksessa. Töitä tehdään moderneissa toimistotiloissa aivan Tampereen Ratinan kauppakeskuksen vieressä.
- Motivoivan palkkamallin sekä säännöllisen työrytmin. Takuupohjapalkan lisäksi pääset tienaamaan kannusteita, joita voi kertyä tuhansia euroja ja kokonaispalkkahaarukka liikkuu 2000-5000€/kk välillä. Työsuhde on voimassa toistaiseksi, ensimmäiset 6kk tarjoamme työtunteja 30 h /vko, tämän jälkeen 37,5 h /vko. Työt sijoittuvat arkipäiviin klo 8-16 välille, viikonloput ja pyhät ovat vapaita!

Hakijan tulee olla täysi-ikäinen ja tehtävään valitulle teetetään luottotietotarkistus sekä huumetestaus, joiden läpäiseminen on edellytys työsuhteen solmimiseen. Myös turvallisuusselvityksiä voidaan tulla teettämään työsuhteen aikana.

Seuraavat myyntiryhmämme aloittavat 18.8.2026 ja 1.9.2026, joten jos tämä on sinun paikkasi, laita meille hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuajalla.

HUOM!

Jätäthän hakemuksen hakulomakkeen kautta, sillä emme voi tietoturvasyistä huomioida sähköpostitse jätettyjä hakemuksia.

Tsekkaa täältä sopisitko Elisan tiimiin: https://elisa.fi/yhtiotieto/rekrytointi/blogi/tata-et-tiennyt-tyosta-puhelinmyyntitiimissa-jori-ja-mikael-elisan-yritysasiakkaat-yksikosta-kertovat-kolme-yllattavaa-faktaa/

title: Senior Product Owner (f/m/x)
