title: HHA (59527)
location: Woodland Pond Inc - New Paltz, NY 12561
description:
$7,500 Sign-On BONUS Exclusively for HHA/CNA/CNA II

ALL SHIFTS

Effective 8/1/2026 to 9/30/2026, we are offering a substantial $7,500* BONUS!

Candidates must have a start date on or before 9/30/2026.

*Bonus will be calculated based on the FTE at the time of payment. No bonus for Per Diem.

POSITION SUMMARY

The HHA is responsible to provide each of your assigned residents with routine daily nursing care and services in accordance with the residents individual service plan, and as may be directed by your supervisors. As a HHA you are delegated the administrative authority, responsibility, and accountability necessary for carrying out your designed duties

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (*CF indicates Critical Function)

Administrative Functions:

  • Documents all cares provided in EMR

  • Reports all changes in the residents condition to the LPN

  • Agrees not to disclose assigned user ID code and password for accessing resident/facility information and promptly report suspected or known violations of such disclosure to the Administrator

  • Agrees not to disclose residents protected health information and promptly report suspected or known violations of such disclosure

  • Reports any known or suspected unauthorized attempt to access facilitys information system

Personnel:

  • Performs all assigned tasks in accordance with our established policies and procedures, and as instructed by your supervisors (* CF)

  • Cooperated with inter-departmental personnel, as well as other facility personnel to ensure that nursing services can be adequately maintained to meet the needs of the residents (*CF)

  • Creates and maintains an atmosphere of warmth, personal interest and positive emphasis, as well as a calm environment throughout the unit and shift

  • Meets with nursing personnel, on a regularly scheduled basis, to assist in identifying and correcting problem areas, and/or the improvement of services

  • Reports all complaints and grievances made by the resident (*CF)

  • Reports occupational exposures to blood, body fluids, infectious materials, and hazardous chemicals to your supervisor

  • Reports known or suspected incidents of fraud to the Administrator/Corporate Compliance Officer

  • Ensures that departmental computer workstations left unattended are property logged off or the password protected automatic screen-saver activates within established facility policy guidelines

Personal Nursing Care Functions:

  • Participates in and receive the nursing report for duty (*CF)

  • Assists resident with all grooming tasks each shift, including but not limited to, oral/dental care, bathing, dressing, hair care, shaving, nail care

  • Assists resident with bowel and bladder functions and any incontinence care, ensuring residents are dry (*CF)

  • Assists in transporting residents to/from appointments, activity and social programs, etc., as necessary

  • Assists with lifting, turning, moving, positioning, and transporting residents into and out of beds, chairs, bathtubs, wheelchairs, etc. as per ISP, using proper body mechanics. (*CF)

  • Assists residents to walk with or without self-help devices as instructed

  • Weighs and measures residents as instructed (*CF)

  • Answers residents calls as promptly as feasible, ensuring that residents who are unable to call for help are checked frequently (*CF)

  • Assist with the care of a dying resident and provide post-mortem care as instructed (*CP)

  • Making and changing beds

Food Service Functions:

  • Prepares residents for meals (i,e., take to bathroom, wash hands, comb hair, raise beds, position tables, place clothing protectors or napkins, take to/from dining room, etc.) (*CF)

  • Serves food trays. Assists with feeding as indicated (i.e., cutting foods, feeding, assist in dining room supervision, etc.) (*CF)

  • Assists residents with identifying food arrangements (i.e., informing resident with sight problems of foods that are on his/her tray, where it is located, if it is hot/cold, etc.)

  • Assists with between meal and bedtime snacks (*CF) as requested

  • Performs after meal care (i.e., remove trays, clean residents hands, face, clothing, take to bathroom, brush teeth, clean dentures, etc.)

  • Checks rooms for food articles (i.e., food in proper container, unauthorized food items, etc.)

Staff Development:

  • Attends and participates in scheduled training and educational classes to maintain current certification as a Home Health Aide (*CF)

  • Attends and participates in scheduled orientation programs and activities

  • Attends and participates in facility in-service training programs as instructed

Safety and Sanitation:

  • Washes hands before and after performing any service for the resident

  • Keeps the nurses call system within easy reach of the resident (*CF)

  • Immediately notifies the LPN of any resident leaving/missing from the facility (*CF)

  • Follows established safety precautions in the performance of all duties

  • Reports any communicable or infectious disease to the Director of Nursing Services and/or to the Infection Control Coordinator

  • Follows established isolation precautions and procedures (*CF)

  • Wears and/or uses safety equipment and supplies (e.g., gait belt, mechanical lifts, etc.) when lifting or moving residents as per ISP

  • Reports missing/illegible labels and SDSs to your supervisor

Equipment and Supply Functions:

  • Uses only the equipment you have been trained to use in a safe manner

  • Reports defective equipment to the LPN

  • Informs the LPN of your equipment and supply needs

Resident Rights:

  • Maintains the confidentiality of all residents care information including protected health information. Report known or suspected incidents of unauthorized disclosure of such information (*CF)

  • Ensures that you treat all residents fairly, and with kindness, dignity, and respect, knocking before entering room, ensuring privacy for all care provided (*CF)

  • Reporting all allegations of resident abuse and/or misappropriation of resident property (*CF)

  • Honors the residents refusal of treatment request. Report such requests to your supervisor

Working Conditions:

  • Works throughout the nursing system area (i.e. nurses stations, resident rooms, etc.), intermittently moving due to frequent interruptions

  • Is involved with residents , personnel, visitors, government agencies/personnel, etc., under all conditions and circumstances

  • Is subject to hostile and emotionally upset residents, family members, personnel, and visitors

  • Works beyond normal working hours, on weekends and holidays, and in other positions temporarily, when necessary

  • Is subject to call back during emergency conditions (e.g., severe weather, evacuation, post-disaster, etc.)

  • Completes all required training and in-services

  • All other duties as assigned

title: Kassa/myyjä keikkatyöhön
description:
Etsimme pikaisella aikataululla asiakasyrityksellemme HalpaHalli Kalajoelle motivoitunutta ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä kassa/myyjää keikkatyöhön.

Tehtävät

Kaupan puolella tehtäviisi kuuluvat mm. kassatehtävät, asiakaspalvelu, kuorman purku ja tuotteiden esillepano sekä myymälän siisteydestä huolehtiminen ja tarvittaessa muiden tehtävien hoitamisessa avustaminen. Mikäli omaat myös sali- ja keittiöpuolen taitoja, voit tehdä vuoroja myös ravintolan puolella.

Odotamme

Odotamme sinulta aktiivista työskentelytapaa, reipasta ja iloista asennetta. Olet asiakaslähtöinen, huolellinen, joustava ja sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot.Aikaisempi kokemus kassatyöskentelystä katsotaan eduksi, mutta se ei ole välttämätöntä.

Tarjoamme

Työ on keikkaluonteista ja työajat tarkentuvat tarpeen mukaisesti. Saat mahdollisuuden työskennellä mukavassa tiimissä, jossa tuetaan toisia ja arvostetaan panostasi sekäkilpailukykyisen työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan osaamisen ja koulutuksen mukaan.

Kiinnostuitko?

Mahtavaa, nyt vain hakemusta tulemaan järjestelmämme kautta! Ole nopea, sillä paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

HalpaHalli Kalajoki

HalpaHalli on perinteikäs, vakavarainen ja täysin kotimainen perheyritys, joka on helpottanut suomalaisten arkea jo lähes 60-vuoden ajan. Kalajoen ydinkeskustassa, liikekeskus Merrassa sijaitseva moderni tavaratalo on vilkas ja monipuolinen ostos- ja kohtaamispaikka.Kalajoen HalpaHalli tarjoaa saman katon alla kattavan elintarvike- ja käyttötavaramyymälän sekä suositun HH-Keittiö -ravintolan, joka palvelee asiakkaita lounas- ja kahvilatuotteillaan. Tässä monipuolisessa työympäristössä työntekijät pääsevät hyödyntämään osaamistaan joustavasti yli osastorajojen. HalpaHalli tunnetaan vastuullisena ja luotettavana työnantajana, jossa työtä tehdään lämminhenkisessä ilmapiirissä, toisia tukien ja aitoa asiakaspalvelua arvostaen.

title: Senior Software Engineer, BackEnd
description:

Flutter Brazil is the platform that revolutionized the Brazilian sports betting market, creating a unique ecosystem with cutting-edge technology, strategic marketing, exclusive services, and many success stories. Our engineering teams build high-performance, scalable distributed systems that support mission-critical products used by millions.

As a Senior Backend Software Engineer, you will work with modern technologies in a fast-moving environment, developing robust, resilient, and highly scalable backend services that directly power our products and experiences. You will join a team that values technical excellence, strong engineering principles, and continuous improvement.

The ideal professional combines solid backend experience with a deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and modern software engineering practices. If you are motivated by big technical challenges, passionate about high-quality code, and looking to grow in a collaborative and innovative environment, this role is for you. 🚀

What you’ll do:

  • Implement and maintain complex, large-scale distributed applications, always aiming for performance, scalability, and continuous improvement.
  • Support code reviews, architectural decisions, and the evaluation of technologies that best solve our challenges.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across the organization.
  • Contribute to product quality and promote innovation within the engineering environment.
  • Create and maintain technical design documentation, runbooks, and other supporting materials to capture decisions and operational improvements.

What you’ll bring:

You will bring strong ownership, a collaborative mindset, and the desire to build reliable systems at scale. You enjoy working in a dynamic environment, solving complex problems, and contributing to the continuous evolution of our platform.

We require a candidate who has achieved or is capable of the following:

  • Experience with backend programming (e.g., Golang, C#).
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly and adapt to change.
  • Clear communication and strong collaborative teamwork.
  • Autonomy and proactivity in solving problems.
  • Experience developing distributed systems and messaging (e.g., Kafka, SQS, Kinesis).
  • Solid experience with SQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL), NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, Elasticsearch) and caching (e.g., Redis).
  • Knowledge of good software engineering practices, CI/CD, design patterns, and automated testing.

Differentials:

  • Experience with high-volume data and high-traffic platforms.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS) and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with observability and performance tools (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus).
  • Knowledge of containers and orchestration (Docker and/or Kubernetes).
  • Experience working with financial products and/or fintechs.

👉 It’s ok if you don’t think you tick every box on this list. We love people who want to challenge themselves and are passionate about what they do. If you believe you can contribute in some areas and are eager to learn, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits:

✨ Competitive compensation
💪 Access to TotalPass
🏝️ Paid time off
💻 Remote environment
📈 Growth and learning opportunities through the Flutter Edge global network
🎓 Annual individual learning & development allowance

title: BI konsulent
description:
Er du en nysgjerrig dataentusiast med en lidenskap for å omdanne data til innsikt? Hos Sopra Steria blir du en del av et inspirerende og inkluderende miljø – et av Norges råeste tech-miljøer – hvor vi kombinerer utfordrende prosjekter med en kultur preget av nysgjerrighet, læring og samarbeid. Vi tror at din evne til å omsette data til forretningsverdi vil bidra til å forme morgendagens beslutningsgrunnlag i et dynamisk team med høyt kvalifiserte kollegaer. Hos oss vil du bidra i varierte oppdrag på tvers av bransjer og sektorer, og være med på å utvikle dataplattformer i Databricks sammen med noen av Norges fremste fageksperter.

Ansvarsområder

  • Utvikling og design Du vil være med å designe og sette opp datadrevne løsninger som gir beslutningstakere de verktøyene de trenger. Vi bygger robuste dashboards og rapporter ved hjelp av verktøy som PowerBI, Qlik, Superset og Looker. Løsningen sikrer pålitelig datatilgang og gir verdifull innsikt for strategiske beslutninger.
  • Dataanalyse og rapportering Du prosesserer og modellerer data for å utvikle innsiktsfulle rapporter og visualiseringer. Dette innebærer å bygge solide datamodeller som støtter våre kunders forretningsstrategier og operasjonelle beslutninger.
  • Operasjonalisering av BI Du vil være med å implementere og drifte BI-løsningene våre. Dette innebærer bruk av Git for versjonskontroll og innføring av CI/CD-prosesser for å sikre en stabil og effektiv produksjonssetting av BI-verktøyene.
  • Samarbeid og kundekontakt Du jobber tett med både tekniske og forretningsorienterte kollegaer for å forstå og kartlegge kundebehov. Du deltar aktivt i utviklingen av løsninger sammen med kundene, og sikrer at verktøyene våre tilpasses deres unike krav. Gjennom jevnlig kommunikasjon bygger du sterke relasjoner og bidrar til at kundene får maksimalt utbytte av innsikten vi leverer.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Høyere utdanning innen IT, informatikk, økonomi eller beslektede fagområder.

description:

description:

title: Retail Floor Supervisor
description:
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE:

The Retail Floor Supervisor oversees the successful operation of the sales floor and oversees Retail Associates assigned to the Retail Floor. Retail Floor Supervisors are keyholders and can open and close the store as required by the needs of the business. Our culture assumes we can count on one another, engage with respect and professionalism, and continue our exceptional tradition of serving the public and our partners through teamwork and cooperation.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Operational Oversight-

  • Promotes CommunityAid’s sales and marketing strategies, including sales floor layout, merchandising, procurement stocking, product quality and rag out.

  • Assists the Assistant Store Manager Retail Floor in designing and implementing seasonal store layout changes.

  • Ensures the sales floor presentation, including recovery and signage, adheres to standards.

  • Ensures the proper functioning of the dressing rooms, including recovery of items to the sales floor.

  • Conducts daily floor walks, sharing insights with the Assistant Store Manager Retail Floor to ensure alignment.

  • Communicates retail supply needs and provides feedback on the quality of product sent to the sales floor.

  • Takes responsibility for the overall function of the store when the Store Manager, Assistant Store Manager Retail Floor, Assistant Store Manager Production Clothing, or the Assistant Store Manager Front End & Production Other is not present.

  • Customer Service-

  • Oversees interactions on the sales floor to ensure and promote a consistent positive shopping experience and to deter theft.

  • Handles customer complaints promptly and professionally.

  • Cash Handling-

  • Comprehends and adheres to cash handling and management procedures.

  • Supervises cash handling procedures, including counting cash drawers, reconciling transactions, making deposits, and conducting bank runs when serving as the Manager on Duty, while ensuring the security of the safe.

  • Staffing, Employee Training and Development-

  • Aids the Assistant Store Manager Retail Floor in overseeing staff for the Retail Floor (Retail Floor Trainer, and Retail Associates).

  • Conducts weekly or as needed one-on-one meetings with the Retail Floor Trainer and Associates.

  • Assists in the evaluation of potential candidates to ensure cultural alignment and position fit by conducting phone interviews and accompanying management in interviews as needed.

  • Supports the Assistant Store Manager Retail Floor with the integration of new staff by adhering to company procedures.

  • Assists the Retail Floor Trainer in training new Associates on their roles, responsibilities, company policies, procedures and best practices, including cross-training in other departments as needed.

  • Communicates performance expectations, coaching for improvement and success and utilizes existing performance management tools to document conversations.

  • Assists the Store Manager in the annual review process by sharing input on the employees’ performance.

  • Employee Engagement and Morale-

  • Promotes employee engagement through regular huddles and team meetings, one-on-one check-ins, special events, and prioritizing employee recognition.

  • Compliance and Regulatory Activities-

  • Ensures compliance with all applicable state and federal laws, as well as CommunityAid policies and procedures, and ensures these are clearly communicated and followed by Retail Floor staff.

  • Facilities and Logistics Safety –

  • Maintains a safe environment for both employees and customers.

  • Ensures cleanliness and organization on the sales floor.

  • Regularly monitors for safety, promptly addressing and taking measures to correct unsafe work conditions.

  • Additional Duties or Responsibilities –

  • Performs additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by a member of the Store Management Team.

  • Provides support to other departments as needed or as directed by a member of the Store Management Team.

  • Complies with all Company established policies and standards.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

  • Embrace, exemplify, endorse, and teach CommunityAid’s 12 Core Behaviors

  • Embrace and support CommunityAid’s Mission

  • Knowledge of retail operations and its integral relationship with warehouse operations

  • Effective leadership skills, including leading teams

  • Emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal relationship skills

  • Excellent communication abilities with an emphasis on clarity and listening

  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and exercises sound judgement

  • Maintains confidentiality

  • The ability to organize and prioritize a variety of tasks while working within strict timeframes

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

  • The ability to maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment

title: Supervisor of Advanced Practice Providers
description:
SUMMARY:

Reports to the Director, Cardiovascular Services. Under the direction of the Clinical Director of Cardiology, and the Attending Physician of Records, is responsible for the organization of clinical services including scheduling, in-service education, and evaluation of Advanced Practice Providers. Under the supervision of the Surgeon, provides pre- and post operative care of the surgery patients.

In addition, our leaders will demonstrate an aptitude for:

Ensure Accountability and Build Effective Teams
Drive Vision and Purpose and Optimize Work Processes

By applying core and leadership competencies, leaders help Brown University Health achieve its strategic goals.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Participates in the hiring of Advanced Practice Providers, including initial review of applications, selection of candidates, and participation in the interviewing and final selection process.

  • Develops schedules for the Advanced Practice Providers, maintaining clinical coverage, as required.

  • Develops and implements a program to certify Advanced Practice Providers in the performance of invasive procedures, i.e., central line placement, tracheal intubation, etc.

  • Develops and maintains an ongoing in-service education program for Advanced Practice Providers, including maintenance of ACLS certification.

  • Conducts annual performance evaluations of Advanced Practice Providers.

  • Serves as liaison for the Advanced Practice Providers with other hospital departments, i.e., Nursing Service, Laboratory, Admitting Department, etc.

  • Generates and maintains statistical information relating to the Surgery program.

  • Coordinates Advanced Practice Provider participation in the M& M and Quality Assurance Review Programs.

  • Acts as payroll coordinator for the Advanced Practice Providers.

  • Participates in the formulation of the annual budget and future budgetary planning as it relates to the Advanced Practice Provider group.

  • Performs other administrative functions within the Advanced Practice Provider area, as deemed appropriate, i.e., serving on appropriate committees.

  • Obtains and records detailed patient medical histories, performs and records complete and detailed physical examinations, records pertinent progress notes in the medical records, prepares discharge and follow-up plans, and initiates life-saving measures in emergency situations.

  • Generates initial patient orders for admission, pre- and postoperative care including diet, fluids, activity, tests, x-ray studies, and medications in collaboration with physician in accordance with hospital procedure. Assesses patient status and participates in the development of a patient care management plan with the nurses and attending physicians.

  • May perform other duties as requested by staff physicians or attending, including care of selected patients on both the medical and surgical services. Such duties and responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, surgical wound care, evaluation of patients in the emergency room, and performing other duties generally accepted as falling within the responsibilities of a house officer.

  • Maintains established hospital/department policies, procedures, objectives, quality assurance, safety, environmental and infection control.



BASIC KNOWLEDGE:


Must be a graduate of either a Nurse Practitioner or a Physician Assistant Program.
If a Nurse Practitioner, must have a Master’s Degree from an accredited Nurse Practitioner program.
Nurse Practitioner certification or certification eligible by the American Nurses Association (ANA) or by the American Academy of Nurse Practitioners (AANP).
Licensed in the State of Rhode Island as a Nurse Practitioner; license must include prescriptive privileges.
If a Physician Assistant, must be a graduate of a Physician Assistant Program with a B.S. degree.
Passing grade on certifying examination administered by the NCCPA.
Certified by the National Commission on the Certification of Physician Assistants
Basic Life Supportdvanced Cardiac Life Support certification required.
Functions with demonstrated knowledge and skills necessary to provide care to patients throughout the life span, with consideration of the aging processes, human development stage and cultural patterns in each step of the care process.

EXPERIENCE:


Three years’ experience in the care of care of cardiac patients preferred.
Prior supervisory experience desirable.


WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:


Healthcare environment such as acute care hospitals, physicians’ offices and ancillary healthcare enterprises.
Works with medical equipment and has direct patient contact.
Any potential hazards are minimized by adherence to established safety procedures and precautions including use safety equipment and protective clothing.

Provides direct supervision for up to 7 FTEs.

title: Member of Technical Staff, Coding Research
description:
Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Coding Research

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

We are seeking a Member of Technical Staff to help advance the evaluation and development of frontier coding agents. Sitting at the intersection of AI research, software engineering, and model evaluation, you will design the benchmarks, methodologies, and data systems that shape how next-generation coding models are measured and improved.

What You'll Do

  1. Design and own evaluation frameworks for coding agents, including benchmark specifications, scoring methodologies, rubrics, and quality standards.
  2. Lead end-to-end research initiatives focused on measuring and improving coding model performance across diverse software engineering tasks.
  3. Develop high-quality datasets, golden examples, and evaluation protocols that enable reliable assessment of frontier coding systems.
  4. Analyze model behavior and failure modes, identifying systematic weaknesses and translating findings into actionable improvements for training and evaluation.
  5. Build tooling and infrastructure that support large-scale experimentation, data generation, review workflows, and evaluation pipelines.
  6. Establish best practices for coding-agent assessment, ensuring methodological rigor, reproducibility, and measurement quality.
  7. Partner closely with researchers, engineers, and applied AI teams to design experiments and evaluate emerging model capabilities.
  8. Contribute to technical reports, benchmark studies, and client-facing research initiatives that communicate model performance and insights.

What We're Looking For

  1. Strong software engineering background with expertise in Python, C++, or comparable programming languages.
  2. 3+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning, AI research, evaluation, or related technical disciplines.
  3. Experience designing, reviewing, or validating technical assessments, benchmarks, coding tasks, or evaluation methodologies.
  4. Familiarity with large language models, coding agents, reinforcement learning, model evaluation, or related AI systems.
  5. Proven ability to build tooling, automate workflows, and improve technical processes through systematic experimentation.
  6. Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate model behavior and derive insights from complex technical systems.
  7. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly articulate technical findings to diverse audiences.
  8. Comfortable operating in fast-moving research environments with significant ambiguity and evolving priorities.

Preferred

  1. Experience working on frontier AI systems, coding agents, or model evaluation research.
  2. Deep interest in understanding how data, evaluations, and feedback mechanisms influence model capabilities.
  3. Track record of independently driving ambiguous technical or research projects from conception to execution.
  4. Experience designing benchmarks or datasets for machine learning systems at scale.
  5. Familiarity with agentic workflows, tool use, reinforcement learning, or post-training methodologies.
  6. Publications, open-source contributions, or demonstrated technical leadership in AI, machine learning, or software engineering.

Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $180,000 –$260,000 USD. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

title: Dispatcher
description:
Communications Specialist / Dispatcher

Job Summary

The Communications Specialist / Dispatcher at Anakeesta is responsible for coordinating and maintaining efficient communication between departments to ensure smooth daily operations across the park. This role involves monitoring radio channels, dispatching team members as needed, and responding promptly to operational, maintenance, and guest service requests. The Dispatcher serves as a central point of contact, ensuring timely resolution of issues while supporting safety protocols and enhancing the overall guest experience. Strong organizational skills, clear communication, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment are essential for success in this position. The Dispatcher is also responsible for coordination with all Emergency Services in the area for various emergencies.

  • Maintain a professional appearance and high standards of personal hygiene

Champion Home Builders - Weiser, Idaho

title: Coordinator, Studios
description:

IMG is a leading global sports marketing agency, specializing in media rights management and sales, multi-channel content production and distribution, brand partnerships, strategic consulting, digital services, and event management. It powers growth of revenues, fanbases and IP for more than 250 federations, associations, events, and teams, including the National Football League, English Premier League, International Olympic Committee, National Hockey League, Major League Soccer, ATP and WTA Tours, the AELTC (Wimbledon), Euroleague Basketball, CONMEBOL, World Rugby, DP World Tour, and The R&A, as well as UFC, WWE, and PBR.   • Coordinating and booking external support for RFP responses and sizzle reels as required.
  • Leading and managing the insight-gathering process for RFP responses, coordinating internal stakeholders and external research to collate client data, market intelligence and financial insights to maximise the competitiveness of submissions.
  • Providing administrative support, including drafting correspondence, agendas and meeting minutes, organising hospitality, and supporting projects and events delivered or hosted by the SVPs or Commercial Team.
  • Carrying out any other duties within the scope and purpose of the role.

Unusual Challenges or Circumstances

  • May require occasional late starts, late finishes, evening and weekend working where required, although the role is primarily weekday office-based.

Key Result Areas-

  • Excellent logistical coordination and support.
  • Ensuring all databases are regularly updated and maintained accurately.

Knowledge and Experience

  • Database and Excel management.
  • Calendar and schedule management.
  • Experience working with external partners, suppliers and clients.
  • Ideally, previous experience in a production environment.
  • Previous experience at Assistant or Coordinator level.
  • Knowledge of and interest in the sports industry, with a desire to learn about future production trends.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work to and meet deadlines.
  • Strong team player.

Som lärare i fritidshem har du en viktig roll i att stötta elevernas sociala utveckling och skapa en miljö som präglas av glädje, trygghet och respekt. Du ansvarar för att planera och genomföra pedagogiska aktiviteter både utomhus och inomhus, och du arbetar tematiskt med allt från skapande och rörelse till värdegrundsarbete och miljömedvetenhet. Du samarbetar nära skolans övriga lärare och bidrar till en röd tråd mellan skola och fritid. Arbetet sker både under skoltid och på fritidstid, före och efter skoldagen samt under loven.

Vidare ser vi att du har en ambition att utveckla fritidsverksamheten genom att höja undervisningens kvalitet, stärka elevernas lärande samt stödja och utveckla dina kollegor.

Om skola

Kvibergsskolan F-9 är skolan som ger eleverna en god möjlighet att kunna verka i och påverka sin

framtid. Det innebär att skolan är en del av ett digitaliserat samhälle med en allt snabbare

utvecklingstakt. Kvibergsskolan är en certifierad Apple distinguished school vilket innebär att våra lärare är Apple Teachers och vi arbetar med och i Apples olika miljöer.

Vi har två skolhus; Kvibergsskolan F-3 och Kvibergsskolan 4-9. Skolans lärmiljöer är designade för ett flexibelt och digitalt lärande. Vi finns i Kvibergs Park med många spännande utomhusmiljöer runt knuten.

Vi arbetar aktivt med vår vision #Hållbarttillsammans och en kultur som tar ansvar för vår miljö och varandra; "Vi vill varandra väl och gör varandra bra". Skolans personal är indelade i 7 arbetslag. Det som utmärker våra arbetslag är att deras uppdrag är att arbeta som ett team med en delakultur och ett gemensamt ansvar för alla skolans elever.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad lärare i fritidshem. Det är meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenheter av utvecklingsarbete i fritidsverksamhet samt behörighet att undervisa i annat ämne.

Som person tar du ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och gruppens arbetsuppgifter. Du tänker på de vi är till för och deras bästa. Du gör ditt bästa för att göra klart alla arbetsuppgifter på rätt sätt och följer upp hur det blev. Du har god förståelse för hur individer tar till sig kunskap och deras olika förutsättningar. Du anpassar sättet att förmedla ditt budskap till mottagaren och uppmuntrar till dialog, delaktighet och engagemang. Vi ser även att du är driven och utvecklingsorienterad.

Vidare arbetar du bra med andra genom att du lyssnar, visar intresse och respekt. Du förstår det gemensamma uppdraget och arbetar för att det ska bli så bra som möjligt.

Stämmer ovan beskrivning in på dig? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Tjänsten tillsätts under förbehåll att den inte tas i anspråk av interna skäl.

Övrigt

Som anställd i vår förvaltning erbjuds du bland annat friskvårdsbidrag, cykelförmån och medarbetarstöd.

Enligt Skollagen ska utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister uppvisas av personer innan de anställs inom förskoleverksamhet, skola och skolbarnomsorg. Detta beställer du på Polisens hemsida.

Inför denna rekrytering har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och därför undanber vi oss

ytterligare erbjudanden om kompetensförmedling, annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.

Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem i enlighet med GDPR.

Om oss

Vi skapar framtiden i Göteborg – en lektion i taget

Varje vardag möts tusentals barn och unga i våra skolor – med dem formar vi framtidens Göteborg. I grundskoleförvaltningen är vi 10 000 engagerade medarbetare som jobbar tillsammans för att alla elever ska få lyckas och växa, oavsett bakgrund eller förutsättningar. Du har en viktig roll i att skapa en likvärdig skola med hög kvalitet, där du både får utvecklas och utveckla verksamheten. Du bygger kunskap, gemenskap och framtidstro tillsammans med dina kollegor. Hos oss får du vara med och göra skillnad – på riktigt.

Göteborgs grundskoleförvaltning ansvarar för stadens närmare 140 kommunala skolor, från förskoleklass till årskurs 9, anpassad grundskola, fritidshem och kulturskola. Välkommen att arbeta nära skogen, staden eller havet. Vi är Göteborg.

title: Projektový Manažer - stavební management
description:
Do našeho týmu Projektového managementu aktuálně hledáme nového kolegu / kolegyni na pozici Projektového Manažera. Máš technické vzdělání a zkušenosti z praxe? Jsi náš člověk, pokud už máš praktické zkušenosti s vedením projektů či ze stavby v oboru pozemního stavitelství, které uplatníš při jednání s klienty, dodavateli a orgány státní správy. U nás budeš mít prostor řídit celý investiční záměr od počáteční studie až do předání dokončené stavby. V Turner & Townsend se zabýváme vedením projektů výstavby a rekonstrukcí kanceláří, výrobních a logistických hal a obchodních jednotek. Přidej se k nám!

Co bude náplní tvé práce?

  • Budeš zastupovat klienta během celého procesu projektu a vše důležité s ním komunikovat

  • Postaráš se o kontrolu jednotlivých stupňů projektové dokumentace a hledání vhodných technických a stavebně-architektonických řešení
  • Budeš zodpovídat za přípravu, organizaci a vyhodnocování výběrových řízení

  • Výtečně ovládáš aplikace MS Office a uživatelsky ovládáš AutoCAD
  • Nebojíš se komunikovat, rozhodovat a nezalekneš se problému
  • Organizovanost a systematičnost pro tebe nejsou cizí pojmy
  • Jsi pozitivní a rád/a pracuješ jak samostatně, tak i v týmu
  • Hodí se, pokud máš řidičský průkaz sk. B a aktivně jezdíš

Co nabízíme?

  • Zajímavou finanční odměnu
  • Práci v úspěšné mezinárodní společnosti
  • Vedení zajímavých projektů pro nadnárodní firmy
  • Plný úvazek s flexibilní pracovní dobou a možností home office - záleží nám na dodržení termínů a kvalitě výsledku, ne na tom, jestli jsi v kanceláři od 9 do 17
  • Skvěle fungující a soudržný tým, který tě vždycky podpoří a ocení tvoje úspěchy
  • Zázemí moderních kanceláří v centru Prahy včetně všech výhod s tím spojených
  • Celofiremní akce a k tomu ještě navíc 3x do roka sportovně laděné nezapomenutelné teambuildingy
  • Standardem je pět týdnů dovolené, příspěvek na stravování formou stravenkového paušálu (100 Kč /den), 2 dny zdravotního volna, narozeninové volno, volno na dobročinné účely, příspěvek na penzijní připojištění, Multisport karta, jazykové kurzy, finanční odměna za doporučení kolegy, neomezené množství výborné kávy, notebook, mobilní telefon a v neposlední řadě u nás podporujeme kariérní růst - nabízíme pestrý školící program, který je k dispozici všem

Naši zaměstnanci sdílejí naši vizi a poslání. Nabízíme inspirativní pracovní prostředí, kde má každý příležitost přispět svými nápady a ovlivňovat pozitivní změny.

Chceme, aby naši zaměstnanci byli úspěšní nejen v práci, ale i v osobním životě. Proto podporujeme zdravé, produktivní a flexibilní pracovní prostředí, které respektuje rovnováhu mezi pracovním a soukromým životem.

title: Director of Robotics Research
description:
Job Title: Director of Robotics Research

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role:

As Director of Robotics Research, you'll lead our Robotics Research team in developing the data foundations behind robot learning. You'll define how robotics data is collected, represented, evaluated, and scaled—helping build a Robotics Data Engine that enables increasingly capable robotic systems.

Working alongside AI researchers and engineers, you'll drive research at the intersection of robotics, perception, learning, and large-scale data. You'll also build and mentor a team of exceptional Robotics Researchers, setting the technical vision while remaining deeply involved in research and experimentation.

What You'll Do

  1. Define and execute the research strategy for robotics data, embodied AI, and robot learning.
  2. Lead research initiatives focused on robotics datasets, multimodal representations, perception, manipulation, and data-centric learning.
  3. Build, mentor, and grow a team of Robotics Researchers while fostering a culture of scientific rigor, curiosity, and rapid experimentation.
  4. Develop novel approaches for collecting robotics data through teleoperation, human demonstrations, simulation, autonomous exploration, and real-world deployments.
  5. Design scalable robotics data pipelines by defining collection workflows, task taxonomies, annotation schemas, quality control processes, evaluation methodologies, and final data delivery formats.
  6. Translate research and client objectives into scalable data pipeline specifications, defining data requirements, collection strategies, labeling standards, and success metrics.
  7. Partner with research, engineering, product, and operations teams to operationalize pipeline designs and deliver production-ready robotics data solutions.
  8. Establish scalable benchmarks and evaluation frameworks to measure and improve robot learning performance.
  9. Stay at the forefront of robotics research by evaluating emerging literature, datasets, and techniques from leading academic labs and industry.
  10. Drive technical excellence through clear documentation, knowledge sharing, and effective cross-functional communication.

What We're Looking For

  1. Significant experience in robotics research, embodied AI, robot learning, or robotics software engineering.
  2. Experience leading or mentoring high-performing technical or research teams.
  3. Deep understanding of robotics data pipelines, multimodal datasets, and data infrastructure for robot learning.
  4. Strong expertise in robot perception, manipulation, control, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or foundation models for robotics.
  5. Experience designing and evaluating large-scale robotics datasets and data collection strategies.
  6. Ability to bridge research and engineering, translating cutting-edge ideas into scalable systems.
  7. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience collaborating across multidisciplinary teams.
  8. Passion for advancing embodied intelligence through innovative research and data-driven approaches.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Master's or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  2. Publications at leading conferences such as CoRL, RSS, ICRA, IROS, NeurIPS, ICML, or CVPR.
  3. Experience building large-scale robotics datasets, data engines, or research infrastructure.
  4. Hands-on experience with robotics frameworks and simulation environments such as ROS, ROS2, Isaac Lab, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Habitat, or ManiSkill.
  5. Contributions to open-source robotics projects or significant research impacting embodied AI.

Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $250,000 –$350,000. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

micro1 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, reach out to .

Our hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

title: Speech Language Pathology Assistant
description:
Speech-Language Pathology Assistant (SLPA)

Fall River, MA | School-Based | Full Benefits | Mission-Driven Team

Boothby Therapy Services

At Boothby Therapy Services, we believe every child deserves the opportunity to communicate, connect, and thrive. Our mission is to empower students through compassionate, high-quality therapy services while building meaningful partnerships with schools, families, and communities.

We are seeking a passionate and student-centered Speech-Language Pathology Assistant (SLPA) to join our growing team serving students in Fall River, Massachusetts. This onsite, district-wide position offers the opportunity to work directly with students across multiple schools and educational settings, helping them develop the communication skills they need to succeed academically, socially, and emotionally.

If you are looking for more than just a job - if you want purpose, support, professional growth, and the chance to truly make an impact - we'd love to meet you!

Why Join Boothby Therapy Services?

At Boothby, our vision is to create supportive learning environments where every student has access to the communication tools they need to succeed.

When you join Boothby Therapy Services, you become part of a collaborative, mission-driven culture where your work truly matters.

As a Speech-Language Pathology Assistant (SLPA), you will provide direct speech and language support services to students under the supervision of a licensed Speech-Language Pathologist.

You'll help students strengthen communication skills that support learning, confidence, independence, and participation in the classroom and beyond.

This is an onsite, school-based role with strong mentorship, leadership support, and opportunities for professional development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide direct speech-language therapy services to students across district schools
  • Implement treatment plans and IEP goals developed by supervising SLPs
  • Support students with articulation, language, fluency, voice, and communication challenges
  • Document student progress and maintain accurate records
  • Collaborate with teachers, school staff, therapists, and families
  • Assist in creating positive, engaging learning environments
  • Support student participation in academic and social settings
  • Follow state, district, and professional compliance guidelines

Qualifications

Required:

  • Associate's degree or higher from an accredited SLPA program
  • Current SLPA license or eligibility for licensure in Massachusetts
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively within school teams
  • Passion for helping children succeed

Preferred:

  • Previous school-based or pediatric experience
  • Experience supporting students with diverse communication needs

Compensation & Benefits

We believe supporting our employees allows them to provide the best support to students.

We Offer:

  • Competitive hourly pay: $30–$40/hour
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off (PTO)
  • Continuing education funds
  • License reimbursement
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Ongoing mentorship and leadership support
  • Professional growth and advancement opportunities
  • Positive, collaborative company culture

What Makes Boothby Different?

At Boothby Therapy Services, you're never "just another provider." We prioritize connection, mentorship, responsiveness, and support so our clinicians feel valued and empowered.

You'll work alongside a dedicated Service Delivery Manager and a team that genuinely cares about your success, professionally and personally.

Apply Today

If you're a compassionate SLPA who wants to make a meaningful difference in students' lives while growing your career in a supportive environment, we encourage you to apply today.

Join Boothby Therapy Services and help students find their voice, confidence, and potential.

title: Math, Physics & Engineering Graduates
description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.


To help fuel that growth, we’re looking for Data Scientists to join our Pricing & Underwriting Department, the strategic engine behind Prima's growth.

As part of this global team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and strengthening our competitive edge. Using data, analytical thinking, machine learning and business acumen, you’ll help predict the future and set the right prices, keeping our offering both attractive and sustainable. You’ll work with your data science tools and skills to bring real-world impact, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action and fuel innovation across the company and its different branches.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details.


What you’ll do

  • Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making;

  • Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers;

  • Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights.


What we’re looking for

  • Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics;

  • Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems;

  • Fluency in English, both spoken and written.


Nice-to-Have

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas;

  • Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python;

  • Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets.

Please note: this is the same position as the one referred as “Data Scientist” on our career site, posted with different job titles to reach STEM students and graduates who might not know a Data Scientist role suits them.

Why you'll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵 Competitive compensation: Benefit from competitive salaries, starting from £80k up to £160k, with clear opportunities to grow as you do.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.


🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

title: Pharmacy Experience Lead
description:
What is the job?

Every prescription represents a patient waiting for treatment - and the Pharmacy Experience Lead ensures their journey is as safe, simple and seamless as possible.

You’ll lead the day-to-day operations of our Pharmacy Support function, building a high-performing team that delivers timely, compassionate and consistently exceptional support. Using data, patient insight and hands-on coaching, you’ll raise performance, remove friction and continuously improve how we communicate with patients throughout their prescription journey.

Working across Pharmacy, Clinical, Technology and Patient Experience, you’ll turn recurring challenges into practical improvements that make a genuine difference. This is an opportunity to shape a critical part of the patient experience while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality and regulatory compliance.

What will you be doing?

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop the Pharmacy Support team, creating a high-performing, patient-focused culture.

  • Manage day-to-day operations, ensuring appropriate resource planning and workload management.

  • Recruit, onboard and develop new team members through regular coaching, performance reviews and career development.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Patient Experience

  • Ensure patients receive a seamless, professional and compassionate experience throughout the prescription journey.

  • Oversee the timely handling of pharmacy enquiries, prescription rewrites, delivery queries, stock issues and patient escalations.

  • Drive improvements to patient communication, reducing avoidable contacts and improving satisfaction.

  • Monitor customer feedback and complaints, identifying trends and implementing improvements.

Operational Excellence

  • Monitor KPIs including response times, quality, productivity, backlog management and patient satisfaction.

  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements to increase efficiency.

  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives across pharmacy operations.

  • Ensure robust processes, SOPs and quality standards are consistently followed.

  • Work closely with the wider Operations team to improve workflows across the patient journey.

Quality & Governance

  • Conduct regular quality audits including ticket reviews, call monitoring and process compliance.

  • Support investigations into complaints, incidents and significant events, implementing preventative actions where required.

  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements, company policies and governance frameworks.

  • Identify training needs and implement development plans to improve quality and consistency.

What do you need?

Essential

  • Experience leading high-volume customer service or operational support teams.

  • Strong leadership skills with experience coaching and developing people.

  • Proven experience managing KPIs and driving operational performance.

  • Experience implementing process improvements and managing change.

  • Excellent communication skills.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience using operational data to drive decisions.

  • Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable

  • Experience within healthcare, pharmacy or another regulated industry.

  • Experience using Zendesk or similar CRM platforms.

  • Knowledge of pharmacy operations or prescription management.

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams including technology and product.

What we offer:

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + usual bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

title: Middle Tech Support / Junior DevOps specialist
description:

Nice to have

  • Basic knowledge of Python

  • Understanding of CDN technologies

  • Broad understanding of modern IT infrastructure and operations practices

  • Experience with additional automation and monitoring tools

  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt to changing project requirements

What We Offer:

  • Vacation days: Up to 26 business days per year.

  • 10 illness/special days off per year (fully paid, no medical papers needed) for all contract types

  • Health and life insurance (Luxmed)

  • MyBenefit platform with Multisport option

  • Internal psychological support service

  • English language classes from the first working day

  • Access to external learning platforms: O’Reilly, LinkedIn Learning, Udemy, and a wide catalog of diverse internal training

  • Flexible workplace: work from the office, from home, or choose a hybrid option

title: Logistics Lead - Programme Integration (Logistics)
description:
Our Programme Advisory team specialises in the strategy, set-up and transformation of major programmes and asset owning enterprises within the transport, defence, utilities, and power sectors in the UK and internationally.

Since forming in 2018 our growing team of experts have brought innovative thinking to some of the world’s most complex infrastructure challenges - delivering tangible outcomes for clients by bringing the best of our technical excellence and transformational change capability.

We are an influential team who share a common passion for making change a reality, continually setting new standards. As a diverse and inclusive team of unique individuals, we inspire one another to do better every day. Our collaborative culture also ensures that everyone’s potential is maximised, constantly learning through experience and close team relationships.

Joining the Programme Advisory team will afford you exciting opportunities to directly support world renowned clients, enhance your consulting skills, shape your career, and directly contribute to the teams exciting growth trajectory.

The Opportunity

We are looking for enthusiastic, talented, and proactive individuals to join our Programme Integration team to deliver a major nuclear new build programme. A robust, integrated and future-ready logistics approach is required. The logistics function must build upon proven industry practices and existing operational experience to ensure that the right resources are delivered to the right location at the right time, maximising project productivity, safety and efficiency.

Support is required to:

  • Understand the proposed approach for delivering the new power station, including procurement routes, contractor strategies and delivery models, and identify how logistics can enable programme success.
  • Develop a comprehensive logistics strategy that supports safe and efficient delivery operations while enhancing resilience, sustainability and productivity.
  • Define detailed logistics requirements needed to support future operations, organisational structures and delivery plans, ensuring alignment with broader programme objectives.
  • Provide technical leadership and logistics expertise throughout project development and delivery.

Role Purpose

The Logistics Lead will be responsible for developing, integrating and championing logistics across a major Canadian nuclear new build project.

The role will ensure that logistics considerations are embedded within engineering, design, programme, procurement and construction planning activities from the earliest stages of project development. Working across a complex stakeholder environment, the Logistics Lead will establish the logistics vision, delivery principles and implementation roadmap required to support the safe, efficient and timely delivery of a nationally significant infrastructure programme.

The successful candidate will provide strategic leadership across all aspects of construction logistics, including material flows, workforce logistics, heavy transport, marine and rail logistics, offsite manufacturing integration, laydown requirements and supply chain optimisation.

Key Responsibilities

Logistics Strategy & Planning

  • Develop the programme-wide logistics strategy and delivery roadmap.
  • Define logistics requirements, constraints, risks and opportunities.
  • Develop logistics solutions covering material flows, workforce logistics, logistics systems, transport and storage.
  • Establish site logistics, consolidation, compound and delivery management requirements.
  • Define system requirements to provide end-to-end visibility of logistics activities
  • Develop Construction Logistics Plans (CLPs) and traffic management approaches.

Design & Programme Integration

  • Ensure logistics requirements are embedded within design, engineering and programme development.
  • Review designs from a buildability and deliverability perspective.
  • Support construction sequencing, phasing and site establishment planning.
  • Promote DfMA, modularisation and offsite manufacturing opportunities.
  • Assess heavy lift, abnormal load and specialist transport requirements.

Supply Chain & Delivery

  • Work with procurement and delivery teams to develop integrated supply chain logistics solutions.
  • Define material flow strategies from supplier to site.
  • Assess road, rail, marine and port logistics opportunities.
  • Evaluate storage, consolidation and laydown requirements.
  • Support selection of logistics providers and delivery solutions.

Risk & Stakeholder Management

  • Identify and mitigate logistics, programme and supply chain risks.
  • Engage with regulators, authorities and key stakeholders.
  • Support planning, environmental and permitting activities.
  • Provide logistics advice to programme leadership and project teams.

Leadership

  • Act as the programme logistics subject matter expert.
  • Lead logistics consultants and specialist advisers.
  • Establish governance, reporting and assurance processes.
  • Support capability development within the team.
  • Proven logistics leadership experience on major infrastructure, energy, nuclear or industrial projects.
  • Experience developing logistics strategies for complex construction programmes.
  • Strong understanding of construction planning, sequencing and site operations.
  • Experience integrating logistics into design and programme development.
  • Knowledge of DfMA, modular construction and offsite manufacturing.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams.
  • Nuclear new build experience. (desirable)
  • Understanding of nuclear regulatory environments. (desirable)
  • Experience of rail, marine, heavy lift or oversized load logistics. (desirable)
  • Experience working in highly regulated environments. (desirable)

Personal Attributes

  • Strategic and systems-thinking mindset.
  • Collaborative and solutions focused.
  • Strong commercial and delivery awareness.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Committed to safety, quality and operational excellence.

Success Measures

  • Logistics integrated into key programme and design decisions.
  • Clear logistics requirements established for future delivery phases.
  • Risks and constraints identified and mitigated early.
  • Opportunities for offsite manufacture, modularisation and productivity improvements realised.
  • Delivery of a practical, resilient and future-ready logistics strategy that supports programme objectives.

This is an in-office position Monday - Friday and is located at 3001 Watson Boulevard, Warner Robins, GA.

Responsible for the general servicing and support of the Financial Advisors. This includes administrative and operational support, business development assistance, and providing a consistent and effective level of client servicing when the Financial Advisor is unavailable.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.

1. Assist Financial Advisors in servicing clients including preparing financial plans, conducting investment research and completing client trades and transactions.

2. Receive and place orders as directed from Financial Advisor and assigned clients. Reply to queries regarding general market information such as quotes and news, as well as trading and order features such as GTC expiration dates and settlement.

3. Process corporate actions where a license is warranted, such as tender offers, optional dividends and the exercise of warrants and rights.

4. Schedule and confirm client appointments, enter data in SalesForce, create meeting agendas and summaries, prepare/coordinate marking events and perform general administrative functions such as answer and return calls, manage the expense report process, prepare routine client correspondence and perform maintenance of client records.

5. Manage the financial advisor's calendar to maximize the appointments' productivity by minimizing travel time and anticipating the time frame required for presentation and answering of questions.

6. Maximize sales opportunities by contacting potential investment clients based on internal and bank leads. Use product and industry knowledge to identify existing client, account, and product attributes that present sales potential.

7. Provide operational guidance to Financial Advisors ranging from systems navigation to document fulfillment.

8. Ensure new business paperwork is accurately successfully submitted. This includes preparing forms to be presented to clients, obtaining appropriate signatures, submission and follow-up of new account documentation.

9. Mitigate risk through appropriate authentication standards. This includes the authentication of incoming and outgoing client calls. Required to perform authentication callbacks for high risk transactions, such as third party distributions, profile changes and wires.

10. Maintain a professional environment and create a positive impression.

11. Submit and process certain operational requests as instructed by the Financial Advisor and/or client. These may include: funds distributions, deposits of checks, journals, client and account updates, ACAT initiation and other operational tasks.

12. Work in coordination with the Financial Advisor to ensure certain reports are reviewed and addressed, such as insufficient funds for periodic distributions and RMDs not met.

13. May assist with physical branch location needs, such as opening, closing, general requests for maintenance or service.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required Qualifications:

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and related training.

2. Experience in the securities industry and/or a sales assistant role.

3. Knowledge of securities markets and brokerage accounts.

4. Knowledge of the features and attributes of annuity products.

5. FINRA SIE, Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) Series 7 and Series 66 (or 63 & 65 in lieu of the 66) licenses. Candidates will be considered if they are partially licensed and can obtain the additional licenses during employment within 365 days.

6. Exceptional telephone skills and the ability to appropriately interact with clients of all experience levels regarding securities transactions and brokerage accounts.

7. Effective time management skills.

8. Ability to communicate effectively and professionally with clients, managers and other teammates.

9. Ability to evaluate, assimilate and utilize detailed and complex written and verbal technical information.

10. Ability to work in a self-directed fashion.

11. Demonstrated proficiency in basic computer applications, such as Microsoft Office software products.

Preferred Qualifications:

1. Three years of experience in the securities industry.

2. Previous sales and/or banking experience.

3. Bachelor's degree in business, accounting, finance, banking or equivalent education and related training.

4. Demonstrated experience in a call center or brokerage office environment, preferably focusing on outbound sales calls.

title: Partner Cordinator (BG & BGLA)
description:
Job Description:

Partner Coordinator BG & BGLA

All Bupa UK Locations

Permanent

Full Time

Hybrid – 2 days a week in the office.

35 hours

Salary - starting from £32,400

We make health happen

At Bupa, our purpose is helping people live longer, healthier, happier lives and making a better world. As a healthcare and insurance provider with no shareholders, we reinvest our profits into improving health and care for our customers and communities.

As a Partner Coordinator, you'll play an important role in helping us deliver high-quality healthcare services to customers around the world. Working across Bupa Global and Bupa Global Latin America, you'll support relationships with our service partners who help manage healthcare networks, claims and customer care services. Your work will help improve operational performance, deliver cost-effective healthcare solutions and make sure customers continue to receive the support they need when they need it most.

This is a great opportunity to join an international team, build strong relationships with partners across different regions and contribute to meaningful improvements that support both our customers and our business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support relationships with a portfolio of service partners and healthcare providers.

  • Help monitor partner performance through reporting, quality reviews and operational audits.

  • Coordinate and follow up on queries, helping to resolve issues quickly and effectively.

  • Build strong working relationships with internal teams, service partners, providers and brokers.

  • Organise and support regular operational meetings covering treatment approvals, complex cases and claims administration.

  • Identify and support improvements that make processes simpler and more efficient.

  • Help deliver measurable savings through effective partner management and operational oversight.

  • Support compliance with regulatory requirements and help deliver fair outcomes for customers.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is organised, proactive and enjoys working collaboratively with a range of stakeholders.

You'll have:

  • A Level qualification, NVQ Level 3 in Management, or an equivalent qualification.

  • Experience within international health insurance, healthcare operations, provider management, sales support or a similar environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

  • Good analytical and numerical skills.

  • The ability to review information, identify trends and make recommendations.

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

  • Experience resolving customer or business queries.

  • The ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Confidence influencing and working with others, even where there is no direct reporting relationship.

  • An understanding of regulatory requirements and customer-focused outcomes.

It would also be helpful if you have:

  • Fluency in Spanish.

  • Experience working in an international or multicultural environment.

Why Bupa?

Bupa Global is the international health insurance division of Bupa. We provide customers who want premium international coverage with products and services to access the healthcare they need anytime, around the world, whether at home or when studying, living, travelling or working abroad.

Bupa Global has offices around the world including London and Brighton (UK), Dublin (Europe), Miami (USA), Dubai (UAE, in partnership with OIC), Egypt and Hong Kong (China) as well as regional offices in mainland China, Singapore, the Dominican Republic, Bolivia, Panama, Guatemala and Ecuador.

Time Type:

Full time

About Waythrough

Waythrough was formed in 2024 following the merger of Humankind and Richmond Fellowship. Together, we’ve created one of the largest mental health and social support charities in England.

Every year, we support around 125,000 people through nearly 200 services – and it’s all made possible by our 3,500 brilliant staff and volunteers.

Make a real difference in your community

Are you passionate about helping others live safer, healthier, more independent lives? Join our team at Waythrough and support people facing challenges around mental health, substance use, housing or domestic abuse. This is more than just a job – it’s a chance to build meaningful relationships and create lasting change.

About the Role

We are looking for a compassionate and motivated Healthcare Assistant to support the delivery of high-quality care to individuals accessing our service. Working as part of a multidisciplinary clinical team, you will help deliver healthcare interventions, promote physical wellbeing, and provide practical support to people affected by substance misuse and associated health needs.

This is a varied role involving direct patient care, health assessments, harm reduction interventions, outreach work, and supporting service users throughout their treatment and recovery journey.

Key Duties

  • Support clinicians in delivering healthcare assessments and interventions.
  • Carry out delegated clinical procedures following appropriate training and competency assessment.
  • Support service users with their physical health needs and overall wellbeing.
  • Deliver harm reduction advice, including overdose prevention and health promotion.
  • Assist with alcohol assessments and community detoxification programmes.
  • Undertake health monitoring activities and record outcomes accurately.
  • Maintain accurate, confidential, and timely clinical records.
  • Ensure clinical environments are safe, clean, and compliant with infection control standards.
  • Provide information, advice, and signposting to appropriate health and community services.
  • Participate in service improvement activities, audits, and ongoing professional development.

About You

You will be a caring and professional individual with a genuine passion for helping people improve their health and wellbeing.

You will have:

  • NVQ Level 2 in Health and Social Care (or equivalent).
  • Good literacy, numeracy, and IT skills.
  • Experience working in a health, care, or support environment.
  • An understanding of confidentiality, safeguarding, and professional boundaries.
  • Knowledge of infection prevention and control practices.
  • The ability to work both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • A non-judgemental approach when working with vulnerable people.
  • An awareness of the challenges faced by individuals affected by drug and alcohol use, mental health, or social exclusion.

Most importantly, you will be committed to treating people with kindness, respect, and dignity while delivering excellent person-centred care.

Na bank nie rzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań.

title: Vikariesamordnare Vimarskolan F-6
description:
Vimmerby är den lilla kommunen i Småland som har mycket att erbjuda; förutom det gedigna kulturarvet från Astrid Lindgren kännetecknas kommunen också av ett mångsidigt näringsliv, stort lokalt engagemang, aktivt föreningsliv, vacker natur och rogivande miljö. 

Genom våra värdeord; Ansvar, mod och fantasi arbetar vi för att ge bästa tänkbara service och omsorg till Vimmerby kommuns ca 15 800 invånare, företag och för alla som besöker kommunen. Dessa värdeord genomsyrar kommunens förhållnings- samt arbetssätt och är något alla bär med sig i det dagliga arbetet.

Barn- och utbildningsförvaltningen i Vimmerby kommun ansvarar för alla pedagogiska verksamheter, från förskola till högskola, och ansvarar även för svenska för invandrare (sfi) och samhällsorientering för nyanlända. Vårt gemensamma mål är att Vimmerby kommuns barn och ungdomar ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att möta framtiden och utvecklas till kreativa, nyfikna och trygga individer.



1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som vikariesamordnare hos oss har du en central roll i att skapa en trygg och stabil vardag för både elever och kollegor. Du har en central roll med operativt samarbete där du koordinerar och tillsätter vikariebehov, för att säkerställa att undervisningen sker enligt plan. Under skoldagen arbetar du nära verksamheten genom att själv kliva in som vikarie i olika årskurser och ämnen. I det pedagogiska arbetet ansvarar du för att tillsammans med kollegor planera, genomföra och följa upp undervisningen så att varje elev ges de bästa förutsättningarna för att lyckas.

Utöver det direkta arbetet i klassrummet ansvarar du för den långsiktiga resursplaneringen. Det innebär att du planerar kommande vikariat samt rekryterar, väljer ut och introducerar nya vikarier till vår skola. I tjänsten ingår även ett visst ansvar för hanteringen av elevernas digitala enheter, vilket gör att vi söker dig med goda IT-kunskaper. Du fungerar som en viktig länk mellan elever, föräldrar och personal, och vi ser att du är en person som drivs av att skapa goda relationer och en trygg arbetsmiljö för alla.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Du som söker har lärarlegitimation med behörighet att undervisa i matte, svenska och engelska i grundskolan. I uppdraget ingår tidvis att följa elever till simundervisningen, så simkunnighet är också ett krav. Du är väl insatt i skolans läroplan och vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av undervisning.

Vi söker dig som vill vara med och fortsätta utveckla vår skola. Du har god samarbetsförmåga och planerar, genomför samt utvärderar verksamheten tillsammans med dina kollegor. Reflektion kring lärande är en självklarhet för dig och du delar gärna med dig till andra i det kollegiala lärandet. Du är flexibel och har god pedagogisk insikt. Därtill är du strukturerad och har ett tydligt ledarskap i klassrummet. Erfarenhet av att undervisa elever i anpassad grundskola är meriterande.

title: Lead, Nights
description:
The Van Drunen Family of Companies is growing!

  • Shift: Monday-Friday 11PM - 730AM and Mandatory OT on Saturday 11PM - 730AM
