title: Sustainable Markets internship
description:
Expected Start Date: 1 October 2026

Internship Sustainable Capital Markets

ING Wholesale Banking (“WB”) is looking to hire a Sustainable Capital Markets intern based in Amsterdam with a strong ambition to work in the Capital Solutions team, comprising of Capital Structuring, Liability Management and Sustainable Capital Markets team.

The Sustainable Capital Markets team acts as an advisory boutique and is specifically geared towards offering tailor-made sustainable structuring solutions. The team is responsible for the structuring of capital markets funding instruments with green, social, sustainable and/or sustainability-linked labels, integrated sustainability advisory for clients including sustainability rating advisory, ESG reporting advisory, and expanding socially responsible investor (SRI) knowledge and distribution capabilities.

We are based in Amsterdam, London and Brussels, but our team has a global reach operating as an overlay for ING’s Global Capital Markets franchise. Primary focus would be on EMEA clients, however also the clients of Americas, Asian and Middle Eastern teams are supported.

Job description:

  • Taking the lead in pitch preparation
  • Supporting DCM deal execution by means of support in preparing investor presentations and green shading of order books
  • Supporting the execution of structuring mandates for green, social, sustainable and sustainability-linked bonds
  • Help to identify market opportunities and monitor market developments and new ESG regulations by applying knowledge from various market sources (incl. BloombergNEF, Environmental Finance, ICMA, macro-economic research, client specific news, etc.)
  • Liaise with other key ING stakeholders (e.g. other Sustainable departments, international and local DCM origination teams, DCM Syndicate & Financial Markets Sales, Research) to identify opportunities, enhance internal cooperation and to maximize client cross-sell


Who we are looking for:

To be considered for this internship we require the following knowledge and experience:

  • Demonstrable affinity with Sustainable Finance and Financial Markets
  • Minimum of Bachelor’s degree required, Master level preferred from an internationally acclaimed university
  • Well-rounded academic background with coursework in finance, economics, law, political science, international relations, sustainability & business studies preferred
  • Internship or relevant work experience is a plus
  • Basic knowledge of Environmental, Social and Governance related topics
  • Basic knowledge of international bond markets and fixed income instruments is a plus
  • Basic knowledge of reading balance sheet, P&L and cash flow statements is a plus
  • Advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills
  • Fluent in English
  • Excellent (English) writing and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work well under pressure and tight deadlines

What do we offer:

  • Unique opportunity to learn about Sustainable Capital Markets in practice
  • Advanced training on the job: structuring process of capital markets funding instruments with green, social, sustainable and/or sustainability-linked labels, integrated sustainability advisory for our clients, deep knowledge of ESG regulations and ESG-rating methodologies
  • Live green, social, sustainable and/or sustainability-linked deal-execution experience with an active role in deals with high market visibility and international press coverage
  • Exposure to complex advisory projects requiring cooperation with other departments
  • Opportunity to create a network within ING as well as in the wider banking sector
  • Competitive allowance and reimbursement of public transport costs
  • You will be joining a highly skilled team who will be training and guiding you. As such, you will be seen as a full member of the team.

Prerequisites:

  • Applicants need to be enrolled in an EU university for the full duration of the internship
  • Applicants need to be available full-time for the full duration (min. 6 months) of the internship

Rewards and benefits

This is a great opportunity to train with highly skilled people who are experts in their field. You’ll do a lot and learn a lot – not only about your specialist area and the bank, but also about yourself and whether this type of environment is right for you.

You’ll also benefit from:

  • Internship allowance of 700 EUR based on 36 hours work week

  • Your own work laptop

  • Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation

  • Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities

During the duration of your internship at ING, it is mandatory to be enrolled at a Dutch university (or EU-university for EU passport holders).

Every year, more than 350 students join our internship program. While there are no guarantees about your future, many of our former interns move into a permanent role or onto our International Talent Programme (traineeship).

Whatever happens, an internship at ING is the ideal opportunity to meet a wide variety of people, to build up your own network, and to learn about many different aspects of banking – put simply, it’s a great start to your career.

title: Onboarding and Compliance Specialist
description:
At Montu, we're growing fast - and every great employee experience starts long before someone's first day.

We're looking for a highly organised, people-focused Compliance & Onboarding Specialist to own the journey from signed contract through to a new joiner's first weeks with us. You'll be responsible for ensuring every employee joins compliantly, on time, and with an exceptional experience, while helping us maintain the high standards expected of a regulated healthcare business.

This is a role for someone who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments, loves bringing order to complexity, and enjoys being the welcoming face that makes every new starter feel excited to join.

What You’ll Do:

You'll own the onboarding journey from signed offer to successful start date, ensuring every new joiner has everything they need while maintaining the highest compliance standards expected in a regulated healthcare environment.

This role is all about organisation, ownership and follow-through. You'll be managing multiple onboarding journeys at once, keeping stakeholders on track, and making sure no detail is missed.

You will:

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding process for every new starter, ensuring a seamless and welcoming experience

  • Chase and manage all pre-employment documentation, including Right to Work, DBS checks, references and professional registrations, ensuring nothing delays a start date

  • Confidently follow up with candidates, hiring managers and internal teams to keep onboarding moving - you're comfortable reminding busy people and know how to get things done

  • Coordinate multiple onboarding schedules each month, often welcoming large cohorts of new employees across different departments

  • Deliver engaging induction sessions and be the friendly face that welcomes every new joiner to Montu

  • Partner with Hiring Managers, IT, Payroll, Facilities and Compliance to ensure every new starter is fully set up before day one

  • Maintain accurate employee records across our HR systems, ensuring documentation is complete, compliant and audit-ready at all times

  • Spot bottlenecks, improve processes and help us scale our onboarding operation as the business continues to grow

  • Keep stakeholders updated on onboarding progress, escalating risks early to ensure start dates remain on track

If you’re a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and loves creating experiences that help people hit the ground running, you’ll fit right in.

What You’ll Bring:

You'll thrive in this role if you're naturally organised, persistent and enjoy bringing structure to busy environments.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Experience coordinating onboarding, compliance or employee administration within a healthcare or other highly regulated environment

  • Experience working in a high-growth business where priorities change quickly and no two days are the same

  • Exceptional organisational skills and the ability to juggle multiple deadlines without losing attention to detail

title: Supervising Producer
location: Abu Dhabi - CNN - Has Creative Hub, Yas South
description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. To see what it’s like to work at CNN, follow @WBDLife on Instagram and X!

You will lead teams, oversee major sponsorship projects, and deliver compelling multi-platform storytelling to a global audience.

If you're a master of multi-platform storytelling – from written digital features to bite-sized social videos to full 30-minute TV documentaries – who strives to innovate and experiment with new technologies, we want to hear from you.

  • Coordinate production on high-profile sponsorship projects, working with Producers to deliver against KPIs, including scheduling, A/B testing and SEO optimisation.
  • Collaborate with global bureaus and travel as required to create content that showcases innovation, people and stories from different regions.
  • Allocate resources and coordinate assignments in partnership with leadership, ensuring efficient project delivery.
  • Build strong relationships with on-air talent, stakeholders and cross-functional teams while maintaining budget oversight and cost awareness.

Qualifications & Experience

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join one of the teams within the Trust & Safety Unit, responsible for building a safe and reliable communication layer across the platform.

Our team owns the communication experience between users on both sides of the marketplace — including drivers and passengers, couriers and customers — across voice calls and in-app messaging. Our goal is to make communication seamless and effective while keeping it safe, protecting users from abuse, harassment, scams and other safety risks.

As a horizontal product domain, we work across multiple products and markets globally, partnering with teams across the company to improve the safety of communication and contribute to the overall Trust & Safety goals of the platform.
  • Communication Quality & Coverage: Own and improve the quality, reliability and coverage of in-app communication channels, including voice calls and messaging, ensuring safe and effective communication experiences. Define and evolve product strategies across communication quality, safety and content moderation, balancing user experience with risk prevention.
  • Communication UX/UI: Drive the UX/UI strategy for calls and in-app messaging. Simplify communication flows, improve user understanding of what is happening within the app, and create intuitive experiences that make communication both seamless and safe.
  • Advanced Analytics & Data Experiments: Define product hypotheses, design and run high-frequency A/B tests, and conduct deep analysis of user behavior and communication patterns. Strong hands-on experience with analytics is highly valued, including the ability to independently explore data and use AI/LLM tools to accelerate product analysis and research.
  • Global Scalability & Localization: Scale communication safety solutions across different product verticals and regions while adapting them to their specific user needs, safety risks and operational contexts. Build flexible product solutions that can be customized to address local challenges without compromising the overall safety strategy and product scalability.
  • Cross-Functional Roadmap & Stakeholder Management: Build and drive a cross-functional product roadmap across multiple products, markets and teams. Align stakeholders, manage dependencies and prioritize initiatives across Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Operations and Trust & Safety.
  • 3+ years in Product Management: Proven experience in Product Management, ideally within high-volume Marketplaces, Ride-hailing, Social, Communication, FinTech or E-commerce products.
  • Trust & Safety / Anti-Fraud Experience: Experience in relevant domains such as content moderation, abuse prevention, fraud, scams, user protection, risk management or platform safety is highly valued.
  • Strong UX/UI Instincts: Deep understanding of UX principles and the ability to critically evaluate and improve complex communication flows across mobile and digital products.
  • Data-Driven Product Management: Strong analytical skills and experience working hands-on with product data. Ability to independently formulate hypotheses, analyze user behavior, define success metrics and make data-driven product decisions.
  • High-Velocity A/B Testing & Experimentation: Proven experience designing, launching and analyzing A/B tests. Ability to evaluate experiments beyond primary metrics, considering downstream impact, long-term user behavior and critical safety guardrails.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives, align multiple teams and stakeholders, manage dependencies and drive execution in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Technical Literacy: Solid understanding of how modern digital products and backend systems work, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering and Data Science teams and make informed product decisions.
  • AI & Analytical Tools: Comfortable using modern AI/LLM tools and analytical technologies to accelerate data exploration, research, experimentation and day-to-day product work.
  • Professional working proficiency in English (B2/C1+), Russian is a plus.
  • Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 1100+ cities in 48 countries.
  • Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs.
  • Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program.
  • Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects.
  • Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow.
  • Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs.
  • Annual salary from 70 700 EUR gross.
Final benefits may vary depending on the location.

title: Undersköterskor till engagerade team på Lyckavägens särskilda boende
description:
Nu söker vi kollegor till våra drivna och kompetenta team på Lyckavägens särskilda boende – kanske just du vill vara en del i arbetet att forma framtidens äldreomsorg? Hos oss får du arbeta i en miljö där teamkänsla, utveckling och omsorg går hand i hand. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Höjdpunkter med jobbet:

  • Att jobba med det som är viktigt på riktigt
  • Möjlighet att göra skillnad i människors vardag
  • Chans att jobba i ett professionellt team

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker omvårdnadspersonal till vårt särskilda boende Lyckavägen i Leksand. Du som är intresserad av att arbeta hos oss behöver vilja vara delaktig i utvecklingen och tillsammans med kollegor forma framtidens arbetssätt utifrån gemensamma mål.

Som omvårdnadspersonal arbetar du nära de äldre och hjälper dem utifrån deras individuella behov. Arbetsuppgifterna är bland annat att ge personlig omvårdnad och bidra till att de äldres tillvaro blir trygg, meningsfull och stimulerande, samt ha kontakt med närstående och dokumentera i våra system.

Vi arbetar i tvärprofessionella team bestående av omvårdnadspersonal, sjuksköterskor, rehab och enhetschef. I teamet ingår också kvalitetsledare samt måltids- och aktivitetssamordnare som aktivt arbetar för att utveckla och höja kvaliteten på våra särskilda boenden. Här får du vara med och påverka, bidra med dina idéer och växa tillsammans med oss.

Tjänsterna vi ska tillsätta är på 100%, dag/kväll/helg.

Din profil

  • Vi söker utbildade vårdbiträden och undersköterskor.
  • Arbetet kräver datorvana för dokumentation i IT system.
  • Goda svenska språkkunskaper både i tal och skrift är ett krav.
  • Du ska kunna få och behålla delegering att utföra hälso-och sjukvårdsuppgifter.
  • Det är meriterande med tidigare erfarenhet av vård- och omsorgsarbete.
  • Kunskap och erfarenhet av att arbeta med inriktning demens är meriterande.

Teamet på Lyckavägen söker dig som har en helhetssyn och en vilja att samarbeta – vi tror på styrkan i att arbeta tillsammans mot gemensamma mål. Du har en personlig mognad och kan stå stadigt i utmanande situationer.

Du har en empatisk förmåga och kan sätta dig in i den äldres livssituation. I din roll möter du både äldre, deras närstående och kollegor från olika professioner – därför är samarbetsförmåga, kommunikation och respekt viktiga egenskaper.

Arbetsdagen kan ibland bli annorlunda än planerat, men i dessa situationer behåller du lugnet, balanserar olika krav och omprioriterar dina arbetsuppgifter. Du är öppen, respektfull och har alltid den äldres bästa i fokus.

Då arbetet som omvårdnadspersonal är fysiskt krävande är det viktigt att du har en god rörlighet och grundfysik.

Om arbetsplatsen

I en vacker miljö i byn Tibble, två kilometer utanför centrala Leksand, ligger kommunens särskilda boende Lyckavägen. Lyckavägen öppnade i december 2021 och består av fyra flyglar med modern standard samt flera ytor för social samvaro, såväl inom- som utomhus. Totalt finns det åtta små enheter, där det bor nio personer per enhet. På Lyckavägen finns två enheter med inriktning demens.

På boendet arbetar omvårdnadspersonal dygnet runt för att stödja de äldre. Arbetet utgår från individens fysiska, psykiska samt sociala behov med ett personcentrerat arbetssätt.

Vi erbjuder dig

För oss är det viktigt att alla våra medarbetare hittar en balans mellan jobb och hem, känner trygghet i sin anställning och en ökad livskvalitet genom att jobba i kommunen. Lyckas vi med det finns det goda förutsättningar att också lyckas med vår gemensamma uppgift, som är:

Vi gör det vi ska genom att ta gemensamt ansvar för vårt demokratiska uppdrag, använda våra resurser klokt och alltid hålla fokus på dem vi är till för.

Vi gör det bra och är stolta över vårt arbete och de resultat vi når, och vi välkomnar engagerade och modiga medarbetare som vill utveckla och förbättra tillsammans med oss.

Vi gör det tillsammans genom att samarbeta och lära av varandra. Dialogen är viktig för oss, och vi hittar nya lösningar tillsammans med dem vi är till för, med tillit, omtanke och respekt.

Vi strävar efter ett hälsofrämjande arbetsklimat, arbetstillfredsställelse, gemenskap och personlig utveckling. Kompetensutveckling är en självklarhet, och vi uppmuntrar våra medarbetare att vidareutvecklas genom kurser, utbildningar och nätverkande.

På vår hemsida har vi samlat information om hur det är att arbeta hos oss. För mer information vänligen se https://leksand.se/jobba-hos-oss

För dig som sökande har vi möjlighet att erbjuda medflyttandeservice, se vidare http://www.rekryteringslots.se/

Din ansökan

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen i Leksands kommun samt möjliggöra god kommunikation med våra sökande ber vi dig skicka in din ansökan digitalt via länken. Ansökningshandlingarna består av CV och personligt brev.

Legitimation för att verifiera din identitet behöver uppvisas vid en eventuell intervju. Det är standard i alla våra rekryteringsprocesser.

Observera att vissa tjänster inom Leksands kommun omfattas av bakgrundskontroll.

Vilken typ av kontroll som genomförs beror på tjänstens innehåll och ansvar. Om den aktuella tjänsten omfattas av detta kommer du att få information om det i samband med rekryteringsprocessen.

Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-08-23

Tillsättning sker efter överenskommelse.

Vi granskar CV:n löpande så det är bra om du skickar in din ansökan så fort som möjligt.

Följ oss också på sociala medier.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Specialistläkare Neurologi, Halmstad
description:
Specialistläkare i neurologi till Aleris Vill du vara med från början? Var med och bygg framtidens neurologimottagning i Halmstad.

Nu öppnar vi möjligheten att utveckla neurologisk specialistvård på vår nya Alerisklinik i centrala Halmstad.

Hos oss får du mer än ett uppdrag – du får möjlighet att forma en verksamhet tillsammans med ett engagerat team som vill göra specialistvården mer tillgänglig för fler patienter.

Vi söker dig som är specialistläkare i neurologi och som vill kombinera hög medicinsk kvalitet med ett nära och personligt patientmöte.

Om Aleris

Aleris är en av Skandinaviens ledande aktörer inom specialistvård. Vi tror på kraften i den nära experten – där medicinsk spetskompetens möter mänsklig värme, tillgänglighet och omtanke. Varje dag arbetar vi för att fler patienter ska få rätt vård i rätt tid.

Om verksamheten

Vår nyöppnade specialistklinik ligger mitt i centrala Halmstad, endast ett stenkast från tågstationen. I moderna, ljusa lokaler tar vi redan emot patienter inom flera specialiteter och vill nu etablera en neurologimottagning.

Här får du möjlighet att vara med och utveckla verksamheten från start och påverka hur framtidens neurologiska mottagning ska utformas.

Vi delar lokaler med Aleris Ögon och arbetar i ett engagerat team med korta beslutsvägar och stort fokus på samarbete, kvalitet och patientupplevelse.

Om tjänsten

Inledningsvis omfattar tjänsten 1–2 dagar per vecka, med goda möjligheter att utöka tjänstgöringsgraden i takt med att verksamheten växer.

Arbetet består främst av mottagningsverksamhet med bland annat:

· neurologiska specialistbedömningar

· utredning och uppföljning av neurologiska tillstånd

· migränbehandling

· läkemedels- och receptförskrivning

· sedvanlig neurologisk öppenvård

Vi tar emot patienter via försäkringsbolag och privatbetalande patienter.

Vi söker dig som

Du är specialistläkare i neurologi och trivs med att arbeta självständigt samtidigt som du uppskattar nära samarbete med kollegor.

Vi tror att du:

· är trygg i din specialistkompetens

· har ett gott bemötande och sätter patienten i centrum

· uppskattar att utveckla nya arbetssätt och verksamheter

· är lösningsorienterad och vill bidra med idéer och erfarenheter

· vill vara med och skapa en neurologiverksamhet med hög kvalitet och korta väntetider.

Därför ska du välja Aleris i Halmstad

Hos oss får du:

· möjlighet att vara med från starten av en ny neurologiverksamhet

· moderna och trivsamma lokaler i centrala Halmstad

· ett engagerat team med hög kompetens och stort driv

· möjlighet att påverka verksamhetens utveckling

· korta beslutsvägar och ett nära ledarskap

· konkurrenskraftiga förmåner enligt Aleris villkor.

Vi tror att de bästa resultaten skapas när människor får möjlighet att påverka sitt arbete och utvecklas tillsammans.

Förmåner Aleris

Som medarbetare på Aleris får du tillgång till flera förmåner som skapar goda förutsättningar för ett hållbart arbetsliv. Vi vill att du ska trivas, utvecklas och känna stolthet över ditt arbete.

Hos oss erbjuder vi bland annat:

Förmåner hos Aleris - Aleris Sverige

· En genomtänkt introduktion anpassad efter din erfarenhet

· Interna utbildningar och goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling

· En företagskultur där samarbete, delaktighet och nya idéer uppmuntras

· En god arbetsmiljö med korta beslutsvägar och möjlighet att påverka verksamhetens utveckling

Hos oss får du vara med och etablera specialistvård för framtiden – i moderna lokaler och med stora möjligheter att påverka hur den gynekologiska verksamheten utvecklas.

Om anställningen

Placering: Halmstad

Omfattning: 1–2 dagar per vecka till att börja med, med möjlighet till utökning.

Arbetstid: Cirka kl. 08.30–16.30.

Anställningsform: Enligt överenskommelse.

Kontakt

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta:

Helena Funseth Senior Executiv Search-Specialist Tel: 079 071 90 70 helena.funseth@aleris.se

title: Software Engineer
description:
Do našeho týmu v Ostravě hledáme motivovaného a cílevědomého kolegu - Software Engineera, který rád spolupracuje v mezinárodním projektovém týmu a podílí se na vývoji inovativních technických řešení.

Stanete se součástí našeho inženýrského týmu, kde budete navrhovat a programovat software pro testovací a měřicí systémy. Budete pracovat v multidisciplinárním globálním týmu složeném ze softwarových, optických, elektronických a strojních inženýrů a spolupracovat s kolegy z dalších evropských poboček na sdílení projektů, znalostí a zkušeností.

Hlavní výzvy Software Engineera:

  • Podílet se na vývoji a integraci softwarových programů pro měřicí a testovací techniku (testing).
  • Vyvíjet systémy pro měřicí, leteckou nebo železniční techniku (embedded).
  • Vyvíjet kód, který musí být dlouhodobě spravován, udržován a aktualizován (desítky let)
  • Práce na projektech na mezinárodní úrovni.
  • Podpora testování vstupů a výstupů, uvedení do provozu, validace a instalace strojů, a to jak u zákazníků, tak v naší kanceláři v Ostravě

Ideální kandidát v kostce:

Vzdělání: magisterský titul v oboru vývoje softwaru;

Zkušenosti:

- 1 rok praxe ve vývoji softwaru C++;

- praxe s vývojem embedded zařízení je výhodou;

- znalosti práce s yocto je výhodou;

- schopnost číst, sledovat a rozumět elektrickým schématům je výhodou;

Dovednosti: kreativní myšlení, vynikající time management a flexibilita, chuť čelit technickým výzvám, smysl pro detail;

Jazykové znalosti: pokročilá úroveň angličtiny (min B2), písemně i ústně.

Ochota cestovat

title: Servicemonteur elektrotechniek
description:
Functietitel

Servicemonteur elektrotechniek

Functieomschrijving

Maken

Als servicemonteur zorg je er samen met je collega’s, binnen een dynamische omgeving, ervoor dat onze opdrachtgevers 24/7 op de elektrotechnische installaties kan rekenen. Een omgeving waarbij verantwoordelijkheid en veiligheid een belangrijk thema is. En hoewel teamwork voorop staat, werk je ook zeer zelfstandig. Je draagt innovatieve verbetermogelijkheden aan, waarbij je rekening houdt met duurzaamheid. Daarbij krijg je als servicemonteur veel vrijheid én de kans om te blijven leren, omdat de ontwikkelingen in jouw vakgebied nooit stilstaan.

Dit ga je doen:

  • Het uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud aan elektrotechnische installaties;

  • Voor een storing aan b.v. licht- en krachtinstallatie, noodverlichting, brandmeldinstallatie, inbraak- en toegangscontrole installatie ontvang je een werkorder je op een tablet [alles digitaal];

  • Jij bent dé troubleshooter die op locatie de storing 24/7 kan lossen. Vaak zelfstandig en indien nodig met hulp van andere collega’s of specialistische leveranciers. Is het probleem verholpen? Dan meld je de storing af en informeer je de klant over de oplossing;

  • Heb je nieuwe materialen nodig, dan bestel je die.

Eens per acht weken een consignatiedienst draaien. Er is een mogelijkheid om losse dagen met collega’s te ruilen mocht het op een bijzondere dag echt niet uitkomen. Met een vast team werk je voor een langere periode op één of meerdere locaties. Waar jij het best tot je recht komt en met welk team jij de beste klik hebt, zoeken we samen uit!

Samenwerken

Bij Heijmans Utiliteit in Diemen werken zo’n 160 collega’s aan de mooiste projecten en service- en onderhoudscontracten. Op de afdeling Service & Onderhoud in Diemen werk je samen met vakmannen en -vrouwen met verschillende disciplines, namelijk elektrotechniek, werktuigbouwkunde en bouwkunde. Iedereen is benaderbaar en gefocust op ontwikkeling. De sfeer is gemoedelijk en al staat de klant altijd voorop; ruimte voor gezelligheid is er zeker. Ook werktijden en doorgroeimogelijkheden zijn bespreekbaar. Binnen je team werk je samen met (1e) servicemonteurs, technici, een chef-monteur, werkvoorbereiders, een contractbeheerder en een klantmanager.

Krijgen

  • Direct een vast contract.

  • Een salaris van € 3.052,- en € 3.926,-, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring. Exacte inschaling gebeurt eerlijk en in balans met je collega’s.

  • Een vergoeding én een extra toeslag van € 150,- bruto per maand ten behoeve van deelnemen aan de consignatiedienst met daarnaast per dienst van één volledige week €219,- euro bruto.

  • Een telefoon, laptop/tablet en een volledig ingerichte bus.

  • Een prettige werksfeer: als collega’s staan we altijd voor elkaar klaar en komen we regelmatig samen om onze successen te vieren.

  • Een warm welkom: je krijgt letterlijk een Heijmans-welkomstpakket. Tijdens twee introductiedagen maak je uitgebreid kennis met ons bedrijf, daarna volg je drie maanden een inwerktraject. Jouw persoonlijke buddy wijst je de weg en beantwoordt je vragen.

  • Veel groeimogelijkheden, onder meer via onze eigen Heijmans Academie en via praktijkgerichte trainingen, gegeven door je eigen professionele collega’s.

  • Een goede balans tussen werk en privé.

  • Arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de cao Metaal & Techniek.

Meebrengen

  • Minimaal een MBO-3 diploma in de richting elektrotechniek en ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie binnen de utiliteit.

  • Aanvullende opleiding/cursus zoals NEN3140 en Stipel (pré)

  • Een praktische instelling: je denkt mee, ziet kansen en draagt actief ideeën aan.

  • Een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en kennis van zaken: je kunt zelfstandig aan de slag en stemt de nodige zaken af met je leidinggevende én met de klant.

  • Een rijbewijs B en je bent in het bezit van VCA VOL en een geldige VOG.

Vragen

Heb je nog vragen over de functie? Neem dan contact op met Danny Cossee, Klantmanager Services via +31 6 21862844. Heb je andere vragen? Neem dan contact op met Milan Verschoor, Corporate Recruiter via +31 6 28429471.

title: Terminalarbetare och Budbilschaufför sökes i Östersund
description:
TERMINALARBETARE OCH BUDBILSCHAUFFÖR ÖSTERSUND (DELTID)

Instabox Östersund behöver förstärka sin arbetsstyrka och söker just nu duktiga terminalarbetare till sin terminal.

OM INSTABOX

Instabox är ett tech/logistik företag som vill förändra branschen för en smartare och fossilfri framtid. Det ska vara okrångligt att handla på nätet och därför erbjuder Instabox ett snabbt och smidigt leveransalternativ, allt för att göra vardagen enklare. Instabox startade i Stockholm 2015 och finns nu runt om i Norden.

UPPDRAGSBESKRIVNING

Som terminalarbetare arbetar du i Instabox terminal där det inkommer tusentals paket som skall lastas om, sorteras och skickas ut för leverans. Arbetet består av maskinell sortering i olika grad och beror på var du arbetar. Häri ligger att säkerställa att verksamheten fortskrider utan hinder genom att noggrant se till så att gods kommer in och ut ur terminalen enligt tidtabell. Arbetet passar dig som studerar på minst 50%, alternativt har ett annat jobb på minst 50%.

ARBETSUPPGIFTER

Sortering - Scanning - Plockning - Budbilschaufför

OBS! Notera att du i denna tjänst kommer att behöva hantera även lådor med alkohol.

VAD FÖRVÄNTAS AV DIG

Som terminalarbetare trivs du med ett tempofyllt, ansvarsfullt och utmanande arbete. Arbetet innehåller en hel del tunga moment och sker i ett högt tempo, vilket innebär att god fysik är en förutsättning. Även förmåga att hantera IT-hjälpmedel är bra egenskaper. Att du upplevs som positiv och professionell är viktigt – Instabox förväntar sig god service och hög kvalitet. Som person är du punktlig, noggrann och sprider en positiv stämning omkring dig. Du är en naturlig problemlösare och älskar utmaningar.

ARBETSTID

Du förväntas kunna jobba ca 3 dagar/vecka måndag - fredag. Arbetstiderna kan variera men är oftast 07:00-17:00.

KRAV

  • Du måste ha fyllt 18 år
  • B-körkort (manuell)
  • Stark lagspelare
  • God fysik
  • Goda språkkunskaper i svenska eller engelska (skriftligt och verbalt)
  • Du är studerande eller har annan sysselsättning (annat jobb) på minst 50%
  • Bakgrundskontroll – Nolltolerans mot förekommande i brottsregister

MERITERANDE

  • Erfarenhet av liknande arbete
  • Truckkort

ANSTÄLLNINGSFORM

Tjänsten är en visstidsanställning (deltid vid behov)

title: Technician, Line Service (BFI) Second Shift 1400-2200
description:
The Line Service Technician (LST) is responsible for providing safe, efficient aircraft ground handling services while delivering exceptional customer service to aircraft owners, guests, and flight crews. This role is hands on and operations focused, supporting all arriving and departing aircraft with professionalism, urgency, and a positive attitude.

Aircraft Ground Handling & Ramp Operations

  • Perform aircraft fueling, towing, parking, de icing, placement, and basic cleaning
  • Operate a wide range of aircraft ground support equipment in accordance with procedures and safety standards
  • Ensure timely and accurate delivery of all required ground support services for arriving and departing aircraft
  • Maintain continuous ramp awareness, including aircraft movement, FOD prevention, and changing weather conditions
  • Perform duties with attention to detail and minimal supervision

Safety & Compliance

  • Promote safe operations by protecting customers, employees, aircraft, and equipment from harm
  • Follow all company policies, standard operating procedures, and safety regulations
  • Use sound judgment when making timely decisions during active operations
  • Support a safety focused culture by maintaining awareness of ramp hazards and operational risks

Customer Service & Experience

  • Deliver Modern Aviation’s exceptional service by assisting passengers and flight crews with professionalism and care
  • Greet customers with high energy, a positive attitude, and a willingness to exceed expectations
  • Anticipate customer needs, offer additional services, and represent Modern Aviation in a professional manner
  • Maintain a positive image with customers, vendors, partners, and airport stakeholders

Communication & Teamwork

  • Work effectively with other Line Service Technicians, Customer Service staff, and Operations leadership
  • Communicate clearly during aircraft movements and active operations
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by Shift Leads or Line Management

Physical Requirements & Schedule

  • Ability to stand or walk for extended periods of time
  • Physical capability to perform frequent bending, reaching, and manual tasks
  • Must meet physical demands associated with ramp operations
  • Able to work variable shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as required

title: People Services Associate
description:
Job Title

People Services Associate

Department

Human Resources-BG-UK

Overview of Department

The people team develops the capabilities, culture and experiences that create a human and commercial edge for Baillie Gifford. We exist to make the firm the world’s most distinctive place to grow a career, investing in our people with the same long-term conviction as our portfolios and continually reimagining how work is done to outpace the industry.

The team supports the full people lifecycle, including people operations, people partnering, leadership, learning and capability development, attraction and resourcing, organisational culture, reward, wellbeing and the end-to-end people experience.

Through this work, we ensure that people and performance are deeply connected and that our colleagues are equipped to deliver long-term value for clients.

Purpose of Role

Our People Services team brings our people strategy to life through the day-to-day moments that matter, resolving colleague queries and delivering the core operational processes that support people throughout their time at the firm.

Supporting around 1,700 colleagues across 11 countries, the team combines responsive support, accurate and consistent operations, sound judgement, strong controls and continuous improvement to make the everyday people experience seamless, scalable and reliable. In doing so, the team is a critical enabler of pace, performance and confidence across the organisation.

As a People Services Associate, you’ll play a central role in making everyday interactions with People Services feel simple, responsive and well supported. Combining care, accuracy and sound judgement, you’ll help keep the operational foundations of the People team running smoothly. You’ll take ownership of day-to-day queries, cases and core operational processes from start to finish, ensuring colleagues and managers receive clear answers and dependable support.

Alongside delivering a high-quality service, you’ll contribute practical ideas and help deliver improvements that make People Services simpler, more consistent and more effective over time.

Responsibilities

Service delivery and colleague experience

  • Delivers high-quality people services across the employee lifecycle, taking ownership of core operational processes to ensure a clear, responsive and supportive colleague experience
  • Acts as a trusted first point of contact for colleagues and managers, ensuring queries are understood, prioritised, resolved or escalated in line with agreed service standards

Service quality, risk and improvement

  • Identifies operational incidents, service failures and data-quality issues, takes appropriate action and records, resolves or escalates them in line with agreed procedures
  • Uses day-to-day experience, colleague and manager feedback and recurring query themes to identify friction, risks, unclear guidance and improvement opportunities
  • Shares learning, contributes practical ideas and helps deliver defined improvements that make services simpler and more effective

Knowledge and development

  • Contributes to team knowledge by sharing learning, identifying gaps in guidance and maintaining accurate documentation for the work they deliver
  • Builds knowledge across a range of People Services areas, with opportunities to deepen expertise and take ownership of defined processes or improvement activity over time

What success looks like

  • A trusted and responsive service: colleagues and managers know where to go, receive clear support and have confidence that commitments will be followed through
  • Reliable, high-quality delivery: core processes, queries and cases are handled accurately, on time and to clear service standards
  • Accurate data and strong controls: Systems and records are kept up to date, required checks are completed and risks or errors are identified and addressed promptly
  • Sound judgement: Day-to-day issues are resolved confidently, with advice sought and matters escalated at the right time
  • Practical improvement: Learning from operational delivery is shared and translated into changes that reduce friction and strengthen the service
  • Growing capability: Knowledge and confidence develop over time, enabling a broader contribution across the team and greater resilience within the service

Your knowledge and experience

  • Experience delivering excellent customer service or operational support, ideally within HR, People Services or another operational environment.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritise work and deliver accurately to agreed timescales.
  • Experience using business systems and maintaining accurate records, with excellent attention to detail and an appreciation of the importance of data quality.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain information in a helpful and accessible way
  • A collaborative approach, with the ability to build positive relationships and work effectively with colleagues and stakeholders
  • A proactive mindset, with an interest in identifying opportunities to improve processes and enhance the colleague experience

The type of candidate we're looking for

We're looking for someone who enjoys helping people and takes pride in delivering a high-quality service. You'll take ownership of your work from start to finish, balancing pace with care and accuracy to ensure colleagues and managers receive timely, thoughtful and dependable support. You'll enjoy working collaboratively, building your knowledge across different areas of People Services and developing your skills over time. You’ll be comfortable managing competing priorities, adapting to changing demands and using sound judgement to resolve day-to-day queries and operational issues, knowing when to seek advice or escalate. You’ll naturally look for opportunities to make things simpler, whether that means improving guidance, streamlining a process or sharing ideas that enhance the colleague experience. Whether you’re building your career in People Services or bringing transferable experience from another customer-focused environment, you’ll be motivated by delivering an excellent service and continually improving how work gets done.

Critical skills

  • Team working
  • Nurture relationships
  • Improvement mindset
  • Digital effectiveness (including AI)
  • Adaptability

Additional information:

Instead of a cover letter, candidates are asked to submit a CV and short written responses (maximum 300 words each) to the following questions:

  • Question 1 – Describe a time when you delivered excellent service while managing competing priorities or responding to changing demands.
  • Question 2 – Tell us about a time when you identified a better way of doing something. What improvement did you suggest and what difference did it make?

Closing Date

August 18, 2026

Should you choose to use AI tools to support your application, we ask that you do this thoughtfully. We encourage you to ensure your application reflects your own voice, experience, and motivations. We value authenticity and want to understand your individual strengths and perspectives.


At Baillie Gifford, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful culture in which each of our colleagues can thrive and develop. We believe that our clients are best served by a diverse workforce with the experiences, ideas and perspectives that this brings.


If you are currently working at Baillie Gifford as an employee or contractor please apply to this job from the firm's Workday internal career site.

title: Säkerhetstekniker till kund i Linköping
description:
Om tjänsten

Montico söker nu Säkerhetstekniker till kund i Linköping.

title: Product Director - Commercial Vehicle Brakes
description:
We are seeking a strategic and analytically driven Product Director to lead the development, expansion, and commercial performance of our Commercial Vehicle brake portfolio. This role owns the full product lifecycle—from concept and business case creation through PPAP qualification, launch execution, pricing strategy, and ongoing portfolio optimization—while ensuring competitive positioning and strong margin performance across OE, OES, and Aftermarket channels. The ideal candidate brings deep CV brake expertise, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to collaborate across engineering, operations, supply chain, finance, and customer teams to drive successful program execution and deliver sustained business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Product Lifecycle Ownership

  • Lead the full lifecycle of new product introductions (NPI), including concept development, feasibility analysis, business case creation, and cross‑functional alignment.
  • Drive execution through all phases of development: engineering, tooling, validation, PPAP, pilot builds, launch readiness, and post‑launch performance.
  • Ensure all new and existing products meet OE and Aftermarket qualification standards, including full PPAP documentation and compliance.
  • Maintain a multi‑year product roadmap aligned with market trends, customer needs, and strategic growth priorities.

Program Management & Execution

  • Serve as the program owner for major customer initiatives, ensuring on‑time delivery, cross‑functional coordination, and commercial success.
  • Lead program reviews, risk assessments, and mitigation planning with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Finance.
  • Manage product changes, cost‑downs, VA/VE initiatives, and continuous improvement activities.

Pricing Strategy, Quote & Margin Management

  • Own pricing strategy for the entire CV brake portfolio across all customer segments: OE, OES, WD, Retail, Buying Groups, and Fleets.
  • Develop and maintain a balanced price architecture that aligns competitiveness, channel dynamics, and margin requirements.
  • Conduct margin analysis, cost modeling, and scenario planning to support pricing decisions and customer negotiations.
  • Lead customer quote responses, including cost breakdowns, value propositions, and commercial justification.

Customer Program Leadership

  • Act as the primary commercial interface for product‑related discussions with key customers.
  • Manage customer program launches, product transitions, and ongoing performance reviews.
  • Support sales teams with product expertise, competitive positioning, and strategic account planning.
  • Lead customer‑specific pricing strategies, ensuring alignment with broader portfolio objectives.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis

title: Senior Electronics Engineer
description:
This is a broad, hands-on senior role. You will take ownership of the electronics across architecture, schematic and PCB design, RF and cellular connectivity, sensor integration, power systems, thermal performance and long-term reliability, for products that live outdoors on streetlights in demanding conditions. The role deliberately extends beyond the PCB into the practical engineering that gets a product built well: test fixtures, production software, validation methods and manufacturing processes.

You will have significant influence over product architecture, engineering standards, design-for-manufacture, and the reliability of hardware deployed at scale in the field.

It will suit an engineer who enjoys working across disciplines: reviewing a complex design one day, debugging hardware in the lab the next, working through enclosure and thermal trade-offs with mechanical engineers, and resolving issues on the production line.

What you will do

  • Own schematic capture, PCB layout, component selection, design reviews and hardware release across digital, mixed-signal, power and RF sections, balancing cost, robustness, DFM and DFT
  • Bring up and debug complex embedded hardware using structured measurement and root-cause analysis
  • Design and validate high-speed interfaces, clocks, memory, cameras and other signal-integrity-sensitive circuits
  • Drive EMC pre-compliance and formal compliance activities, using test results to guide practical design improvements
  • Advance cellular and wireless performance through antenna tuning, placement, matching, grounding, shielding and enclosure-aware RF design
  • Integrate camera, microphone, environmental and radar sensors, and validate their electrical and system-level performance
  • Develop power supplies, protection, low-power behaviour and thermal performance for reliable outdoor operation
  • Use CAD and 3D printing to develop enclosures, mounts, seals, prototypes, assembly aids and test jigs
  • Manage component lifecycle, availability, alternates and obsolescence risk
  • Build factory fixtures and automated workflows for programming, functional test, calibration, RF checks, traceability and reporting
  • Write practical Python or C/C++ tools for test automation, DFM and engineering analysis
  • Partner directly with suppliers and manufacturers on production support, yield optimisation and engineering change control
  • Strong electronics product-development experience spanning prototype, verification and production
  • Advanced schematic capture and PCB layout capability, including RF-aware and mixed-signal design
  • Hands-on EMC debugging and compliance experience, and practical antenna or cellular modem integration experience
  • Confidence with oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers, VNAs, logic analysers and electronic loads
  • Practical mechanical design skills, and enough software ability to automate engineering and manufacturing tasks
  • A methodical, ownership-driven approach and the ability to collaborate across software, hardware and manufacturing

Beneficial

  • Connectivity and RF: LTE-M / NB-IoT, LoRaWAN, Wi-SUN, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth or GNSS
  • Interfaces, firmware and high-speed design: USB, camera MIPI CSI buses, digital audio, embedded firmware, or high-speed digital signal design
  • Standards and compliance: RCM / CE / FCC / RED, or Zhaga Book 18 / D4i
  • Outdoor products and manufacturing: IP-rated or outdoor products, PCBA production, or yield improvement

Why join

  • Genuine ownership from concept through to field deployment, not a slice of someone else's design
  • A complete, real-world product spanning outdoor electronics, embedded Linux, edge AI, wireless connectivity, cloud services and manufacturing
  • Hardware you design, deployed on lighting infrastructure in cities worldwide through Schréder's global reach
  • The autonomy and pace of a small, practical engineering team, with the backing and stability of a global leader
  • Hybrid working, based in Sydney

If you want to own real hardware end to end and see it deployed at scale, we would like to hear from you.

Respect is one of our Values. Our commitment to inclusivity goes hand in hand with our dedication to sustainability and the environment. Inclusivity is part of who we are, so we encourage applications from all backgrounds, communities and industries and are committed to having a team that is made up of diverse skills, experiences and abilities.

At Schréder, we commit ourselves to co-creating an environment where passionate people work and win together, learn and have fun. Let Join us!

title: Interim Avdelningschef till kund i Skövde!
description:
Är du en trygg och närvarande ledare som motiveras av att utveckla människor, skapa struktur och driva verksamheten framåt? Vill du ta dig an ett betydelsefullt konsultuppdrag där du får kombinera operativt ledarskap med strategisk utveckling i en samhällsviktig verksamhet? Då kan detta vara nästa steg för dig.

Om uppdraget

Vi söker nu en interim Avdelningschef till ett spännande uppdrag inom en samhällsviktig verksamhet med fokus på tillgängliga och hållbara transportlösningar.

Du kommer att leda en engagerad grupp om cirka 14 medarbetare och ansvara för att verksamheten levererar med hög kvalitet, god service och ett tydligt kundfokus. Rollen innebär ett verksamhetsnära ledarskap där du arbetar nära både medarbetare, samarbetspartners och andra intressenter.

Det här är ett uppdrag för dig som trivs med att skapa engagemang, bygga starka team och samtidigt säkerställa en stabil och effektiv leverans.

Ditt uppdrag

Som avdelningschef får du ett brett ansvar där du bland annat kommer att:

  • Leda, coacha och utveckla en grupp om cirka 14 medarbetare.

  • Skapa tydlighet genom struktur, uppföljning och ett närvarande ledarskap.

  • Ansvara för medarbetarsamtal, utvecklingssamtal och måluppföljning.

  • Säkerställa att verksamheten når uppsatta mål inom kvalitet, leverans och kundnytta.

  • Bidra till utvecklingen av arbetssätt, processer och verksamheten som helhet.

  • Samarbeta med interna och externa intressenter för att skapa effektiva och hållbara lösningar.

  • Delta aktivt i ledningsarbetet och bidra till både operativa och strategiska beslut.

Vi söker dig som

Vi tror att du är en trygg ledare som får människor att växa och som skapar engagemang genom ett tydligt, inkluderande och coachande ledarskap.

Du har dessutom:

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som:

  • Har dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda medarbetare som första linjens chef.

  • Är van att leda och utveckla operativa verksamheter med många interna och externa kontaktytor.

  • Trivs i en verksamhetsnära ledarroll där du kombinerar personalansvar med fokus på leverans, kvalitet och samarbete.

  • Är trygg i att fatta beslut, prioritera och driva arbetet framåt även i komplexa och föränderliga situationer.

  • Är en tydlig, lyhörd och förtroendeingivande ledare som anpassar ditt ledarskap efter situation och medarbetarnas behov.

Meriterande

Det är meriterande om du har:

  • Mer än tre års erfarenhet som första linjens chef.

  • Erfarenhet av att leda förändrings- och utvecklingsarbete.

  • Erfarenhet från kollektivtrafik eller annan samhällsfinansierad verksamhet.

  • Erfarenhet av arbete i en politiskt styrd organisation.

  • Erfarenhet av upphandling, avtalsförvaltning och leverantörsstyrning.

Vem är du?

För att trivas i uppdraget tror vi att du är:

  • En inspirerande och trygg ledare.

  • Relationsskapande och lyhörd.

  • Strukturerad och handlingskraftig.

  • Prestigelös och lösningsorienterad.

  • Van att skapa engagemang och delaktighet.

  • Resultatinriktad med ett starkt fokus på kvalitet och verksamhetsutveckling.

Därför är uppdraget unikt

Du blir en del av en verksamhet med ett tydligt samhällsuppdrag där kvalitet, tillgänglighet och hållbar utveckling står i centrum. Här får du möjlighet att påverka både människor och verksamhet samtidigt som du leder ett engagerat team i en organisation med stor betydelse för samhället.

Uppdragsinformation

  • Placering: Skövde (resor inom regionen kan förekomma)

  • Omfattning: Heltid 100%

  • Arbetsplats: Hybrid på plats 3–4 dagar per vecka

  • Start: Enligt överenskommelse

  • Uppdragets längd: 01 Sep 2026 - 31 Maj 2027 med möjlighet till förlägning.

  • Sista ansökningsdagen: 18 Aug 2026

Vi arbetar med löpande urval och intervjuer, vilket innebär att uppdraget kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

description:
The position is responsible for balances due from patients, insurance carriers, and third-party payers.   • Interpret Managed Care/Commercial contracts and/or Medicare and Medicaid rules and regulations to ensure proper reimbursement/collection.
  • Make necessary adjustments as required by plan reimbursement.
  • Performs payment validation by utilizing internal and/or external resources to ensure proper reimbursement.
  • Reviews, researches, and appeals partially denied claims for reconsideration.
  • Responsible for contacting patients to gain additional information required to resolve an outstanding insurance balance.
  • Responsible for posting payments both electronically and manually.
  • Analyzes, investigates, and resolves claims errors in the clearinghouse system to ensure claims are filed to carriers timely.
  • Regular attendance and punctuality for scheduled shifts.
  • Maintains professional and technical knowledge through continuing education opportunities including internal and external educational offerings.
  • Must adhere to safety protocols at all times.
  • Per DRH policy, all required conditions of employment must be met and maintained including required vaccinations.
  • Implement DRH Standards of Behavior and exhibit behaviors consistent with DRH core values.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

title: Senior Pipe Stress Engineer
description:
As a Senior Pipe Stress Engineer, you will provide practical, hands‑on technical expertise within our Engineering Services team on a variety of capital and expense projects for Canada’s largest oil refinery in Saint John, NB, as well as Irving Oil’s network of terminal facilities throughout Canada and the US eastern seaboard. Your goal will be to work alongside team members, project partners, and stakeholders, to successfully plan and execute work, and effectively communicate complex technical issues while building and sustaining piping engineering capabilities. Your success in this position will enable our multi-disciplinary team to execute safely, efficiently, reliably, and productively on engineering deliverables.

What We Offer:

  • Work Environment – Work onsite in our beautiful home office building with access to a fitness facility, onsite nurse, and a café
  • Competitive Compensation – Including an annual bonus plan, pension plan, and parking allowance
  • Flexible Benefits Plan – In effect from day one and offers three levels of coverage to select from to meet your unique, personal needs
  • Paid Vacation – Plus an annual option to purchase additional vacation, too
  • Wellness Support – With an annual wellness allowance, paid personal care days and a 24/7 Employee & Family Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to give back to some amazing causes in our community – Choose when and where to make an impact with a paid volunteer day, company volunteer opportunities and a donation matching program

Your Responsibilities:

  • Provide effective technical leadership and problem-solving guidance for piping system routing and tie-ins, static and dynamic pipe stress analysis (AutoPIPE and Caesar II), selection and specification of pipe materials and engineered specialty items, and piping system compliance to applicable codes, standards and regulations
  • Review, check, and approve (including professional sealing as required) of piping engineering and design deliverables
  • Create, modify or select from existing piping line class specifications for new or upgraded piping systems
  • Perform engineering calculations
  • Engage with vendors, subject matter experts, and other engineering disciplines to resolve static and rotating equipment nozzle designs, arrangements and load limits
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to integrate piping requirements and issues into overall project designs via estimating and scheduling workshops, field walks, 3D model reviews (Navisworks), constructability reviews, P&ID reviews, PHAs, material selection reviews, and risk assessments
  • Engage with 3rd party consultants, contractors, and suppliers in an Owner’s Engineer capacity, which may include scoping, directing, reviewing and approving of outsource engineering work and deliverables, development of RFQs, review of bids, and responding to clarification requests and field changes

Your Skills:

  • Effective technical expert, able to competently manage and review piping engineering activities on multiple projects being developed in parallel
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving skillsets
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills and ability to address complex technical issues, risks, and outcomes
  • Proficiency with applicable codes, standards, and regulations, governing process and utility piping material selection, routing, support and interfaces, including ASME B31.1, 31.3, 31.4, 31.8, BPVC Sections II, VIII, XIII, various API standards, and CSA Z662, B139, B149, and B51
  • Proficiency with static and dynamic pipe stress analysis methods and tools (AutoPIPE or Caesar II) to determine pipe stress and deflections, as well as forces and moments on supporting structures, equipment nozzles, and other fittings and fixtures
  • Ability to work in various field conditions year-round, including wearing full PPE, performing physical tasks, and working at heights and in enclosed spaces

Your Experience:

  • University degree in Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent, with P.Eng. designation (or immediate eligibility) in New Brunswick is required
  • Minimum of 15 years of design experience in process and utility piping design for brownfield industrial facilities, ideally in oil and gas refining or terminals
  • Experience working in a stage-gated capital project environment, where design work progresses incrementally, and project performance and documentation requirements apply
  • Proficiency with either AutoPIPE or Caesar II pipe stress analysis software, and with Plant3D and Navisworks is a strong asset
  • Familiarity with above- and below-ground pipelines (CSA Z662), polymer-lined and refractory-lined steel piping, and pressure tubing/ fittings for pneumatic and hydraulic systems would be an asset


The expected salary range for this position is $95,207 - $148,542. Placement within range will be based on relevant experience, qualifications, and skills.

title: Säljare vikariat på Kappahl Töcksfors

Målet är att lyssna, känna in och hjälpa dem hitta det där nya favoritplagget som kan användas om och om igen.

Tjänsten är vikariat på 20 h/veckan med start enligt överenskommelse.

Mycket har hänt sedan vi började sälja kappor i en källare för snart 70 år sedan. I dag har vi närmare 360 butiker och är en av Nordens ledande modekedjor. Men en sak är sig lik - vårt brinnande intresse för våra kunder.

För att kunna kunna följa med på vår utvecklingsresa söker vi dig som är flexibel, lätt kan ändra fokus och prioritera om. Du har lätt för att känna igen dig i Kappahls värdeord – Inclusive, Courageous och Joyful. Ingen dag är den andra lik, och älskar du liksom vi utmaningar och att arbeta i ett högt tempo är det dig vi söker!

  • Social, utåtriktad och älskar mötet med människor.
  • Brinner för sälj och service och vill ge kunden den bästa shoppingupplevelsen.
  • Älskar att jobba i team och samarbeta med andra för att nå mål.
  • Har stor initiativförmåga och tar ansvar i ditt arbete.
  • Behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
  • Tidigare erfarenhet inom detaljhandeln eller service.

Kappahl Group grundades 1953 i Göteborg och är en av Nordens ledande modekedjor med runt 360 Kappahl- och Newbie-butiker i Sverige, Norge, Finland, Polen och Storbritannien samt online på över 20 marknader i Europa och Asien.

Vi vill göra skillnad i modevärlden och vara en föregångare i branschen genom att alltid hålla våra löften: att ta hand om världen omkring oss, minimera miljöpåverkan för varje plagg och samtidigt uppfylla vårt medarbetarlöfte: " We promise you the right to always be yourself - a place to belong".Idag består Kappahl-teamet av cirka 4 000 kollegor i åtta länder, alla med olika bakgrund, ålder, kunskaper och stil. Vår gemensamma motivation är att skapa en ansvarsfull modevärld och erbjuda mode till en mängd olika människor och livsstilar. Ett ansvarsfullt mode som känns rätt, för bäraren och för den värld vi lever i. Idag är mer än 85 % av produkterna tillverkade av certifierade och/eller spårbara material. Vårt mål är att nå 100 procent år 2025 tillsammans med Kappahl-gruppens övergripande klimatmål om att halvera värdekedjans klimatutsläpp till år 2030. Läs mer på kappahl.se.

title: Air and Ocean Import Operations
description:
Shaping the Future of Logistics- Your Career Starts at Röhlig

Whether it’s sea freight, air freight, or contract logistics, at Röhlig Logistics you’ll help create tailor-made solutions that move the world forward. As a global, family-owned company founded in Bremen, Germany in 1852, we’ve built our reputation on reliability and trusted partnerships.

Join our international team of more than 2,700 colleagues across 35+ countries and collaborate on exciting projects for customers around the world. You’ll work in a supportive, trust-based, and collaborative environment that values open communication and empowers you to share your ideas and grow professionally. At Röhlig, we’re committed to helping you build a long-term career while maintaining a healthy work-life balance — because we believe success is best achieved together.

We are seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented professional to join our Air and Ocean Import team, playing a key role in managing international shipments and ensuring seamless end-to-end operations.

What you will do:

Coordinating Operations with Air & Sea freight Imports

  • Timely processing of import air and sea documents including registration of shipments.
  • Communicates automation details to subcontractors for reporting to customs.
  • Monitors clearance and delivery of cargo within free storage/holding times.
  • Checks for special instructions on documents.
  • Invoice and collection of correct charges.
  • Authorizing delivery of air and sea freight.
  • Monitors availability, and in conjunction with subcontractors, ensures timely collection of cargo, check in to warehouse and reporting to customs.
  • Follow up on delivery with truckers

Financial and Accounting Responsibilities

  • Approve freight invoices, credit notes and monitor transport waiting time costs.
  • Pay carrier local charges, and any other related costs upon arrival, to ensure storage is avoided and no added costs are incurred.
  • Prepare payment vouchers and write checks for authorization, and presentation.
  • Processes air and sea freight debtors & creditors in an expeditious manner by verification prior to handing over to accounts for payment.
  • Ensures the department (cost center) achieves its financial and quality objectives.

Client and Supplier Management

  • Keeps record of discrepancies via the Innovations and Incidents Management (IIM) to ensure compliance.

What you bring:

  • High school graduate and qualification preferred
  • Has knowledge of related computer applications
  • Familiarity with freight forwarding procedures
  • Globally aware of countries and where they are located
  • Up to two years of previous related experience required
  • Excellent customer services & communication skills
  • Above average administration skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Excellent time management
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines
  • Resilient
  • Customer focused
  • Shows initiative and drive

What we offer you:

At Röhlig, we believe in supporting our employees' well-being, growth, and work-life balance. That’s why we offer a competitive benefits package designed to empower you both personally and professionally:

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance – Keeping you and your family healthy is our priority.
  • 401(k) Plan with Company Match – We’re invested in your future and help you save for retirement.
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) – Whether you’re planning a vacation, taking care of personal needs, or just need a mental health day, we’ve got you covered.
  • Supportive Work Environment – From career development opportunities to a collaborative culture, we ensure you feel valued every step of the way.

Apply now and shape the future of logistics with us!

For further information about the position or the application process, please reach out to:

Mark Aulisio

Talent Acquisition Manager

mark.aulisio@rohlig.com

title: Stylist
description:
We consider applications for this position on an ongoing basis.

OVERVIEW

Experience a perfect blend of deliberate purpose and clear-eyed vision. At Ulta Beauty, some of the industry’s most highly-esteemed beauty leaders share themselves, as well as their expertise. Building authentic community. Creating a real sense of belonging—even as they’re plotting a bold, strategic course of exciting innovations destined to revolutionize the industry.

Think robust organizational support. Ever-increasing levels of investment. And a healthy dose of personal empowerment and growth opportunity. All with a company of unwavering strength and stability.

We are the future of beauty services. Be part of the transformation.

GENERAL SUMMARY & SCOPE

The Stylist is responsible for engaging with guests, consulting with them on their hair care needs and recommending products and services. The Stylist delivers quality professional services with an emphasis on the guest’s total look. They support the Experience Manager (EM) and the Assistant Services Manager (ASM) through a focus on performance (service sales, and productivity), people (guest service), and process (operating procedures and compliance standards). This position requires a passion for the beauty industry, exceptional guest service, and the aptitude to learn and communicate product knowledge.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES (*Essential Functions)

The Stylist is a champion of Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision, and values, and should demonstrate them skillfully and consistently by performing the following duties and responsibilities of the position (as well as all other projects/duties as assigned):

Performance

  • Perform hair services including hair design, haircuts, color, texture, hair treatments, styling, updos, perms, blowouts, keratin treatments, extensions, makeup applications, and ear piercing (where applicable).
  • Meet or exceed sales goal of $800 average weekly sales and productivity goals for hair services by delivering exceptional guest service and contribute to meeting or exceeding the store’s goals related to retail and service sales, guest loyalty (including credit), and retail shrink as set by Ulta Beauty.
  • Demonstrate business acumen with understanding of business drivers and identified opportunities for growth.
  • Perform product demonstrations with guests to drive sales and the guest service experience.
  • Support the execution of in-store events, promotions, and marketing-initiatives that deliver an unrivaled guest experience.
  • Take the initiative to stay informed regarding new and existing industry trends, products, and services during work time, and be knowledgeable about the ingredients and benefits of these trends, products, and services to better serve guests.
  • Maintain prompt, regular attendance.

People

  • Develop guest relationships through consultations and appropriate retail and service recommendations.
  • Demonstrate high standards of customer service and salon image standards.
  • Serve all guests, including walk-in guests, in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Develop a partnership with skin therapists and the retail team to provide a total-store and well- rounded guest experience.
  • Establish professional peer and brand partner relationships that foster a shared interest in collaboratively delivering exceptional guest service.
  • Share the benefits of the guest loyalty program, including credit and the Ulta Beauty app, with guests in the salon and on the salesfloor.
  • Attend mandatory trainings and meetings to enable continuous professional development.

Process

  • Be knowledgeable of and ensure compliance with Ulta Beauty policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Follow all safety, sanitation, and infection control procedures before, during, and after services; always ensure compliance with state board guidelines.
  • Follow established service protocols to ensure a consistent and exceptional guest experience.
  • Utilize appropriate booking and clientele systems to book guests for return services and for events.
  • Communicate any supply needs to the EM, ensuring guest readiness at all times.
  • Maintain outstanding store operational standards, including cleanliness of the salon, salesfloor, restrooms, backroom, break area, and any additional assigned area.
  • Adhere to the Ulta Beauty dress code.
  • Protect company assets by following loss prevention best practices and providing exceptional guest service.
  • Execute other operational tasks as directed.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Cosmetology license

Experience

  • Previous relevant salon experience is preferred.

Skills

  • Proficiency with latest salon techniques for performing haircutting, haircolor, lightening, styling, texture, treatment, extensions, makeup, and ear piercing services (where applicable) and/or an aptitude to develop skills and capabilities in all service categories.
  • Proficiency with use of equipment and chemicals needed to perform technical work
  • Proficiency to demonstrate, recommend and sell pro hair care and makeup products
  • Developed communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships, and build clientele

SPECIAL POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Work a flexible schedule to include days, evenings, weekends, and holidays

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Frequent mobility during shift
  • Continuous lifting and/or moving up to 10 lbs. during shift
  • Frequent stooping, kneeling, bending, reaching, twisting, and crouching during shift
  • Ability to stand for long periods of time during shift
  • Continuous and/or frequent coordination and manipulation of objects during shift

If an associate has a disability that prevents them from performing an essential function of the job, the Company will engage in the interactive process with the associate to determine whether there is a reasonable accommodation that will enable the associate to perform the essential functions of the job.

Ulta Beauty is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer, and we encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate based upon race (including traits associated with race, such as hair texture and protective hairstyles like braids, locks, and twists), color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding), sex stereotyping (including assumptions about a person’s appearance or behavior, gender roles, gender expression, or gender identity), gender, gender identity, gender expression, status as a transgender or transsexual individual, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, ancestry, medical condition, marital status, military or veteran status (including honorable discharge from military service), reproductive health decisions, familial status, refugee status, citizenship status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other legally protected status of an individual.




The pay range for this position is $17.00 - $17.00 / Hour with the opportunity for eligible associates to earn services pay pursuant to the Company’s Services Compensation Plan. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, shift, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Eligible associates may also earn overtime pay as required by applicable law and tips paid by service guests. Full-time positions are eligible for paid time off, health, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. Part-time positions are eligible for dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. For additional information concerning our benefits, visit our Benefits and Career Development page: https://learn.bswift.com/ulta

ABOUT

At Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ: ULTA), the possibilities are beautiful. Ulta Beauty is the largest North American beauty retailer and the premier beauty destination for cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products and salon services. We bring possibilities to life through the power of beauty each and every day in our stores and online with more than 25,000 products from approximately 500 well-established and emerging beauty brands across all categories and price points, including Ulta Beauty’s own private label. Ulta Beauty also offers a full-service salon in every store featuring—hair, skin, brow, and make-up services.

We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest records, conviction records, or other criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of any applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the New York City Fair Chance Act.
