title: Family Practitioner
description:
Family Practitioner
Location: Sinfin Family Hub, Derby
Working Hours: 37
Contract Type: Permanent
Salary: £25,867 - £32,090

Please note: The salary listed reflects the full earning potential for this role. Starting salaries depend on experience and progression within the band.

About Waythrough

Waythrough provides specialist support across mental health, alcohol, drugs and related areas. We delivery high-quality, evidence-based services designed around the real needs of the people we serve.


Every year, we support around 125,000 people through over 250 services - and it's all made possible by our 3,500 brilliant staff and volunteers.

Make a real difference in your community

Are you passionate about helping others live safer, healthier, more independent lives? Join our team at Waythrough and support people facing challenges around mental health, substance use, housing or domestic abuse. This is more than just a job – it’s a chance to build meaningful relationships and create lasting change.



About the Role

We’re looking for a passionate and driven practitioner to join our Intensive Family Support Programme, working with families affected by parental substance use. This is a rewarding opportunity to make a real difference—supporting families on the edge of care to create safer, healthier environments for their children.

In this role, you’ll deliver trauma-informed, person-centred support, helping parents and carers build insight, reduce risk, and move towards recovery. You’ll work closely with partner agencies, including Children’s Services and treatment providers, to ensure families receive the right support at the right time.

This is a community-based role, so being able to travel to meet families and partners is essential.

Key Duties

  • Manage a diverse caseload, delivering tailored assessments, support plans, and interventions
  • Build strong, trusting relationships with families and carers to support long-term change
  • Work collaboratively with partner agencies to support engagement with treatment and safeguarding processes
  • Attend and contribute to multi-agency meetings, including Child Protection and PLO processes
  • Deliver a mix of face-to-face and digital interventions, including group work
  • Support families to access community resources and specialist services
  • Promote recovery, resilience, and positive outcomes for the whole family
  • Identify and respond to safeguarding concerns, ensuring the safety of children and vulnerable individuals
  • Maintain accurate, timely records and contribute to service evaluation
  • Take part in ongoing training, supervision, and professional development

About You

You’re someone who is empathetic, resilient, and motivated by making a difference. You’ll have experience supporting vulnerable individuals or families and feel confident working in a fast-paced, multi-agency environment.

You’ll bring:

  • Experience working with families, ideally within substance misuse, social care, or a related field
  • A good understanding of safeguarding and risk management
  • The ability to build trust and engage people in meaningful change
  • Strong communication and organisational skills
  • Confidence using IT systems and managing case records
  • A proactive, flexible approach and a genuine passion for supporting families

Essential: A full UK driving licence and access to a vehicle

What We Offer

We value the people who make a difference every day. Alongside meaningful work, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package:

  • 27 days’ annual leave, rising to 32 after 1 year (plus bank holidays)

  • Pension scheme with 4.5% employer contribution, matched up to 6.5%

  • Life assurance (3× annual salary)

  • Enhanced sick pay and family-friendly pay

  • Birthday leave and the option to buy up to 5 extra days’ annual leave

  • Professional fee reimbursement for relevant qualifications

  • 24/7 online GP access and Employee Assistance Programme

  • Recognition and long service awards via our Way to Go and Aspirations portals

  • £500 Recommend a Friend bonus

  • Cycle to Work scheme and Credit Union membership

  • Discounts via Blue Light Card, Charity Discounts, Extras and Tickets for Good

  • Free will writing service and wellbeing initiatives throughout the year

Inclusion and accessibility

At Aquarius, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from people with lived experience of substance use or recovery, and from candidates from minoritised ethnic communities. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, abilities, and identities to ensure our services are representative of the communities we serve.

title: Etsimme kahvila-pikaruokatyöntekijöitä St1 Kyyjärvelle
description:
HelmiSimpukka-ketjun asemilla pääset työskentelemään erilaisten työtehtävien parissa! Asemat ovatkin tunnettuja reippaasta ja iloisesta palvelusta sekä viihtyisästä ilmapiiristä, jonka luovat aseman iloiset työntekijät! Menestyt työssäsi varmasti, kun olet oma-aloitteinen, palvelualtis ja täyttänyt 18 vuotta – ja mikä tärkeimpänä; sinulla on asenne kunnossa!

Työ on mielenkiintoista sekä sopivasti haastavaa, eikä työpäivien aikana taatusti pitkästy. Omaat aurinkoisen ja joustavan asenteen työntekoon eikä pieni kiirekään kykene haihduttamaan hymyä huuliltasi. Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis ammattilainen töihin tullessasi, sillä asemalla sinut perehdytään ja koulutetaan työhön.

Tässä työssä pääset tekemään ja oppimaan monipuolisia työtehtäviä mm. pizzojen tekemistä, erilaisten pikaruokatuotteiden valmistusta, kassatyötä, siisteydestä huolehtimista, sekä kahviotuotteiden riittävyydestä huolehtimista.

Työtunteja 10-20h/vk sesonki aikana vuoroja on enemmän. Työ on vakituinen, mutta osa-aikainen.

Työtä tehdään arkisin ja viikonloppuisin. Edellytämme sinulta suomen kielen osaamista sekä intoa oppia uusia asioita. Eduksi katsomme aikaisemman kokemuksen liikenneasemaravintolassa tai kahvilassa työskentelystä sekä muusta soveltuvasta asiakaspalvelu- ja kassatyöskentelytyöstä.

Mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme henkilö, laitathan hakemuksen mahdollisimman pian!

Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: Senior Executive, Consumer & Behaviour Insights

NIQ CMI’s Customer Success Team focus on delivering world class insights and reports to the clients and striving for very high level of Customer Satisfaction and advocacy.

Customer Success is NIQ's key department which is instrumental for the company’s success.

So where do you fit here?

A successful candidate for this role will be someone who can establish strong relationships with both our clients and our colleagues. You will quickly become a trusted partner, working with many of our clients’ teams, including marketing, sales, category, and many more.

You will be expected to understand our clients’ needs and then create and present solutions that help achieve their strategic and tactical goals.

title: Verkäufer (m/w/d) - LEGO Store Berlin - Teilzeit
description:
Job Description

Verkäufer (m/w/d) - LEGO Store Berlin - Teilzeit

Dein Herz schlägt höher, wenn Du den Namen LEGO® hörst? Du arbeitest gerne im Verkauf und berätst Kunden, um Ihnen immer wieder aufs Neue ein unvergessliches Kauferlebnis bieten zu können?

Dann komm zu uns und werde Teil unseres Teams!

Begeistere unsere kleinen und großen Kunden und zaubere ihnen ein Lächeln auf das Gesicht. Als Teamplayer trägst Du zu einem besonderen Einkaufserlebnis für unsere Kunden bei. Als Teil unseres Verkäuferteams im LEGO Store Berlin, Tauentzienstraße 8, repräsentierst Du die Marke LEGO mit all ihren Werten.

Diese Bausteine bringen Dich ins Spiel:

- Durch Deine kommunikative, freundliche und aufgeschlossene Art, fällt es Dir leicht, auf Kunden zuzugehen.

- Du hast eine ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung und zeigst verkäuferisches Talent.

- Du sorgst dafür, dass jeder Besuch in unserem Store zu einem Erlebnis wird.

- Du hast bereits Wissen zu LEGO Produkten und bist neugierig auf mehr.

- Du hast gute bis sehr gute Kenntnisse in gesprochenem Deutsch und Englisch.

Bau Deine Karriere Stein für Stein!

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Title: Quality Engineer

The Quality Engineer shall be responsible for ensuring that the products produced meet quality standards required to minimize quality costs and maximize customer satisfaction while ensuring that all quality management system processes are operating effectively.

The duties shall include, but not be limited to the following:

  1. Manage all quality-related issues within the assigned manufacturing teams and associated support departments.
  2. Works with teams to identify root causes and develop/implement effective permanent corrective actions to address product/process quality issues.
  3. Works with stakeholders to resolve quality issues that arise as quickly and efficiently as possible to prevent compromising quality & safety standards.
  4. Performs product, process, and system audits as assigned.
  5. Monitors and reports on quality related KPIs including scrap, rework, PPM levels, customer complaints, and non-conformances.
  6. Responsible for leading / managing/ problem solving projects and Corrective Action activities.
  7. Participates in cross-functional teams responsible for the development of new products and processes required to exceed customer expectations.
  8. Demonstrate efficiency in utilizing dimensional inspection tools such as Optical comparator surface plates, gage blocks, Pin gages, Calipers, Micrometers, Thread gages, CMM usage, height gages, and indicators.
  9. Manage and assign internal auditors in day-to-day workloads.

title: Detention Deputy (On-site)
description:
Job Posting End Date: August 17, 2026 at 11:59pm CSTHiring range: $72,716.80 ($34.96 per hour). Starting rate will depend on experience, education, and qualifications. Advancement opportunities exist for individuals motivated to move up within Anoka County.

Come join our team at Anoka County where you can serve your community while enjoying the benefits of work-life balance! This includes 24 days of paid flexible time off and up to 12.5 holidays your first year.

In order to be considered for this position, information to support your answers must be included in your application. A resume attachment is optional and cannot be used in place of this application. Applications must be received by the closing deadline of 11:59pm on 08/17/2026 in order to be considered.

Position Description

The Anoka County Sheriff’s Office mission is to protect and serve the community in a manner that preserves the public trust. The department has an immediate opening for Detention Deputy who will perform various duties. Some of the critical responsibilities of this position include managing inmate behavior through direct supervision and to provide a secure, safe and humane confinement.

This is a full-time, non-exempt, on-site position.

Pay & Benefits

  • Typical starting salary $72,716.80 ($34.96 per hour).
  • Anoka County Salary Schedule Grade 2106: $34.96 to 49.09 per hour ($72,716.80 to $102,107.20 annually).
  • Lateral wage consideration for experienced candidates.
  • 24 days of paid flexible time off and up to 12.5 paid holidays.
  • Comprehensive insurance, including medical, dental, vision, flex benefits and more at
  • Medical and dental clinic exclusive to employees, located at the Anoka County Government Center.
  • Pension plan and other retirement investment options.
  • Advancement/professional development opportunities.

Work Location

  • This position will work at Anoka County Jail, located at 325 Jackson Street, Anoka, MN 55303.
  • The Anoka County Jail is a 24/7 facility. Detention Deputy schedules include weekends and holidays.

Job Duties and Responsibilities
These examples are not all inclusive and are intended to be illustrative of primary responsibilities of an Anoka County Detention Deputy:

  • Monitor and supervise jail inmates and related activities.
  • Maintain security and safety of facilities, inmates and employees by means of surveillance.
  • Monitor cameras, alarms, doors and security controls.
  • Interact with inmates by enforcing rules and facility regulations. Conduct inmate counts and searches. Prevent the introduction of contraband and weapons into facilities.
  • Respond to and assess emergencies such as disturbances among inmates, fires, escape attempts, contraband recovery, medical situations and restores order and security.
  • Mediate conflicts among inmates and housing units. Diffuse emotional inmates and deescalate tension in housing units.
  • Handle intake and release of inmates.
  • Obtain pertinent information, necessary documentation and proper credentials from arresting or escorting officer prior to receiving or releasing inmates.
  • Supervise recreational and visiting periods.
  • Identify and monitor at risk inmates with mental illness, alcoholism or drug addiction.
  • Provide supervision of inmates during court appearances.
  • Prepare written reports and logs activities.

Qualifications and Requirements:

Minimum Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Needed

  • Requires a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Possess a valid driver’s license.
  • Must be able to credibly testify in a court of law.
  • Must undergo, and pass, a thorough physical and psychological examination and successfully complete a background investigation.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Needed

  • Secondary education in corrections, law enforcement, criminal justice, behavioral/social science or related field.
  • Evidence-Based Practice Corrections Professional Certification from an accredited school.
  • Experience using de-escalation techniques in a work setting.
  • Knowledge of CPR principles, procedures and techniques.
  • Possess an Advanced First Aid certification.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Must be able to credibly testify in a court of law.

NOTE: Applicants are NOT required to be certified by the Minnesota Peace Officer’s Standard Board.

No tattoos, scars, or brands that qualify as “Unauthorized Tattoos” under the Sheriff’s Ofﬁce Policy 1044.3 are allowed under any circumstances by any member of the Anoka County Sheriff’s Ofﬁce. Tattoos on the head, face, neck, or hands are prohibited. Exceptions may be made on a case-by-case basis. (Complete policy available upon request).

Physical Demands and Work Conditions

  • Standard office environment, correctional and detention institutions, field offices, courtrooms, offender'/clients' homes, hospitals and schools, and various community settings depending on assignment.
  • Work activities may involve contact with and the supervision of juveniles or adults charged with major or minor criminal offenses, and/or individuals who may be hostile, dangerous, threatening, armed, and aggressive and/or under the influence of drugs or alcohol. Consequently, some assignments may encounter stressful and physically threatening situations.
  • Vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus, such as to work on computers. Ability to see colors, shades and brightness.
  • Hearing abilities required for general and phone communication, signals, and machine sounds.
  • Ability to detect, discern, and tolerate a wide range of scents required for safety and performance of essential duties.
  • Cognitive abilities required include problem solving, prioritization of tasks, short- and long-term memory, interpreting and understanding written documents, and general mathematical skills.
  • Assignments require several hours of varied physical activity in addition to viewing a computer screen, sitting at a desk, or walking/standing.
  • Physical activity may include handling/carrying equipment, reaching, climbing or balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling. Periodic high levels of exertion in the form of self-defense, pursuit, or restraint of an individual is possible for some assignments.
  • Lifting over 100 lbs. in emergency situations .
  • Equipment used includes computers, phones, and standard office equipment in addition to various law enforcement equipment depending on assignment.
  • Law enforcement equipment may include but is not limited to radios, pagers, handcuffs, first aid equipment, restraints, chemical agents, Tasers, and protective equipment such as masks, goggles, and gloves.
  • Travel between work sites may require driving a county vehicle and/or a personal vehicle.
  • Additional physical/mental requirements that occur may not be listed above, but are inherent in performing the position's essential functions.
  • Exposure to bodily fluids, toxic or caustic chemicals, fumes, or other hazards is possible while performing essential duties.

Union Representation

This position is represented by a collective bargaining agreement between Anoka County and the LELS – Detention Deputy union.

Selection Process

It is important that your application show all the relevant education and experience you possess. This information will determine which candidates will proceed in the selection process. A submitted application is also used to verify the answers to any supplemental questions.

Pre-employment Requirements

Anoka County has determined that successfully passing a pre-employment criminal/driving background check, drug screen and DOT physical, and/or other qualifications checks may be necessary for certain positions. Applicants may be required to sign an informed consent form allowing the County to obtain to conduct such screenings and/or verify their qualifications in connection with the position sought. Applicants who do not sign the informed consent form will not be further considered for the position.

About Anoka County

As the fourth largest county in Minnesota, Anoka County thrives because of the diversity, dedication, determination, and innovation of our employees. United by our mission- Commitment to Excellence: Through collaborative efforts, we seek to improve lives and serve with care, integrity, and professionalism- we offer a wide range of career opportunities for people with a variety of personalities, abilities, knowledge, and life experiences. Together, we work toward a single purpose of serving Anoka County’s 369,000 citizens in a respectful, innovative, and fiscally responsible manner. Commitment to Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employment

Anoka County is committed to the principles of our Affirmative Action Plan and Equal Employment Opportunity. It is the policy of Anoka County to recruit, hire, train, and promote persons in all job titles, without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), national origin, marital status, genetic information, status with regard to public assistance, physical ability, sexual orientation, or age except where such status is a bona fide occupational qualification. It is the policy of Anoka County to make employment decisions in a manner that will further our Affirmative Action Plan and Equal Employment Opportunity.

title: Skolkurator till Bergsgårdsskolan
description:
Beskrivning

Vill du göra skillnad för barn och ungas skolgång och mående? Vi söker nu en skolkurator till Bergsgårdsskolan som vill bli en del av vårt engagerade team! Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på 100 % med placering i både grundskolan och den anpassade grundskolan.

Bergsgårdsskolan är en grundskola med F–6 (2-parallellig) samt en anpassad grundskola för årskurs 1–6. Cirka 330 elever har vi i grundskolan och runt 70 elever tillhör den anpassade grundskolan, fördelade på 13 klasser. Till verksamheten hör även tre fritidsavdelningar. Skolan är belägen i Hjällbo med omedelbar närhet till naturområden och med endast fem minuters gångavstånd från Hjällbo spårvagnshållplats.

Skolan har ett erfaret och välfungerande elevhälsoteam bestående av skolsköterska, kurator, specialpedagog och psykolog som hela tiden finns som ett nära stöd för alla våra elever och medarbetare.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som kurator ingår du i skolans, och skolområdets, elevhälsoteam och bidrar med psykosocial kompetens på organisations-, grupp-, och individnivå. I elevhälsoarbetet samverkar du med bland andra lärare, skolsköterska, specialpedagog, psykolog, skolläkare och biträdande rektor.

Teamets uppdrag är att tillsammans med biträdande rektor och arbetslag arbeta hälsofrämjande och förebyggande för att stärka barn och ungdomars möjligheter att uppnå målen.

Utöver ditt lokala team på Bergsgårdsskolan har du också ett nära samarbete och utbyte med övriga kuratorer i Hjällbo skolområde.

I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår att:

  • Delta i skolans kontinuerliga värdegrunds- och trygghetsarbete samt genomföra insatser i grupp och klass.
  • Hålla i stödsamtal samt samverka med och stödja vårdnadshavare. Erbjuda konsultation till skolans personal.
  • Göra sociala utredningar inför mottagande i anpassad grundskola, skolsociala utredningar och utredningar av elevers frånvaro.
  • Dokumentera ditt arbete i PMO. Du har god kännedom om Socialtjänstlagen, Skollagen och övriga styrdokument.
  • Samverka med externa aktörer såsom socialtjänst, BUP, UPH, habilitering, fritid samt SSPF och Rätt kurva.

Inom Grundskoleförvaltningen medverkar du på professionsträffar en gång i månaden tillsammans med kuratorskollegor och professionsutvecklare, samt deltar i extern handledning. Kuratorer i förvaltningen utgår från en gemensam uppdragsbeskrivning. Som ny kurator hos oss får du en god introduktion samt en mentor.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har socionomexamen eller motsvarande högskoleutbildning som bedöms som relevant av arbetsgivaren. Det är meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete som kurator, liksom erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn och unga.

Meriterande är även om du har:

- Erfarenhet av arbete inom socialtjänsten

- Erfarenhet av främjande och förebyggande insatser

- Utbildning i samtalsmetodik / handledning

Personliga kvalifikationer

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen är du stabil, empatisk, prestigelös och trygg i din yrkesroll. Du har ett stort engagemang för barn och ungdomars psykosociala situation och har en genuin förmåga att möta människor i olika livssituationer. Du har lätt för att skapa relationer och är professionell och respektfull i ditt bemötande av elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor. Genom ditt arbetssätt möjliggör du barns berättande och medverkar till att elevernas delaktighet och perspektiv lyfts fram.

Yrkesrollen kräver en hög grad av självständighet, samarbetsförmåga och personlig mognad. Du har ett intresse av att arbeta i en pedagogisk miljö och i team med olika professioner. I ditt arbete är du strukturerad och tydlig, tar initiativ och fattar beslut inom ramen för ditt uppdrag, samt prioriterar dina insatser tillsammans med rektor och övrig elevhälsa. Du trivs med att arbeta med komplexa frågor, ser möjligheter och är kreativ. Du behåller lugnet i svåra situationer och kan fatta välgrundade beslut även under tidspress. Du har dessutom en god förmåga att formulera dig väl i både tal och skrift.

Stämmer beskrivningen in på dig?

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Övrigt

Göteborgs Stad tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning. Här kan du få mer information om bland annat lönestatistik: Lön, ersättningar och förmåner - Göteborgs Stad

Som anställd i vår förvaltning erbjuds du bland annat friskvårdsbidrag, cykelförmån och medarbetarstöd.

Enligt Skollagen ska utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister uppvisas av personer innan de anställs inom förskoleverksamhet, skola och skolbarnomsorg. Detta beställer du på Polisens hemsida.

Inför denna rekrytering har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och därför undanber vi oss ytterligare erbjudanden om kompetensförmedling, annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.

Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem i enlighet med GDPR.

Om oss

Vi skapar framtiden i Göteborg – en lektion i taget

Varje vardag möts tusentals barn och unga i våra skolor – med dem formar vi framtidens Göteborg. I grundskoleförvaltningen är vi 10 000 engagerade medarbetare som jobbar tillsammans för att alla elever ska få lyckas och växa, oavsett bakgrund eller förutsättningar. Du har en viktig roll i att skapa en likvärdig skola med hög kvalitet, där du både får utvecklas och utveckla verksamheten. Du bygger kunskap, gemenskap och framtidstro tillsammans med dina kollegor. Hos oss får du vara med och göra skillnad – på riktigt.

Göteborgs grundskoleförvaltning ansvarar för stadens närmare 140 kommunala skolor, från förskoleklass till årskurs 9, anpassad grundskola, fritidshem och kulturskola. Välkommen att arbeta nära skogen, staden eller havet. Vi är Göteborg.

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitaja, 2 kpl
description:
Meillä pääset vaikuttamaan työhösi, sillä annamme aktiivisuudelle ja uusille ideoille tilaa. Oppimiskäsitystämme ohjaavat leikki ja lasten mielenkiinnon kohteet sekä myönteiset vuorovaikutustaidot.
Liedon varhaiskasvatuksessa meille on tärkeää, että koet työsi mielekkäänä ja pääset nauttimaan työn imusta. Tämä mahdollistuu sillä, että työntekijänä voit hyödyntää osaamistasi ja vahvuuksiasi laaja-alaisesti työssäsi.

Varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitajana suunnittelet, toteutat ja arvioit lapsiryhmän perushoitoa, huomioit lasten erityistarpeet, jaat osaamistasi tiimissä, osallistut lapsen varhaiskasvatussuunnitelman / esiopetuksen oppimissuunnitelman toteutukseen sekä lapsiryhmän toiminnan suunnitteluun. Olet tiimin vahva osaaja hoivan ja huolenpidon osalta ja vastaat tarvittaessa lasten lääkehoidosta, johon saat aina tarvittavan perehdytyksen ja opastuksen.

Tehtävien ensisijaiset sijoituspaikat ovat:

1. Viherkodon päiväkoti Liedon keskustan alueella. Päiväkoti koostuu Viherkodon päiväkodista (4 ryhmää) ja esiopetusyksiköstä (3 ryhmää) Jokilaakson koululla. Päiväkotiin haetaan 1 määräaikaista varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitajaa ajalle 31.8.2026 - 31.1.2027

2. Kisapuiston päiväkoti Liedon keskustan alueella. Päiväkodissa on yksi ryhmä. Päiväkotiin haetaan 1 määräaikaista varhaiskasvatuksen lastenhoitajaa ajalle 7.9. - 31.12.2026

Tarjoamme sinulle
- Mahdollisuuden tehdä monipuolista ja mielenkiintoista työtä Liedon varhaiskasvatuksessa
- Toimintakulttuurin, jossa vasun mukainen pedagoginen kehittäminen on keskiössä
- Työyhteisön, jossa autamme toisiamme ja huumori kukoistaa
- Tukea työhösi esihenkilön, varhaiskasvatuksen laaja-alaisen erityisopettajan, varhaiskasvatuksen kiertävän toimintaterapeutin ja digipedagogin taholta.
- Digitaalisesti erittäin hyvin varustellun varhaiskasvatusympäristön
- Työhyvinvointia tukevia palveluita mm. maksuton kuntosali

Odotamme sinulta
- Olet ottanut varhaiskasvatussuunnitelman haltuun ja osaat käyttää sitä työssäsi
- Lapsi ja hänen tarpeensa ovat aina työsi keskiössä
- Kiinnität huomiota siihen, miten otat lapset huomioon päivittäisessä toiminnassasi
- Sinulla on taito ohjata leikkiä innostavasti ja lapsia osallistaen
- Työskentelyäsi ohjaa pitkäjänteisyys ja johdonmukaisuus
- Kohtaat perheet arvostavasti
- Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityötaitoja, sensitiivisyyttä ja joustavaa työotetta

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on varhaiskasvatuslain 28 §:n mukainen tutkinto. Kelpoisuuden osoittavat alkuperäiset todistukset pyydetään esittämään mahdollisessa haastattelutilaisuudessa. Haastattelut pidetään 18.8.2026.

Tehtävään valitun on ennen työsopimuksen allekirjoittamista esitettävä lain 504/2002 tarkoittama rikosrekisteriote. Tehtävässä edellytetään tartuntatautilain 55§:n mukaista terveydentilan selvitystä hengityselinten tuberkuloosista.

Noudatamme valinnassa KVTESin mukaista koeaikaa.
Tehtävä on haettavana sähköisesti Kuntarekryssä 16.8.2026 mennessä.

Tehtäväkohtainen tasopalkka 2580,14 €/kk - 2684,98 €/kk+ mahdolliset lisät

Liedon kaupunki on savuton työpaikka.

Liedossa 4.8.2026

title: Backend QA Engineer
description:
Location: London hybrid, a minimum of 3 days in teh office a week.

Contract: 6-month fixed-term contract

Diversity matters
We are building a brand that represents the people of the world. It’s what you do that counts, and we are always looking to expand perspectives and voices to shape our future.

We see you, we celebrate you, we want you!

Who we are
You might know us as the inventors of the bath bomb, but there’s more to this great-smelling, partly employee-owned, family-run company than pioneering cosmetics. We believe our business should put more back into the world than it takes and demonstrate that capitalism can be a force for good.

The Living Wage Foundation’s statement 'a hard day's work deserves a fair day's pay' is one that we are proud to commit to in the UK. As an accredited Living Wage employer, we put our people first and fight cruel practices like animal testing, promote regeneration, and show that it is what’s inside that counts - whether that’s an ingredient in a product, or the minerals in a smartphone.

The role
Lush Digital has embarked on a total transformation, placing digital at the center of everything we do. Having established a global platform, we are now seeking an experienced Backend QA Engineer to join our high-performing, cross-functional engineering team.

In this role, you’ll focus on the engine under the hood—ensuring our APIs, databases, microservices, and server-side logic are fast, reliable, secure, and built to scale. You will work across product teams to validate approaches, catch complex edge cases early, drive automation, and ensure feature updates never compromise global stability.

Want to see where a career at Lush could take you? Head over here to explore real stories of growth and development across the business.

Please note: We may close this vacancy early if we receive an overwhelming response or our business requirements change.
  • API & Backend Validation: Design, execute, and maintain test suites for GraphQL and REST APIs, verifying payload structures, status codes, and optimal response times.
  • Automation & Integration: Build and maintain automated test frameworks for backend services in TypeScript or Python, integrating automated E2E test runs into our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Data & Architecture Testing: Write complex database queries (SQL/NoSQL) to verify data flow, migration scripts, and backend consistency. Test distributed microservices and asynchronous workflows (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub).
  • Performance & Security: Conduct performance and load testing using tools like Grafana k6 or JMeter. Assess backend security against OWASP API Top 10 guidelines and verify authentication mechanisms (JWT, OAuth).
  • Defect Diagnosis & Observability: Use tracing tools (e.g., Grafana Tempo) and log analysis to isolate complex breakpoints and collaborate with Developers and DevOps on root-cause fixes.
  • Agile Collaboration: Serve as an active member of an autonomous agile team, preparing test scenarios, supporting continuous testing, and advocating for quality in planning and architecture discussions.
  • Experienced: 2+ years of dedicated software testing experience with a strong focus on backend architecture, API testing, and data integrity.
  • API & Database Proficient: Hands-on experience with API tools (Postman, REST Assured, Insomnia) and database querying (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or DynamoDB).
  • Automation Skilled: Comfortable writing and maintaining backend test suites in TypeScript or Python.
  • Environment Savvy: Working knowledge of Docker containerization for local testing and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
  • Analytical & Collaborative: Excellent root-cause analysis skills, strong technical communication, and a proactive approach to highlighting risks and edge cases early.

Desirable

  • Prior experience in performance and load testing (k6, JMeter, Locust, Gatling).
  • Familiarity with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and distributed microservices.
  • Understanding of security compliance standards (OWASP, NIST 2.0 CSF).
  • Experience in retail, e-commerce, or fast-paced digital operations.
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • 6 months of full pay for parental leave (primary caregiver must qualify for SMP)*
  • Enhanced paternity leave*
  • Bonus scheme
  • Day off for weekday birthdays
  • Holiday purchase scheme
  • 50% discount on Lush products and spa treatments
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Discounted rail and bus season tickets
  • Employee assistance programme
  • There’s a big difference between "Flexible Working " (the legal minimum) and working flexibly. What that looks like varies from role to role and location to location. We actively welcome conversations about what working flexibly could mean and look like for you.
  • We’re 10% Employee Owned - all colleagues play a role in protecting our ethics, our independence, contributing ideas for the future and share in the rewards of success when the company is doing well.
  • Wellbeing & mindfulness sessions
  • Access to employee-led Community Networks, including Disability and Chronic Illness, Family Support, Global Majority (Race and Ethnicity), LGBTQIA+, Menopause and Neurodiversity communities.

title: Operational Safety Lead - Water Utilities
description:
The Operational Safety Lead - Water Utilities provides specialist health, safety, environmental and quality support across capital delivery projects within the UK water sector. The role supports the safe delivery of water and wastewater treatment works, pumping stations, pipelines, reservoirs and network infrastructure from design through construction and commissioning.

You will be responsible for health, safety, environment and quality aspects of work delivered through our [water] contracts centred in [Worsley]. This role links to a wider central Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ) team meaning you will be responsible for communicating and cascading (HSEQ) initiatives, systems, processes, activities, regulatory and compliance requirements across the business.

Your role will entail advancing compliance within the contracts, exhibiting leadership qualities and establishing the benchmarks we anticipate everyone to adhere to. Effective interaction with clients and operational teams will be pivotal, ensuring alignment with Health, Safety, Environment, and Quality (HSEQ) objectives, construction, design and management legislation, other relevant regulations, and standards across all contract activities.
  • You will provide technical Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ) & CDM guidance and support directly to the contract/s.
  • Ensure all project stakeholders comply with CDM 2015 regulations, assist in the preparation and coordination of pre-construction information (PCI).
  • Review and contribute to the development of Construction Phase Plans (CPP)
  • You will have a passion for ensuring exceptional levels of health, safety, quality and environmental standards are delivered; putting in place the processes and reports to continually monitor and maintain quality standards.
  • Lead by example offering guidance, support and coaching as needed to the project.
  • Review, approve, and oversee the quality, progress, and compliance of Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ) plans to ensure adherence to standards and objectives.
  • Review workstream activities and contract risks including 1st line, 2nd line and 3rd line of defences (Operational, Strategic, Regulatory, Environment).
  • Formulate roadmaps and strategic plans to address key risk areas or promote best practices, aligning with the company's values of continuous improvement.
  • Undertake audits as per targets agreed within the Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ) plan.
  • Assume leadership in managing all high-potential or high-severity incidents, assigning responsibilities to an agreed investigation team. Oversee the completion of incident reports and ensure the closure of corrective actions. Being a point of escalation as agreed on the Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ) plan.
  • Implement corporate standards and governance interpret this and client requirements into local arrangements and ensure successful implementation.
  • Work collaboratively with fellow Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ) Leads, members of the leadership team, and other stakeholders to achieve organisational goals and promote a culture of health and safety excellence.
  • Review and authorise Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ) documentation, including any modifications to management systems, ensuring compliance with established standards and regulations.
  • You will work closely with the wider Operational Team to maintain strong relationships and improve processes/systems wherever possible.
  • Support in client-facing performance reviews and engagement forums and where requested attend.
  • Approve local induction materials produced by the Health, Safety, Environment and Quality (HSEQ) Advisors specific to the contract.
  • You will support the contract on training and competency requirements, ensuring that the contracts are achieving the highest standards of training compliance.
  • Support Operational Leads with arrangements, contents and deliver of safety stand downs or workshops.
  • You will lead by example and strive to drive the correct safety behaviours on-site, within depots and within our offices.

Technical Competencies and Experience
  • CDM Regulations and Principal Contractor assurance.
  • Temporary Works assurance including compliance with BS 5975.
  • Confined space entry, rescue planning and permit compliance.
  • Lifting operations assurance in accordance with LOLER and BS 7121.
  • Excavation safety, buried services, utility avoidance and permit controls.
  • Process safety awareness for water and wastewater treatment assets.
  • Isolation (mechanical, electrical and process), commissioning and decommissioning activities.
  • Water Industry Registration Scheme (WIRS)
  • Environmental Awareness
  • Quality Management Systems
Water Sector Experience
  • Water networks, infrastructure and assets
  • Wastewater networks, infrastructure and assets
  • Pumping stations
  • Pipeline installation and rehabilitation
  • MEICA installation and commissioning
Essential Qualifications
  • H&S qualification e.g. NEBOSH Diploma
  • IOSH managing safely
  • TechIOSH/GradIOSH or working towards Chartered status
  • Full UK Driving Licence.
Desirable Qualifications
  • Temporary Works
  • Confined Space Management
  • IEMA Foundation or equivalent environmental qualification.
  • Internal Auditor qualification
  • Accident/investigation training
Key Skills
  • Strong technical understanding of construction risk.
  • Ability to influence operational teams and contractors.
  • Excellent investigation, reporting and communication skills.
  • Working knowledge of water industry standards and client frameworks.
  • Demonstrate leadership skills, mentor, coach and motivate others
  • Strive for excellence and consistently achieve exceptional outcomes.
  • Consistently meet or exceed expectations by executing plans effectively and setting ambitious goals to raise standards.
  • Demonstrate decisiveness and quick-thinking abilities.
  • Skilfully manage time, prioritising tasks to ensure successful completion.
  • Proficiently handle multiple priorities, tracking responsibilities with precision.
  • Exhibit outstanding analytical, organisational, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Take initiative and maintain meticulous attention to detail.
  • Showcase enthusiasm and foster strong relationships with key stakeholders.
Success Measures
  • Delivery of proactive HSEQ assurance across projects.
  • Compliance with CDM and statutory obligations.
  • Reduction in repeat audit findings and incidents.
  • High-quality support to project delivery teams.
We offer a competitive salary based on experience along with a full benefits package.

title: Sr. Program Director
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


The Global Facilities Delivery (GFD) Organization, part of Corporate Engineering and Continuous Improvement delivers new and renovated capital assets around the world. Our mission is accomplished through a highly leveraged organization of design, construction, and qualification contractors. Many of the assets delivered focus on medical innovation and delivering innovative

solutions to patients. Some of the assets delivered will expand the supply of existing medicines or strengthen the supply chain.

Key Objectives/Deliverables:

Project Management:

Lead and manage teams to deliver large programs of at least $1BN USD or more in capital assets and/or highly business-critical in nature. These teams will consist of both Lilly and Non-Lilly professionals to safely achieve project objectives from front-end planning (conceptual design) in a Brownfield or Greenfield site through operational qualification (cradle to grave). Project objectives are defined as delivering asset capability or capacity with safety, cost, schedule, and quality assurance.

Interface/Communication:

Ability to lead from a regional distance from corporate headquarters and while developing and maintaining effective communication with GFD leadership, the project team, governance teams, business partners, and other stakeholders. Facilitate issue resolution, anticipate scope changes, and implement safely with quality, speed, and value.

Compliance:

Lead with a disciplined, structured approach to project management based on compliance with Company Policies and Procedures.

Safety/Environment:

Develop and maintain safety and environmental execution plans for projects. Ensure compliance with safety and environmental policies, procedures, and work rules for project personnel, contractors, and subcontractors from conceptual design through operational verification.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor of Science – Engineering field or related to project management or equivalent experience.

  • Minimum 15+ Years of previous experience in capital project delivery in industrial or manufacturing facilities.

  • Previous experience managing greenfield projects.

  • Willingness to relocate and/or travel to locations outside of home state/country.

Additional Preferences:

  • Previous experience on projects or multiple projects of $1Bn.

  • Pharma manufacturing experience.

  • Capital Project Management Experience in Pharma manufacturing facilities, such as: Bulk API, sterile products, secondary packaging, Devices and to a lesser extent lab projects.

  • Experience in the following areas: GMP manufacturing, LEAN, Automation, construction, construction quality, project controls, the engineering disciplines, safety, scheduling.

  • The capacity to achieve results and influence through people is critical.

  • Demonstrated ability to work from long distances with little supervision.

  • Must exhibit a good sense of judgment in decision making, without the need for management approval while at the same time keeping management informed and engaged on critical issues.

  • Effective communication skills both written and verbal.

  • Ability to influence personnel and organizations without having direct administrative responsibility for them.

  • Competency in a foreign language(s).

  • Professional Engineer (PE) or equivalent technical certification.

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

  • Experience in working and/or living outside the U.S.

  • Demonstrated willingness to embrace the concept of continuous improvement and be an agent for change.

title: Project Manager - Malta based
description:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

About the role:

As a Project Manager, you will be the strategic and technical leader behind some of our most meaningful engineering projects. You will guide cross‑functional teams through every stage—from identifying opportunities and building business cases to planning, execution, and successful implementation.

You will join a dynamic and globally connected team based in Malta, supporting manufacturing sites across EMEA and APAC. We drive end‑to‑end initiatives in product design, material changes, and cost optimization, partnering closely with multiple functions to ensure our solutions enhance quality, efficiency, and patient impact.

This individual leads teams in financial analysis, including market research, cash flow analysis, capital planning, and project cost evaluation and ensures effective communication with stakeholders and business partners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority across multiple geographic locations to achieve project goals.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional technical teams in defining milestones to achieve launch-date commitments and identify issues and risks associated with project plans throughout the planning and execution of projects.
  • Identify and evaluate cost-optimization opportunities across materials, components, and processes throughout several Baxter sites, with a specific focus on insourcing, alternate sourcing, and process and product value engineering.
  • Develop and maintain accurate project schedules and drive execution with the core team, and technical support groups in order to achieve milestones.
  • Support change-control processes, validation activities, and implementation planning.
  • Partner closely with Procurement, R&D, Quality, Operations, and Suppliers to identify, validate, and implement cost-optimization opportunities while maintaining product performance, regulatory compliance, and supply continuity.
  • Identify and communicate project risks and potential conflicts, develop risk mitigation plans and proactive solutions, and lead proactive risk response strategies that guarantee project deliverables.

What You'll Bring

  • Minimum 5 years of experience having a Bachelor's degree in an engineering field (Mechanical, Materials, Plastics, Chemicals, Packaging, Manufacturing or related field)

  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects in a matrix organization.

  • Strong skills in project planning, budgeting, risk management, and executive stakeholder communication.

  • Candidates with experience in regulated industries such as medical, pharma and automotive will be given preference

  • Experience leading cross-functional projects end-to-end using structured project management methods

  • Strong communication skills and cross-functional influence skills.

  • Willingness to travel internationally (approximately 10% of the time based on business needs).

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Baxter, we are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. The minimum salary for this position is €36.000 annually. Your initial pay could be at the minimum or higher based on skills and expertise, experience, and other relevant factors, all of which are subject to change. This position may also be eligible for competitive benefits, discretionary bonuses, and/or long-term incentive. title: Per Diem EMS Dispatcher
location: EMS BH EMS LLC - Bristol, CT 06010
description:
At Bristol Health, we begin each day caring today for your tomorrow. We have been an integral part of our community for the past 100 years. We are dedicated to providing the best possible care and service to our patients, residents and families. We are committed to provide compassionate, quality care at all times and to uphold our values of Communication, Accountability, Respect and Empathy (C.A.R.E.). We are Magnet ® and received the 2020 Press Ganey Leading Innovator award for our rapid adoption and implementation of healthcare solutions during the COVID-19 pandemic. Use your expertise, compassion, and kindness to transform the patient experience. Make a difference. Make Bristol Health your choice.

Bristol Health EMS (Emergency Medical Services) Dispatcher is responsible for the prompt notification and activation of EMS system resources for emergent and non-emergent transportation. The position is responsible for facilitating continuous throughput of patients from all points of entry within the Bristol Health EMS service area. The EMS Dispatcher will work directly with public safety agencies, Case Managers, Nurses and other stakeholders across the Bristol Health EMS service area and is the liaison between EMS agencies and the Case Managers. The position applies clinical and industry knowledge for the appropriate activation and tracking of EMS resources. This position reports to the Bristol Health EMS Supervisor assigned responsibility for Dispatch Operations.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:

  • Receives, interprets, intercepts and processes all emergent and non-emergent transfer into and out of the Bristol Health EMS system that requires response of an ambulance, wheelchair van or service performed by an EMS agency.
  • Establishes priority of multiple EMS requests and assigns agencies in order of availability.
  • Communicates with EMS agencies that assist Bristol Health EMS to receive and communicate information, keeping track of EMS locations and demands on each service.
  • Records variety of information compiled during a shift and logs follow up to be done when necessary. This includes time stamps, data queries, transfer delays, and more.
  • Assist in increasing effective bed capacity at Bristol Hospital by identifying barriers in bed assignment processes and collaborate with nursing and case managers in the resolution of these issues.
  • Documents and reports on timeliness of patient placement activities and issues of concern related to efficient throughput..
  • Achieve seamless delivery of services by appropriately involving colleagues, physicians, nurses and other staff to ensure commitment, communication and cross-functional linkage.
  • Ensures successful and consistent execution of Bristol Health EMS policies and procedures.
  • Ensures that continuous performance improvement forms a basis for efficient patient throughput.
  • Ensures that all clinical services work in synergy to support efficient delivery of care.
  • Works with EMS agencies and case managers to effectively triage clinical needs of patients to assure the appropriate resources are utilized to support patient transfers.
  • Collaborates with clinical leadership and management to define, reduce, and eliminate barriers within the system which may negatively affect patient throughput/efficient delivery of care.
  • Participates in the identification and implementation of strategic efforts to support patient throughput by influencing unit management and championing projects.
  • Supports unit/department management in the facilitation of inter- and intra-unit problem resolution.
  • Actively participates in and contributes to meetings and organizational initiatives with Provides valid, timely and effective feedback to unit/department leadership as to the management performance related to patient throughput.
  • Collaborates with senior leadership in regard to issues related to off shift activity and patient placement/bed availability.
  • Ensures the confidentiality of appropriate patient, staff and management data is maintained.
  • Models customer service standards and demonstrates value for all people in the work environment.
  • Effectively models and upholds a customer service orientation with staff to meet the legitimate needs of all internal and external customers.
  • In collaboration with management, ensures that customer relations standards reflecting excellence consistent with organizational policy for internal./external customers are appropriately met.
  • Maintains a strong working knowledge of all applicable computer systems that will affect and support EMS activities.
  • Demonstrates a strong ability to multitask by utilizing multiple computer systems

title: Group Product Manager-Content Intelligence
description:
Join PatientPoint to be part of a dynamic team creating change in and around the doctor’s office. As a leading digital health company, we innovate to positively impact patient behaviors. Our purpose-driven approach offers an inspirational career opportunity where you can contribute to improving health outcomes for millions of patients nationwide.

Location: Remote

Travel Requirements: 10-15 days per year

Job Summary
PatientPoint is seeking a Group Product Manager (GPM) to lead the evolution of our content tools, services and API’s. With a focus on product discovery and delivery in partnership with our customer-facing product teams and in alignment with content partners, you’ll be the driving force behind the product team, responsible for solving for the future of PatientPoint’s content capabilities, creating measurable impact, and helping mature best practices as we build our product-led culture.

In this role, you will operate as a senior player-coach, with accountability for product outcomes for the content platform and enabling outcomes for stream-aligned product teams that support core and Precision products. You’ll coach, improve and achieve PatientPoint’s product practice standards within the Content Intelligence domain. And you’ll manage a product manager responsible for PatientPoint’s provider hub, determining the future for content tools that are both internally and customer-facing.

This is a hands-on role that requires strong product instincts, ability to navigate ambiguity with structured thinking, strong data acumen, a sense of urgency, ability to lead through change, and a relentless focus on value creation.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the strategy, roadmap and outcomes for the content intelligence platform (digital platform and tools used to ingest, store and smartly deliver content to products in provider offices and Precision partner products). Source information from experts, partners, stakeholders and customers to frame customer problems that are worth solving. Adapt the product strategy and then translate it into meaningful product bets that align with PatientPoint’s mission and OKR’s.
  • Be the expert for a product and/or product group. Serve as the expert for provider content experiences at the point of care, staying informed on market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics. Conduct competitor product teardowns, understand rational for content capability differentiation in the market, and educate product peers and internal partners/stakeholders on opportunities.
  • Lead product discovery and delivery. Partner closely with peer product teams, engineering, design, content and business partners to frame the right problems, run structured discovery, validate solutions, and deliver high-quality product experiences. And ensure alignment with portfolio leadership proactively.
  • Champion AI-forward product development. Leverage AI as an enabling capability in every aspect of product development and solutioning – enabling faster alignment, communication, analysis and document creation that power faster-time-to-insights and time-to-market; and best-in-class product capabilities and experiences.
  • Drive measurable business impact. Define success through clear KPIs and OKRs tied to engagement, retention, and revenue. Establish dashboards and new metrics as needed. Continuously assess performance, generate insights, and prioritize with data. Help the team interpret performance data and iterate quickly.
  • Prioritize and effectively manage expectations. Gather input from your team(s) and working group to inform your perspective, and then prioritize aggressively to focus the team’s investment on the most impactful work to achieve goals.
  • Champion Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with Provider Sales, Client Sales, Customer Support, Data, and other partners to ensure alignment, velocity, smooth delivery, and strong go-to-market execution.
  • Elevate the Voice of the Customer. Serve as the conduit between the customer, content and the business. Use empathy, insight, and curiosity to deeply understand user needs and behaviors. Iterate/advance tactics used by PatientPoint to build user empathy.
  • Lead through influence. Operate as a senior IC who sets direction, raises the bar for product thinking, and contributes to a strong product culture. Mentor product and sr. product peers, with future people leadership potential. May manage and coach 1-2 product professionals.

What We Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) or a related field is required.
  • 6+ years of experience in product management, product development, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated success owning and scaling content platform products with measurable outcomes connected to business strategy.
  • Strong product discovery skills and deep experience validating ideas before heavy investment (ex. experience with A/B testing, experimentation frameworks, and hypothesis-driven development).
  • Proven ability to translate strategy into actionable roadmaps and product bets
  • High data literacy and comfort defining, gathering (w/ SQL or similar), tracking, and interpreting product metrics
  • Strong business acumen and ability to balance customer, revenue, and technical considerations
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills; can align execs, partners and engage teams.
  • Fluency with modern product tools (Jira, Confluence, Looker, Mixpanel, Figma) and Agile methodologies.
  • Fluency with modern AI platforms (Claude, ChatGPT, Figma Make, etc.).

Desired Qualifications

  • MBA or related Masters degre
  • Previous experience at growth- or mature-stage companies with mature product organizations; leveraging a modern product operating model with dedicated prod-eng teams and outcome-led goals.
  • Previous experience in healthcare/health tech, or environment with similar data privacy considerations
  • Previous experience with recommendation systems and mixed media types including articles, video, infographics and innovative formats.
  • Previous experience with DOOH platforms such as BroadSign, SignageOS, or similar is a plus

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • You can move between strategy and execution with ease - connecting the “why” to the “what” and “how.”
  • You are able to see the field, from internal opportunities to external competition, and define the path toward transformational growth. You don’t just ship features - you solve real problems and prove it with data.
  • You are self-sufficient in defining the right metrics to track in an unstructured environment, and proficient in pulling the data you need with minimal support.
  • You’re a trusted partner to engineers, designers and business partners, and know how to co-lead with humility and clarity. You are able to model and mentor product management best practices within your peer group.
  • You are able to mature processes, measurement and product capabilities with some degree of autonomy, connecting dots across the portfolio.
  • You thrive in ambiguity, drive momentum, and keep teams focused on outcomes. You proactively manage expectations in a complex environment of partners and stakeholders, to sustain alignment and momentum.
  • You advocate for the customer without losing sight of business constraints.
  • You lead through influence and foster accountability without command-and-control tactics.

Base Salary Band: $166,000.00 - $231,700.00

Compensation: At PatientPoint, we are committed to providing competitive pay and benefits that are in line with industry standards. We analyze and carefully consider several factors when determining compensation, including skills, qualifications, geographic location, and professional experience, which can cause your compensation to vary. The base salary range listed is just one component of PatientPoint’s total compensation package for employees. For additional details on our total benefits package, please review the section “About PatientPoint” at the end of this job description.

About PatientPoint: PatientPoint® is the Point of Change company, transforming the healthcare experience through the strategic delivery of behavior-changing content at critical moments of care. As the nation’s largest and most impactful digital network in 30,000 physician offices, we connect patients, providers and health brands with relevant information that is proven to drive healthier decisions and better outcomes. Learn more at patientpoint.com.

Latest News & Innovations:

  1. Why is PatientPoint a Best Place to Work! Read More
  2. Teammate Honored as "Top Woman in Tech". Read More
  3. Recognized on Vault’s Top Internship List. Read More

What We Offer:
We know you bring your whole self to work every day, and we are committed to supporting our full-time teammates with a comprehensive range of modernized benefits and cultural perks. We offer competitive compensation, flexible time off to recharge, hybrid work options, mental and emotional wellness resources, a 401K plan, and more. While these benefits are available to full-time team members, we strive to create a positive and supportive environment for all teammates.

title: Social-First 3D & Concept Artist
description:
Who is Blueprint?

We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States. Unified by a shared passion for solving complicated problems, our people are our greatest asset. We use technology as a tool to bridge the gap between strategy and execution, powered by the knowledge, skills, and the expertise of our teams, who all have unique perspectives and years of experience across multiple industries. We’re bold, smart, agile, and fun.

What does Blueprint do?

Blueprint helps organizations unlock value from existing assets by leveraging cutting-edge technology to create additional revenue streams and new lines of business. We connect strategy, business solutions, products, and services to transform and grow companies.

Why Blueprint?

At Blueprint, we believe in the power of possibility and are passionate about bringing it to life. Whether you join our bustling product division, our multifaceted services team or you want to grow your career in human resources, your ability to make an impact is amplified when you join one of our teams. You’ll focus on solving unique business problems while gaining hands-on experience with the world’s best technology. We believe in unique perspectives and build teams of people with diverse skillsets and backgrounds. At Blueprint, you’ll have the opportunity to work with multiple clients and teams, such as data science and product development, all while learning, growing, and developing new solutions. We guarantee you won’t find a better place to work and thrive than at Blueprint.

In This Role

You will create high-quality 3D artwork and visual concepts for a globally recognized gamingfranchise, primarily supporting social media, paid media, marketing campaigns, product launches, and community-focused initiatives. You will translate creative briefs and strategic ideas into engaging visual work that feels playful, culturally relevant, and native to social platforms rather than overly promotional.

This is a hands-on creative role for someone who combines strong 3D and concept-art expertise with a social-first mindset. You will work across multiple levels of fidelity, from rapid sketches and early visual explorations to polished key art and presentation-ready campaign assets. You will collaborate with cross-functional creative, marketing, social, and production partners while experimenting with emerging tools and AI-enabled creative workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Create high-quality 3D artwork, concept art, key visuals, sketches, mockups, and visual explorations for social media, paid media, marketing campaigns, franchise moments, and community activations.
  • Translate creative briefs, business objectives, and marketing strategies into clear, compelling visual concepts.
  • Develop environmental imagery, product visualizations, campaign assets, and creative mockups that establish and evolve a project’s visual direction.
  • Produce presentation-ready materials that communicate creative ideas during planning, pitching, and concept-development stages.
  • Create adaptable artwork for social platforms, websites, events, presentations, partner materials, and other marketing channels.
  • Develop social-first creative that captures attention quickly, feels organic to the platform, and encourages engagement and sharing.
  • Collaborate with creative directors, art directors, marketers, social specialists, producers, and other stakeholders to align work with strategic objectives.
  • Explore multiple visual directions and incorporate feedback efficiently while maintaining a consistently high standard of quality.
  • Stay current on trends across gaming, entertainment, social media, design, technology, and popular culture.
  • Experiment with new creative tools, formats, and AI-enabled workflows to accelerate ideation, rendering, exploration, and iteration.
  • Ensure all creative work meets established standards for brand consistency, accessibility, confidentiality, and community appropriateness.
  • Develop work with engagement, reposts, and other relevant performance indicators in mind.

Qualifications

  • 5–7+ years of experience in 3D art, concept art, visual development, entertainment art, marketing design, gaming, or a related creative field. An exceptional portfolio may offset the years-of-experience requirement.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating 3D artwork, concept development, visual storytelling, sketches, mockups, key visuals, or campaign creative.
  • Demonstrated social-first creative experience, including an understanding of what makes content engaging, shareable, and native to social platforms.
  • Proven ability to take an idea from initial concept through polished execution.
  • Strong knowledge of composition, lighting, color, form, storytelling, and visual communication.
  • Proficiency with industry-standard tools for 3D modeling, rendering, visual development, and image creation.
  • Experience developing visual prototypes, campaign mockups, and concept materials that help stakeholders understand and align around creative ideas.
  • Ability to work across multiple levels of fidelity, from rapid explorations to finished artwork.
  • Experience creating artwork that supports both marketing objectives and audience engagement across multiple channels.
  • Ability to work effectively in rapid creative cycles, incorporate feedback, explore multiple directions, and maintain quality under tight deadlines.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, including experience working with cross-functional creative and business stakeholders.
  • Sound judgment when creating content for a global audience and highly engaged fan community.
  • Portfolio required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience creating social and marketing content for gaming, entertainment, or other culturally relevant consumer brands.
  • Familiarity with sandbox games, gaming culture, online fan communities, and the ways gaming franchises appear in popular culture.
  • Personal enthusiasm for and active engagement with the featured gaming franchise.

title: Data Center Technician
description:
Team Connect is Poland’s leading nearshore and offshore IT provider. Since 2008 we successfully create and develop software for our clients.


We specialize in Agile and DevOps-based software development. From the analysis stage through implementation. We develop backend, frontend, and mobile applications.

For one of our clients, we are looking for a Data Center Technician.

Data Center Technician (DCT), Supplementary Profile (SUPPPRO). Profile domains: Monitoring & Reporting & Maintenance. One-time request for service.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Hands-on experience with server and network device installation

  • Understanding of rack layouts, PDUs, cabling standards, and labelling

  • Basic networking knowledge (LAN, patching, switches)

  • Familiarity with asset management and inventory systems

  • Ability to follow change management and data center procedures

  • Basic troubleshooting of hardware components

  • Strong documentation and reporting skills

  • Proficiency in "Rack & Stack" procedures

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

  • Team-oriented with the ability to work independently

  • Manual Handling proficiency (lifting up Data Center & IT heavy equipment)

  • Ability to work in a data center environment (noise, cold, confined spaces)

  • Driving license cat. B

RESPONSIBILITES

  • Commissioning & decommissioning, installation: physically installing Data Center components, servers, network switches; performing initial power-on tests.

  • Cabling: ongoing verification and upkeep of DC cabling, correct routing through designated pathways, secure mounting/fastening, accurate end-to-end labelling for power and network runs.

  • Stores & logistics: maintaining a tidy DC store, accepting deliveries, ensuring equipment is ready for further processing after arrival, owning the whole hardware lifecycle including commissioning and decommissioning.

  • Audit & reporting: regular inventory audits, updating asset registers, detailed reporting on capacity and hardware health when needed.

  • Hardware maintenance: replacing faulty components, managing the RMA process in cooperation with the DC Contract Manager.

  • Capacity planning: planning rack layouts, overseeing third-party contractors when requested.

  • Documentation: maintaining the maintenance management system, preparing notifications for planned maintenance windows.

  • Preparing and performing changes to the Data Centre and IT core infrastructure.

WE OFFER

  • Long-term cooperation

  • Training budget

  • Assistance in accounting issues when setting up/running a business

  • Individual support from a dedicated company supervisor

description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.

  • An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution

  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.

  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

This position works out of either one of our Plymouth,MN or Hollywood,FL locations in the Structural Heart division.

Structural Heart Business Mission: Why We Exist

Our business purpose is to restore health and improve quality of life by designing and providing device and management solutions for treating structural heart disease.

Our team is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Demand Planner to lead the CALA forecasting and IBP process. This pivotal role involves close collaboration with finance, commercial, supply chain, and marketing teams to drive process improvements, product lifecycle planning strategies (including product launches and phase-outs), commercial strategy modeling, field inventory management, and the management of systems and metrics to measure performance.

We are looking for a proactive problem solver who is comfortable with ambiguity and can lead a team to achieve results. If you have a strong background in business and marketing and are ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role, we encourage you to apply.

This is an energetic and dynamic opportunity to be at the forefront of growth in the Structural Heart division. You will play a crucial role in shaping the future of the CALA organization, driving significant improvements in our business processes, and contributing to our success.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Monthly Review Process: Oversee the monthly IBP (Integrated Business Planning) Commercial Management Review process with CALA Executive Leadership. Manage commercial KPI performance, conduct root cause analysis, and develop solutions.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Partner with key stakeholders to build consensus around forecasts, commercial plans, and action plans to address challenges.

  • Demand Planning: Develop demand plans with commercial, marketing, and finance teams based on business trends, commercial and marketing strategies, and sales pipeline over a 24 mo horizon. Create models to forecast sales, field inventory changes, product phase-ins/phase-outs, and distressed inventory risks.

  • Execution and Management: Execute approved plans, manage abnormal demand, and review and report adherence to forecasts and launch plans.

  • Scenario Planning: Utilize scenario planning to assess risks and drive informed business decisions.

  • Forecast Reconciliation: Reconcile and explain differences between IBP forecasts and LBE forecasts.

  • Change Leadership: Demonstrate effective change leadership and build strategic partnerships to advance departmental and organizational objectives.

  • Process Development: Develop, implement and continuously optimize processes, tools, and systems.

  • Presentation and Communication: Summarize complex data and changing assumptions into concise reports, messages, and recommendations for stakeholders, including senior leadership.

  • Problem Solving: Proactively solve problems, handle unstructured challenges, and lead teams to resolve identified issues.

  • IBP Program Implementation: Implement and optimize the new IBP (Integrated Business Planning) Commercial Management Review process for the CALA Structural Heart division.

  • Travel for position up to 10%.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Supply Chain Management, Finance or a related field

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in forecasting, S&OP/IBP processes, or a related field.

  • Strong analytical skills and proficiency in excel modeling, planning systems and analytics tools.

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to addressing challenges.

  • Experience in change management and building strategic partnerships.
