title: Architect Software Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

Data Platform Architect:

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Data Platform Architect to work on Qualys’ next-generation data platform and middleware. Working alongside a very talented team of engineers and architects, you will be responsible for prototyping, designing, developing and supporting a highly scalable SaaS based cloud security data platform. This is a great opportunity to be an integral part of a team building Qualys’ next generation microservices based technology platform processing over a 100 million transactions and terabytes of data per day, leverage open-source technologies, and work on challenging and business-impacting projects.

Responsibilities

As a platform architect, you will be responsible for the availability and scalability of Qualys’s relational and NoSQL databases, search engines, graph databases, caches, big data systems and message pipelines. This at the scale of a million transactions per second in NoSQL databases, across trillions of datapoints in the search engine, billions of messages per day flowing through the message pipelines and scaling 100s of terabytes of data in relational databases all with sub-second latencies.

Responsible for driving the data source and providing data platform as a service to all applications built in Qualys.

You will be part of the architecture review board reviewing applications’ architecture and identifying the data scale needs. Investigate the cutting-edge technologies, do POC, and then be responsible for defining the guidelines for using the data technologies at scale. Be the face and developer advocate of the stack you own and contribute back to open-source community if any enhancement is needed to fit in the Qualys ecosystem.

Applying Machine Learning and AI technologies to improve the availability and performance of data platform services while keeping the operational costs down.

Conduct brown bag sessions with application development teams to share guidelines, POC findings and industry trends.

You will be instrumenting both day 1 and day 2 operations on these data technologies, keeping the 100s of thousands if not millions of operations per second. Migrate or burst into cloud and scale the stack with zero downtime.

You will also be responsible for reviewing the cloud-native architecture of data platform technologies.

You will be constantly in the hunt for better solutions out there to resolve the current issues with scale, availability, and costs across cloud platforms.

Co-develop with a strong sense of ownership, Qualys’ big-data platform that scales to meet/exceed the demands of processing over 100 million transactions and terabytes of data per day.

Architecture, performance, scalability, high availability, and security will be your primary goals for delivering a first-rate experience to our customers.


Work closely with engineering teams, product management and operations to provide platform and infrastructure features and components to support Qualys’ business objectives.

A day in the life…

  • Apply advanced concepts, theories, and principles to create multi-disciplinary innovations and solutions for the most complex or risky data source related situations

  • Contribute to the development of new data platform principles and concepts

  • Collaborate with and suggest best practices to application teams in Qualys

  • Provide thought leadership across multiple teams to ensure that systems and services are designed, and operating to achieve optimal levels of performance, reliability and sustainability interacting with data platform in Qualys

  • Ensure security coding practices and security system fundamentals across multiple teams

  • Demonstrate ability to identify important areas to instrument across multiple teams

Who you are...

  • A trendsetter. You thrive in an intellectually challenging environment with leading edge technologies.

  • A teacher. You’re able to mentor your peers and help our team grow.

  • A learner. You have an insatiable thirst for knowledge and greater understanding.

title: Process Specialist (56624)
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW:

PGI is a privately held company, established in 1996. We are a leading supplier of private label solutions in the automotive industry. Our focus is on designing, manufacturing and distributing products for automotive, diesel, power-sports and specialty filter markets. Our supply chain network now branches across the Pacific and into South America.


POSITION SUMMARYSet-up, adjust, inspect, troubleshoot, repair, changeover, schedule and operate as required all process equipment within assigned area. Maintain process equipment in a manner to ensure safe and reliable operation. Provide guidance and support to team members related to process equipment in order to facilitate the achievement of scheduled production volume within acceptable safety, quality and scrap levels. May perform other duties as assigned.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  1. Reads/interprets various forms of information (electronic or paper) to determine production requirements.
  2. Transports proper production/maintenance supplies, which may include tooling, from/to storage location to/from production area by hand using floor jack, cart, etc. Visually inspects equipment, supplies, and tooling and performs all required safety checks on equipment. If any defects are found, ensures they are corrected before being used in production.
  3. Sets-up, adjusts, maintains, troubleshoots, and repairs equipment in assigned area to produce quality parts at acceptable rates. Operates various types of equipment related to maintenance functions, i.e. powered hand tools, grinders, drill press, cutoff saws, etc. May perform basic electrical maintenance, i.e. use VOM meter, check voltage, replace fuses, reset motor overloads, etc.
  4. Starts and observes process equipment operation and makes any necessary adjustments to ensure conformance to order specifications. May have primary responsibility for the operation of assigned equipment.
  5. Inspects product dimensions, reads and interprets mechanical drawings, hydraulic drawings, equipment manuals, manufacturer's specifications and basic electrical schematics. Performs regular checks during operation, using calipers, micrometers, fixed gauges, etc., and records results.
  6. Supplies/prepares materials for storing products (boxes, skids, etc.) and removes finished product or returnable materials from production area.
  7. Establishes requirements for spare production supplies, (i.e. tooling, machine parts, etc.) and maintains in proper condition to assure availability.
  8. Responsible for documentation and interpretation of records and reports by entering data into computer system or completing paperwork to record activities and maintain historical maintenance records. Interprets/completes necessary paperwork, i.e. scrap, transfer, production and accept tickets, daily log, etc.
  9. Organizes changeovers to ensure a minimum amount of downtime. Works with team members to ensure that changeovers are made properly and that tooling and equipment are maintained in good working condition.
  10. Utilizes PM, TPM and predictive techniques and equipment to maintain equipment and tooling in good working condition. Schedules and performs machine teardown to make repairs and modifications.
  11. Confers with equipment manufacturers and materials suppliers concerning problems and solutions.
  12. Monitors work in progress and makes or suggests improvements. Keeps supervisor and/or Team Leader informed of any problems associated with production, and takes action to provide support for resolution of problems and continuous improvement. Promotes teamwork, and may train team members in job operations, paperwork, etc.
  13. Performs general housekeeping tasks and keeps work area clean, organized and free of scrap, debris, etc.
  14. Follows all safety procedures and safe work practices

WOODLAND POND CONFORMANCE STATEMENT

In the performance of their respective duties and responsibilities, all employees are expected to conform to the following:

  • Interacting professionally with other employees, residents, guests, and all others
  • Working effectively and in accordance with the Woodland Pond Communication Fundamentals
  • Completing tasks independently while understanding the necessity for communicating and coordinating work efforts with other employees and organizations
  • Complying with all federal, state and local standards, guidelines and regulations as well as Woodland Pond policy and procedure at all times

Position Summary
The Exploration and Walking Guide provides compassionate supervision and guidance to a group of senior citizens from the Woodland Pond Health Center, primarily those with cognitive impairment that cannot be unsupervised, during organized walking activities and time in the WP wander-garden daily. The primary responsibility is to ensure the safety, well-being, and enjoyment of all participants. This includes managing logistics, fostering a positive group environment, and adapting to the needs of seniors with varying mobility and physical capabilities.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (*CF indicates Critical Function)

  • Safety and Supervision:
    • Maintains a register of all participants and tracks attendance for each walk (*CF)
    • Monitors the group's pace, ensuring no participant is left behind, and remains vigilant for signs of fatigue, discomfort, or potential accidents (*CF)
    • Ensures all safety guidelines are followed, including instructions for road crossings and navigating challenging terrain
    • Requires use of a hand radio to be signed out at Reception for any activities off the health center units

  • Participant Support and Companionship:
    • Provides emotional support and companionship to seniors, offering a listening ear and engaging in friendly conversation (*CF)
    • Assists seniors with mobility aids (canes, walkers, wheelchairs) as needed and provides a helping hand on uneven surfaces
    • Fosters a friendly, inclusive, and positive environment that encourages social interaction among group members
    • Assists with any specific needs of individual participants, such as providing water, arranging rest breaks, pushing manual wheelchairs, or helping with meals on longer outings (*CF)
  • Logistics and Administration:
    • Ensures each participant has been cleared to participate by WP rehab department representative / nursing / social services (*CF)
    • Arrives at the designated meeting point at least 15 minutes before the scheduled start time
    • Reports to nursing to review walk destination and eligible resident-participants
    • Provides a brief orientation to the group before each walk, discussing the route, safety precautions, and break schedules
    • Has familiarity with each participant's essential medical information and emergency contacts, carries this information on every offsite outing (*CF)
  • Emergency Response:
    • Administers basic first aid and responds calmly and effectively to any minor incidents
    • Contacts emergency services and/or appropriate authorities in the event of a serious incident (*CF)
    • Follows established emergency protocols and reporting procedures (*CF)
    • All other duties as assigned

General Skills and Abilities

    • Patient, empathetic, and compassionate with a genuine passion for working with the elderly
    • Reliable, dependable, adaptable and responsible
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with seniors, particularly those with a dementia diagnosis
    • Ability to exercise good judgment and remain calm in stressful situations
    • Sufficient physical stamina to walk at varying paces and distances, and assist participants with mobility as necessary

The Elite Stylist delivers quality professional services with an emphasis on the guest’s total look. They support the Experience Manager (EM) and Assistant Services Manager (ASM) and focus on performance (service sales, and productivity), people (guest service), and process (operating procedures and compliance standards). This position requires a passion for the beauty industry, exceptional guest service, and the aptitude to learn and communicate product knowledge.


PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES (*Essential Functions)
The Elite Stylist is a champion of Ulta Beauty’s mission, vision, and values, and should demonstrate them skillfully and consistently by performing the following duties and responsibilities of the position (as well as all other projects/duties as assigned):


Performance

  • Perform hair services including hair design, haircuts, color, texture, hair treatments, styling, updos, perms, blowouts, keratin treatments, extensions, makeup applications, brow services, and ear piercing (where applicable).
  • Meet or exceed sales goal of $1900 average weekly sales and productivity goals for hair services by delivering exceptional guest service and contribute to meeting or exceeding the store’s goals related to retail and service sales, guest loyalty (including credit), and retail shrink as set by Ulta Beauty.
  • Perform product demonstrations with guests to drive sales and the guest service experience.
  • Support the execution of in-store events, promotions and marketing initiatives that deliver an unrivaled guest experience.
  • Take the initiative to stay informed regarding new and existing industry trends, products, and services during work time, and be knowledgeable about the ingredients and benefits of these trends, products, and services to better serve guests.
  • Maintain prompt, regular attendance.


People

  • Develop guest relationships through consultations and appropriate retail and service recommendations.
  • Serve all guests, including walk-in guests, in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Develop a partnership with skin therapists and the retail team to provide a total-store and well- rounded guest experience.
  • Establish professional peer and brand partner relationships that foster a shared interest in collaboratively delivering exceptional guest service.
  • Share the benefits of the guest loyalty program, including credit and the Ulta Beauty app, with guests in the salon and salesfloor.
  • Attend mandatory trainings and meetings to enable continuous professional development.

Process

  • Be knowledgeable of and ensure compliance with Ulta Beauty’s policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Follow all safety, sanitation, and infection control procedures before, during, and after services; always ensure compliance with state board guidelines.
  • Follow established service protocols to ensure a consistent and exceptional guest experience.
  • Utilize appropriate booking and clientele systems to book guests for return services and for events.
  • Communicate any supply needs to the Experience Manager, ensuring guest readiness at all times.
  • Maintain outstanding store operational standards, including cleanliness of the salon, salesfloor, restrooms, backroom, break area, and any additional assigned area.
  • Adhere to the Ulta Beauty dress code.
  • Protect company assets by following loss prevention best practices and providing exceptional guest service.
  • Execute other operational tasks as directed.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS
Education

title: Data Science / ML Engineer
description:
Om stillingen
Er du en lidenskapelig tech-entusiast med en dyp interesse for maskinlæring og moderne utvikling? Liker du utfordrende og komplekse problemstillinger? Hos Sopra Steria blir du en del av et inspirerende og inkluderende miljø – et av Norges råeste tech-miljøer – hvor vi kombinerer utfordrende prosjekter med en kultur preget av nysgjerrighet, læring og samarbeid.

Vi tror at din sterke utviklingskompetanse og genuine interesse for teknologi vil bidra til å forme morgendagens datadrevne løsninger i et dynamisk team med høyt kvalifiserte kollegaer. Hos oss vil du bidra i varierte oppdrag på tvers av bransjer og sektorer, og være med på å utvikle maskinlæringsmodeller og datadrevne løsninger sammen med noen av Norges fremste fageksperter.

Ansvarsområder

  • Utvikling og design: Du vil være med å designe og sette opp maskinlæringsløsninger med en event-drevet tilnærming. Ved å integrere meldingstjenester som Kafka og Pub/Sub, skaper vi en robust arkitektur som sikrer sanntids dataflyt og rask respons.
  • Deep Learning: Du jobber med avanserte teknikker innen deep learning. Dette innebærer modelltrening, evaluering og implementering av state-of-the-art modeller for å løse komplekse problemer.
  • ML-Ops: Du vil være med å sette opp og optimalisere ML-Ops pipelines. Dette innebærer utvikling av løsninger for kontinuerlig integrasjon, distribusjon og overvåkning av maskinlæringsmodeller, slik at vi sikrer stabil drift i produksjon.
  • Datahåndtering og modellering: Du håndterer og modellerer data for å forberede det til maskinlæringsløsninger. Dette inkluderer datainnsamling, preprocessing og transformasjon for å sikre høy kvalitet og relevans i datasettene.
  • Plattformarbeid: Du jobber med moderne dataplattformer som Databricks og Microsoft Fabric for å bygge skalerbare og vedlikeholdbare ML-løsninger.

I prosjektene våre vil du kombinere denne tekniske kompetansen med evnen til å forstå kundens behov, samarbeide godt med ulike fagmiljøer og levere løsninger som er robuste, optimaliserte og som skaper tydelig verdi for kundene våre.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Høyere utdanning innen IT, datateknologi, maskinlæring eller beslektede fagområder.
  • Minimum to års relevant arbeidserfaring med utvikling og implementering av maskinlæringsløsninger.
  • Sterk programmeringskompetanse, spesielt i Python, samt erfaring med rammeverk som TensorFlow, PyTorch eller lignende.
  • Erfaring med ML-Ops-verktøy (MLflow, KubeFlow) og produksjonsklare ML-løsninger.
  • Erfaring med skyplattformer som Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, eller AWS SageMaker.
  • Erfaring med datahåndtering, datamodellering og arbeid med store datasett.
  • Norsk, minimum B2 nivå.

Personlige egenskaper

  • Du er faglig sterk og har en genuin interesse for dataplattformer
  • Du er nysgjerrig, lærevillig og deler gjerne kunnskap
  • Du trives i møte med ulike mennesker og samarbeider tett med både kunder og kollegaer
  • Du kommuniserer klart og skaper tillit i dialog med andre
  • Du jobber selvstendig, men liker også å løse problemer i team
  • Du tar initiativ, er løsningsorientert og bidrar til et positivt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø


Hvorfor Sopra Steria?

Hos oss får du jobbe med meningsfulle og varierte prosjekter for noen av Norges største virksomheter. Vi satser på kontinuerlig faglig og personlig utvikling gjennom sertifiseringsprogrammer, opplæring og støtte fra faglige miljøer. Du vil jobbe i et dynamisk miljø med engasjerte kollegaer, konkurransedyktige betingelser og fleksible arbeidsforhold. Vår kultur bygger på innovasjon og samarbeid. Du trenger ikke oppfylle alle kravene for å være den perfekte kandidaten. Hvis du kjenner deg igjen i mye av det vi beskriver og ønsker å utvikle deg sammen med oss, ser vi frem til å høre fra deg!

Send oss din søknad og CV i dag!

Kontaktinfo

Søknadsfrist:13.09.26

Kontakt: Stig-Ole Gundersen (Leder, Data Intelligence) via epost: stig-ole.gundersen@soprasteria.com hvis du har spørsmål om rollen, kontakt Glenn Bøe (Rekrutteringsrådgiver) via glenn.boe@soprasteria.com hvis du har spørsmål om prosess.

Sopra Steria har kunder og prosjekter som kan kreve sikkerhetsklarering på ulike nivåer. Vi selekterer og inviterer kandidater til intervju fortløpende.

Vi er Norges ledende konsulentselskap innen digitalisering, innovasjon og bærekraft. I Sopra Steria bistår vi våre kunder innen privat og offentlig sektor med å bli fremtidens virksomheter. title: Biologist
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Job Title: Biologist-DNA and Protein Reagent Generation

Organization Overview:
The Reagents Group in the Laboratory of Experimental Medicine (LEM) is a diverse and dedicated team responsible for generation of critical recombinant protein and DNA reagents to enable global Lilly drug discovery efforts of both pre-clinical and clinical programs. The group carries out vector construction, recombinant protein expression, protein purification, and protein refolding. The group is also responsible for generation of labeled antibodies and protein standards for immunogenicity and biomarker assay development and implementation supporting discovery efforts and clinical studies.


Responsibilities:
We are seeking a highly motivated scientist to join Reagents Group. This role is a part of a multi-disciplinary group of scientists collaborating on the generation of high-quality recombinant protein and DNA reagents, which are critical for global Lilly drug discovery efforts.

  • Carry out projects of generating DNA and protein reagents with limited supervision.
  • Work with other members of Reagents Group to accomplish reagent generation projects in a team-oriented environment.
  • Serve as a technical expertise in own specific areas but have knowledge of other functional areas in the group.
  • Provide technological innovation and process improvement.
  • Interact and work closely with other scientists to solve issues regarding DNA and protein reagent generation.


Basic Requirements:

  • BS with relevant pharmaceutical or academic research experience in the areas of molecular biology, protein expression, and protein purification.
  • Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.


Additional Skills/Preferences:

  • Willingness to work in a highly collaborative and team-oriented environment.
  • Think creatively and willing to tackle new challenges.
  • Attention to detail, multitasking, flexibility and learning agility, accurate record keeping.

title: Junior First Line Agent till Stockholms innerstad!
description:
Om tjänsten

Här läser du om drömtjänsten för dig som:

  • Är i början av din karriär och söker jobb inom kundtjänst
  • Har viss tidigare erfarenhet av kundtjänst eller liknande roll
  • Har bakgrund/förståelse för ekonomi (exempelvis pluggat ekonomi på gymnasiet)
  • Är en driven ”vad kan jag göra nu”-person som vill till en arbetsplats med högt i tak och en engagerad chef som vill hjälpa dig utvecklas.
Vi antar du vill veta mer om din nya roll?

Om tjänsten då? Du kommer sitta i en kundtjänst som stöttar kunderna kring tekniska frågor kopplade till de system och tjänster som vår kund erbjuder sina kunder. Med det sagt behöver du inte vara tekniskt lagd för rollen - de bitarna kommer du att få lära dig under anställningen.

Då företaget arbetar med ekonomi är det fördelaktigt om du har viss förståelse för ekonomi sedan tidigare. Ditt nya jobb är beläget i centrala Stockholm och har en energigivande kultur och teamet du ansluter till har högt i tak.

Vi söker dig som

För den här tjänsten ligger mycket vikt vid rätt person med rätt inställning. Däremot, om man ser till tidigare personer som lyckats i rollen, så finns vissa aspekter som ökar sannolikheten att du lyckas och trivs i rollen. Därför söker vi dig som:

  • Först och främst kommer med rätt inställning - du ska vara nyfiken, driven och ha ett sinne för bra service.
  • Har en förståelse/bakgrund inom ekonomi så som exempelvis pluggat ekonomi på gymnasiet eller jobbat på bank eller liknande.
  • Har tidigare relevant erfarenhet (kan vara kundtjänst, kan vara teknisk support, kan vara att telefonkontakt har varit en stor del av ditt arbete överlag)
  • Talar och skriver flytande svenska samt engelska väl då båda språken förekommer i tjänsten.

För att trivas i teamet och i rollen är du som redan nämnt en driven person som vill utvecklas och tar ansvar och har en stolthet i att göra ett bra jobb. För rätt person är detta ett team med en väldigt engagerad chef som är mån om att du ska lyckas.

Om anställningen

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag med anställning hos OIO under första tiden. Tanken är att detta med tiden övergår till en fast anställning hos vår kund förutsatt att samtliga parter är nöjda med samarbetet.

Övrig information
  • Omfattning: Heltid, kontorstider
  • Start: September/ oktober.
  • Placering: Centrala Stockholm
  • Kontaktperson: Anna Edlund (anna.edlund@oio.se)
  • Lön: Fast månadslön

Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval av kandidater och att annonsen kan stängs ner innan tjänsten är tillsatt om vi gått över till urvals och intervjufasen.

Om OIO

Vår passion är att hjälpa dig till rätt roll och arbetsplats. Vi är samtidigt medvetna om att du är kräsen och väljer med omsorg inför nästa karriärsteg, det skulle vi också göra. Därför arbetar vi dedikerat i rekryteringsprocessen för att lära känna dig och dina ambitioner. Vi tror nämligen att människor på rätt plats har större chans att nå sin fulla potential. Genom schyssta, okrångliga anställningsvillkor samt ett närvarande ledarskap arbetar vi därefter aktivt med ditt engagemang och din utveckling. På så vis strävar vi efter att bli en självklar karriärpartner för dig. We are as picky as you are.

title: Float Surgical Clinical Assistant (CMA, EMT, or AT)

description:
Rothman Orthopaedics is looking to hire a full time Float Surgical Clinical Assistant based in our Bryn Mawr, PA office! This is designed as a float position that requires travel to our offices in King of Prussia, Limerick, Malvern, and West Chester, PA. The Surgical Clinical Assist (SCA) provides assistance to the Physician and Physician's Assistant with daily administrative and clinical duties. If you are qualified for and interested in this role, please apply.

Schedule: Monday through Friday 7:30 AM to 4 PM

Responsibilities:

  • Examines post-operative patients and preforms wound checks for possible infections.
  • Performs history and physicals for pre-operative patients.
  • Assists surgeon at collegiate and professional sporting events. Assists with field coverage for patients who are athletes.
  • E-Prescribe, write (getting physician to sign), fax and/or phone in prescriptions for patients according to physician's practice protocols. Obtains pre-certification for prescriptions drugs.
  • Pre-operative calls, making sure patients' PATs are complete, discuss discharge plans, and obtain other important information supplied by patient and answer questions. Post-operative calls, within two weeks of surgical date. Used clinical judgment when directing patient's care based on information the patient shares during the post-op call.
  • Previews charts pre-operatively and documents any pertinent information including surgical clearances. Collates, distributes and discusses post-op discharge instructions to surgical patients and referring physicians
  • Discusses patient care and necessary home equipment with homecare nurse. Arranges for any medical supplies for patient.
  • Phones patient with test results and follow-up instructions. Responds to and refers incoming telephone calls. Instructs patient and family regarding treatment instructions and medication, documenting all patient contact in EHR.
  • Removes staples, sutures, and bandages when necessary.
  • Assists medical assistants in maintaining timely flow of patients. Assists other physicians when their assigned Clinical Assistant is unavailable.
  • Assists physician during office hours in all locations including pre-op and post-op instructions.
  • Scans information into the patient's record (including physician orders, prescriptions, etc. on the date of service).
  • Communicates with surgery scheduler about surgery cancellations/reschedules.
  • Assists physician with research projects as needed.
  • Completes short-term disability forms, medical necessity letters, worker's compensation forms, and return to work letters.
  • Reviews all mail, filing and sends faxes.
  • Reviews physician schedules for patient appropriateness, clinic flow and volume.
  • Assists physician during hospital rounds with post-op patients.
  • Exemplifies the desired culture and philosophies of the organization.
  • Rotates with residents and fellow Clinical Assistant IV's covering the "on-call" rotation.
  • Liaisons between RI physician and outside consulting physicians regarding patient care.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED minimum education requirement
  • Must be a CCMA, CRMA, EMT, or ATC
  • Professional license/certification must be active and valid
  • Knowledge of medical office procedures and medical terminology
  • Computer skills including, but not limited to, MS Office Suite
  • Experience with EMR system(s) preferred

Pay Range:

  • Medical Assistant (CCMA/CRMA)/Emergency Medical Technician (EMT-A/EMT-B): $21.00/hr - $27.00/hr
  • Athletic Trainer (ATC): $48,000/yr - $70,000/yr

This commitment to our employees has earned us the distinction as a Top Workplace in Philadelphia by the Philadelphia Inquirer year after year. Our employees enjoy competitive pay, comprehensive health and dental benefits, tuition reimbursement, paid time off, and retirement savings plans.

title: 1e servicemonteur klimaattechniek
description:
Functietitel

1e servicemonteur klimaattechniek

Functieomschrijving

Meemaken

Je werkt aan het onderhoud, de service en de nieuwbouw van koel- en airconditioningsinstallaties. Je zorgt ervoor dat installaties betrouwbaar, veilig en energiezuinig functioneren en dat onze opdrachtgevers kunnen rekenen op een professionele uitvoering van begin tot eind. Eventueel ga je samen met een collega op pad om onderhoud te verrichten aan gasgestookte installaties.

Dit ga je doen:

  • Je voert onderhoud, service en storingsoplossing uit aan koelinstallaties en airconditioningssystemen bij onze opdrachtgevers;
  • Je werkt aan nieuwbouw en uitbreiding van installaties, van split-units en multisplit-systemen tot VRV/VRF-installaties;
  • Je controleert, test en stelt installaties in bedrijf en zorgt dat alles veilig, betrouwbaar en volgens afspraak functioneert;
  • Je werkt zorgvuldig volgens de geldende wet- en regelgeving rondom F-gassen, koudemiddelen, lekcontroles, registratie, veiligheid en milieu;
  • Je denkt samen met collega’s mee over slimme oplossingen en verbeteringen;
  • Je werkt veelal in bestaande en operationele omgevingen, waarbij je netjes, veilig en klantgericht te werk gaat;

title: Palveluvastaava siivoustehtäviin Imatralle
description:
Etsitkö työtä, jossa saat hyödyntää aiempaa siivousalan kokemustasi? Onko sinulla itsenäinen ja oma-aloitteinen työote? Jos kiinnostuksesi heräsi, lue ilmoitus loppuun ja hae iloiseen tiimiimme!



Etsimme aurinkoiseen joukkoomme täysi-ikäistä suomenkielentaitoista
PALVELUVASTAAVAA SIIVOUSTEHTÄVIIN IMATRALLE.


Työtehtävät sisältävät toimistojen ja yleisten tilojen päivittäistä ylläpitosiivousta viikottaisen siivoussuunnitelman mukaisesti, mukaanlukien siivouskoneiden käyttöä. Lisäksi työtehtäviin kuuluu perussiivoukseen liittyviä töitä, kuten lattioiden pesuja ja ikkunanpesua.


Päivittäiset ylläpitosiivouksen tehtävät suoritetaan perehdytysjakson jälkeen pääosin itsenäisesti.
Toki tiimin / esihenkilön tuki on aina saatavilla, vähintään puhelimitse!


Työvuorot sijoittuvat maanantaista perjantaihin kello 06–18 välille.
Viikkotyötunnit: 25h/vko, on mahdollisuus tehdä välillä lisätunteja alueen muissa kohteissa.


Palveluvastaavan siivoustyö on yhdistelmä ammattitaitoa, viihtyisyyttä ja puhtautta! Keskeisiä työtehtäviäsi ovat:

- Ylläpitosiivouksen tehtävät käsi- ja konemenetelmin. Siivoustehtävät sisältävät muun muassa imurointia, moppausta ja kosketuspintojen pyyhintää.

- Hygieniatason ylläpito: WC-tilojen päivittäinen siivous, keittiö- ja taukotilojen pintojen pesu, käsi- ja WC-paperin täydennys.

- Roska-astioiden tyhjennys

- Kommunikointi ja yhteistyö asiakkaiden ja henkilökunnan kanssa.

- Vahinkojen ja huoltotarpeiden raportointi ohjeiden mukaisesti.

- Siivousvälineiden huolto ja puhdistus.

Palveluvastaavan siivoustyö on merkityksellistä, sillä se on keskeinen osa asiakkaan toimintaa, vaikuttaen suoraan työntekijöiden ja vierailijoiden hyvinvointiin, turvallisuuteen ja työskentelyolosuhteisiin. Varmistat ympäristön viihtyvyyden, edistät hygieniaa ja terveyttä, luot viraston ensivaikutelman ja vaikutat viraston maineeseen, huolehdit tilojen sekä ympäristön turvallisuudesta.


Odotamme hakijalta:

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa kommunikaation ja työturvallisuuden tueksi. (We require good proficiency in Finnish to support workplace safety and communication.)

- Aiempaa kokemusta siivoustyöstä

- Täysi-ikäisyyttä

- Aurinkoista asiakaspalveluasennetta sekä reipasta ja oma-aloitteista työotetta

- Joustavuus työajoissa tarpeen mukaan

- Rikoksetonta taustaa (suppea turvallisuusselvitys teetetään työhön valituille henkilöille ennen työsuhteen aloitusta)

Katsomme eduksi siivousalan koulutuksen. Tämä ei kuitenkaan ole pakollinen, saat perehdytyksen työvälineisiin ja kohteen siivousmenetelmiin.
Olet kuitenkin jo siivonnut sen verran, että tunnet välineet nimeltä ja osaat käyttää suurinta osaa työvälineistä.



Palkkaus noudattaa kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimusta palkkaryhmässä 3 (13,22 €/h).
Perehdytysjaksolla palkkaryhmä 1 (11,33€/h).



Työt alkavat heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä



Kiinnostuitko? Haethan paikkaa täyttämällä sähköisen hakemuslomakkeemme huolella ja liittämällä mukaan ansioluettelosi ja/tai hakukirjeesi. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Virpi Rönkä, etunimi.sukunimi(at)sol.fi.

Me SOLissa käytämme siivoustyön ammattilaisistamme nimitystä palveluvastaava, sillä he ovat vastuussa tuottamastaan palvelusta eli erinomaisesta siivousjäljestä ja asiakastyytyväisyydestä. Jos etsit työtä mukavassa työporukassa ja jossa pääset näkemään kätesi jäljen, hae meille nyt!

Liity osaksi aurinkoista porukkaamme!




Tarjoamme


- Liikunta- ja hierontaetu

- Lakisääteistä laajempi työterveyshuolto

- Työsuhde-edut voimassa koeajan jälkeen.



SOL Palvelut Oy

Meille on tärkeää työssä viihtyminen ja kannustava ilmapiiri – toimintaamme ohjaavat SOL arvot: aurinkoisen tyytyväinen asiakas, arkiluovuus, yrittäjyys, luotettavuus ja iloinen työn tekeminen.
Jos nämä arvot resonoivat kanssasi, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!
Arvostamiamme ominaisuuksia ovat myös oma-aloitteisuus, vastuullisuus ja täsmällisyys.



SOL on osaava, monipuolinen ja kansainvälisesti toimiva suomalainen palvelualan perheyritys, jonka keskiössä on aurinkoisen tyytyväinen asiakas ja iloinen työn tekeminen.

SOL Palvelut Oy:n palveluihin kuuluu siivous- ja toimitilapalvelut. Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme puhtauden ja korkean hygienian ratkaisuja, joilla vaikutamme työympäristöjen viihtyvyyteen ja turvallisuuteen.

SOL Palvelut Oy on osa SOL-konsernia, joka työllistää noin 13 000 aurinkoista SOLilaista.



SOL KONSERNI

Iloisiin SOLilaisiin kuuluu [turvallisuusalan, kiinteistönhuollon, talotekniikan, puhtaanapidon ja tekstiilihuollon ammattilaisia](https://www.sol.fi/). Lisäksi tarjoamme [henkilöstövuokrauspalveluja](https://www.sol.fi/palvelut/henkilostopalvelut/) joustavasti eri toimialoille.

Arvostamme osaamista ja ammattitaitoa. Vahva osaaminen taataan räätälöidyillä perehdytyksillä, sisäisillä koulutuksilla sekä oppilaitosyhteistyöllä. Myös eteneminen on mahdollista erilaisten urapolkujen avulla. Työssäsi sinua kannustaa ja tukee oma esihenkilösi sekä koko tiimi.

SOL Life-ohjelman avulla kehitämme työhyvinvointia sekä panostamme työntekijöidemme työturvallisuuteen.

Arvostamme monimuotoisuutta työyhteisössä. Toivomme hakijoiksi eri ikäisiä ja eri sukupuolia olevia henkilöitä sekä kieli-, kulttuuri- tai muihin vähemmistöihin kuuluvia henkilöitä.

title: ML Engineer (Research Scientist - Cryosphere)
description:
ML Engineer (Scientific Research - Cryosphere)

FULL-TIME | UK & ARCTIC | DEV

LOCATION: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER, UK


THE LAST FRONTIER

ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox—an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence—is why we exist.

Our solution is autonomy.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

THE ROLE
ARD is building Auka - an intelligence layer for the Arctic that turns a flood of observations into understanding, foresight, and action. Our approach is deliberately grounded in modern science. We develop and run physics models, collect empirical data in the field and laboratory and then use that knowledge to extract meaning from our diverse datasets. We avoid black boxes — the products we ship trace back to the physics and data that produced it.

This role focuses on developing and tuning machine learning pipelines that are fast, trustworthy, and traceable, ingesting diverse datasets with an emphasis on remotely sensed imagery. These pipelines will form the foundational products on which our longer-term Arctic intelligence platform will build.

This is the first science hire and a senior one. You will own the Analyse-and-ML workstream, working directly with the Science Lead, set the technical direction for how physics and ML meet at ARD, and become a pivotal founding member of the ARD science team.


CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Distil reference physics into fast operators - build emulators / surrogates that run orders of magnitude faster than our reference physics models.

  • Own the forward-to-inverse bridge - Build the ML that inverts real hyperspectral and multispectral imagery into physical quantities (albedo, melt state, impurity loading), with the physics as the constraint, not an afterthought.

  • Make trust a property of the model, not a report - bake in uncertainty quantification, provenance, and validation against cold-lab and field measurements. Outputs must be defensible pixel-to-decision.

  • Set the technical bar for physics ⇄ ML across the science team, and help shape and mentor the hires that follow you.

  • Ship into the platform - work with the Science Lead and Head of Software so your models land in production — not just in papers.

REQUIREMENTS

We are looking for a scientist who lives on the seam between physical modelling and machine learning — someone whose instinct is to respect and accelerate physics, not replace it with an opaque network.

Essential

  • A PhD (or equivalent research track record) in a physical, geophysical, computational, or ML discipline, with a body of work at the physics–ML interface: physics-informed / hybrid models, emulators or surrogate models, neural operators, differentiable simulation, or data assimilation with learned components.

  • Fluency with uncertainty quantification and with validating models against real measurements.

  • GIS or geospatial data handling

  • Machine learning or data science background

  • Strong scientific software engineering: production-quality Python, reproducibility, version control, testing. Your models are meant to ship.

  • Seniority to own a workstream and be delegated to — able to set direction, make sound calls under ambiguity independently, and represent the science externally. Comfortable being the first, and helping build the team.

Strongly preferred

  • Working knowledge of the cryosphere (glaciology, ice-surface / snow, or sea-ice physics). We will weight the ability to reason fluently about physical models over any specific sub-domain, and we also highly value marine and atmospheric science — but you should be able to engage with radiative-transfer and ice-surface physics without hand-holding.

  • Experience with Earth-observation / remote-sensing retrieval — inverting satellite or drone imagery into physical quantities, atmospheric correction, cal/val.

  • The cloud-native geospatial stack (Xarray, Zarr, Dask, STAC; the Pangeo ecosystem).

WHAT WE VALUE

  • You reach for the simplest model that respects the physics before the biggest one.

  • You treat provenance and uncertainty as first-class, not documentation added at the end.

  • You've shipped something real that others depend on — an open-source tool, an operational model, a product.


Why ARD

The mission - The Arctic is the fastest-changing region on Earth. You'll build the intelligence layer that helps understand and steward it — an early-warning system for the planet's coldest edge.

Science and product - Our model rewards work that yields both new science and a platform others build on. You won't have to choose between publishing and shipping.

Foundational scope - You're the first science hire, you'll work directly with the Science Lead and Head of Software. You'll be instrumental in shaping the team that follows.

Open by design - A free Arctic data commons alongside paid services — your work reaches the whole field, not a walled garden.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation

· Assist unit personnel with system employment, configuration management, and best-practice procedures.

· Coordinate with government engineers, program offices, and external stakeholders to resolve software, hardware, and network issues.

· Support fielding, upgrades, and capability insertion activities for Air C2 systems.

Required Qualifications

· Active SECRET clearance.

· Working knowledge of CTN architecture, data-link operations, or sensor-fusion networks.

· Strong background in system setup, configuration, troubleshooting, and sustainment.

· Ability to support units in dynamic environments, including field exercises and operational deployments.

· Familiarity with USMC aviation operations, airspace management, or integrated fires is preferred.

Desired Skills

· Experience supporting Marine Corps aviation units or service-level exercises.

· Understanding of network architectures, tactical data links, and cross-domain solutions.

title: Data Engineer

  • Utvikling og design

    Du jobber med distribuerte plattformer for å prosessere store datamengder. Dette innebærer avansert datamodellering for å strukturere, transformere og gjøre data om til verdifull innsikt.
  • Skyteknologier
    Vil du være med å designe, sette opp og optimalisere løsninger på Azure, AWS og GCP? Her utnytter du tjenester for lagring, serverless computing og containere for å bygge systemer som er sikre, skalerbare og kostnadseffektive.

    Du vil være med på å designe og implementere skyinfrastruktur ved hjelp av moderne IaC-verktøy, som Terraform, Biceps og tilsvarende.


I prosjektene våre vil du kombinere denne tekniske kompetansen med evnen til å forstå kundens behov, samarbeide godt med ulike fagmiljøer og levere løsninger som er robuste, optimaliserte og som skaper tydelig verdi for kundene våre.

  • Gjerne erfaring med infrastruktur som kode.
  • Norsk, minimum B2 nivå

  • Du er faglig sterk og har en genuin interesse for dataplattformer
  • Du er nysgjerrig, lærevillig og deler gjerne kunnskap
  • Du trives i møte med ulike mennesker og samarbeider tett med både kunder og kollegaer
  • Du kommuniserer klart og skaper tillit i dialog med andre
  • Du jobber selvstendig, men liker også å løse problemer i team
  • Du tar initiativ, er løsningsorientert og bidrar til et positivt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

Hos oss får du jobbe med meningsfulle og varierte prosjekter for noen av Norges største virksomheter. Vi satser på kontinuerlig faglig og personlig utvikling gjennom sertifiseringsprogrammer, opplæring og støtte fra faglige miljøer. Du vil jobbe i et dynamisk miljø med gode kollegaer, konkurransedyktige betingelser og fleksible arbeidsforhold. Det finnes uttallige faglige og sosiale tilbud, og vi kan tilby en ferieuke ekstra. Vi er stolte av vår kultur og vårt engasjement for teknologi. Du trenger ikke oppfylle alle kravene for å være den perfekte kandidaten. Hvis du kjenner deg igjen i mye av det vi beskriver og ønsker å utvikle deg sammen med oss, ser vi frem til å høre fra deg!

Vi er Norges ledende konsulentselskap innen digitalisering, innovasjon og bærekraft. I Sopra Steria bistår vi våre kunder innen privat og offentlig sektor med å bli fremtidens virksomheter. description:
Haluatko olla mukana kehittämässä täysin uudenlaista tapaa rakentaa työllisyyspalveluja alueellisesti? Etsimme oma-aloitteista, toimeen tarttuvaa ja ratkaisukeskeistä projektisuunnittelijaa Naapurustoallianssiin Helsingin työllisyyspalveluihin! Me Helsingin työllisyyspalveluissa teemme töitä sen eteen, että työnhakijat ja työnantajat kohtaavat. Autamme työnhakijoita hankkimaan sen osaamisen, jota työllistyminen edellyttää ja poistamme työllistymisen esteitä.

Naapurustoallianssi on Helsingin kaupungin uusi, innovatiivinen toimintamalli, jossa työllisyyspalveluja kehitetään tiiviissä yhteistyössä kaupungin, palveluntuottajien, yritysten ja järjestöjen kanssa. Allianssimallissa jaamme vastuun, riskit ja hyödyt, ja keskitymme konkreettisiin alueellisiin haasteisiin, kuten vieraskielisten työllistymiseen, nuorten koulutuspolkuihin ja pitkittyneen työttömyyden ehkäisyyn. Tavoitteena on pysyvä ja kustannusvaikuttava muutos: enemmän työllisyyttä, vahvempaa osallisuutta ja elinvoimaisempia kaupunginosia. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa rohkeita kokeiluja, yhteistä ongelmanratkaisua ja uudenlaisten palvelujen viemistä suoraan arkeen.

Projektisuunnittelijana vastaat erityisesti Naapurustoallianssin tiedolla johtamiseen liittyvistä suunnittelu-, kehittämis- ja koordinaatiotehtävistä. Edistät uuden asiakastieto- ja raportointijärjestelmän kehittämistä yhteistyössä hankkeen koordinaatiokumppanin kanssa. Koordinoit järjestelmän käyttöönottoa ja huolehdit ylläpidosta työllisyyspalveluissa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa tietotarpeiden määrittelyä, prosessien kuvaamista, raportointinäkymien kehittämistä sekä tietosuojaan liittyvää valmistelua.

Projektisuunnittelijana tuotat ja jalostat tietoa toiminnan kehittämisen ja asiakasohjauksen tueksi. Kehität tiedonhallinnan käytäntöjä ja ratkaisuja, jotka tukevat arjen asiakastyötä. Lisäksi vastuullesi kuuluu myös muita Naapurustoallianssin vaihtelevia koordinointitehtäviä, jotka voivat liittyä esim. tilojen järjestämiseen, talouteen, maksatuksen seurantaan ja ohjeistuksiin. Lisäksi koordinoit työpajoja ja tilaisuuksia sekä huolehdit niiden käytännön järjestelyistä. Teet tiivistä yhteystyötä projektipäällikön ja muun hanketiimin sekä kumppaniverkonston kanssa.

Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos viihdyt kädet savessa -tyyppisessä projektityössä, viet asioita oma-aloitteisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti eteenpäin ja pystyt toimimaan itsenäisesti osana laajempaa kokonaisuutta. Onnistut tehtävässä, kun pystyt työskentelemään tavoitteellisesti muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä. Osaat toimia verkostomaisessa yhteistyössä, pidät arjen tekemisen liikkeessä ja tuot aktiivisesti esiin havaintoja kehittämisen tueksi.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on alempi korkeakoulututkinto tai muu vastaava osaaminen sekä kielitaitovaatimuksena hyvä suomen kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito, hyvä englannin kielen suullinen taito ja tyydyttävä ruotsin tai muun kielen taito.

Lisäksi odotamme sinulta:

- Hyviä projektinhallintataitoja sekä kokemusta tai valmiutta toimia ratkaisukeskeisesti muuttuvassa ja nopeatempoisessa projekti- ja kehittämisympäristössä
- Kykyä tunnistaa tietotarpeita ja tuottaa ratkaisuja asiakastyön ja kehittämisen tueksi
- Kykyä johtaa omaa työtäsi ja huolehtia tavoitteiden etenemisestä suunnitelmallisesti
- Kykyä toimia sujuvasti verkostoissa ja rakentaa yhteistyötä eri toimijoiden välillä

Luemme eduksi ymmärryksen vaikuttavuusperusteisesta kehittämistyöstä, työllistymisen edistämisen palvelujärjestelmän tuntemuksen sekä kokemuksen asiakaspalvelutyöstä.

Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen roolin osana uutta ja kunnianhimoista kehitysprojektia, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan helsinkiläisten työllistymiseen konkreettisesti, rakentamaan uudenlaisia ennakollisia työllisyyspalveluja ja kehittämään tiedolla johtamisen ratkaisuja yhdessä osaavien ammattilaisten ja laajan kumppaniverkoston kanssa. Saat tueksesi innostuneen ja osaavan tiimin sekä Helsingin kaupungin tarjoamat monipuoliset henkilöstöedut. Lue lisää: Miksi töihin Helsingin kaupungille? https://www.hel.fi/fi/avoimet-tyopaikat/miksi-toihin-kaupungille.

Tehtävä alkaa 7.9.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan ja on määräaikainen 31.1.2028 saakka. Määräaikaisuuden perusteena on projektiluontoinen työ hankkeessa. Tehtävä sijoittuu työllisyyspalveluiden ennakollisten palveluiden strategiset kumppanuudet ja innovaatiot -tiimiin. Tehtävässä on kuuden kuukauden koeaika.

Hakuaika päättyy 18.8.2026 klo 16.00. Ensimmäisen kierroksen haastattelut toteutetaan ryhmähaastatteluna pe 21.8. klo 9-12. Ryhmähaastattelun luonteen vuoksi emme voi järjestää korvaavaa ajankohtaa. Tämän jälkeen osa hakijoista kutsutaan henkilökohtaisiin haastatteluihin, jotka järjestetään to 27.8. klo 8.30-11.

Tasa-arvon ja yhdenvertaisuuden edistämiseksi Helsingin kaupunki kannustaa anonyymiin rekrytointiin, ja tämä rekrytointi toteutetaan anonyymisti. Anonyymin rekrytoinnin tavoitteena on kohdentaa huomio hakijan ammatilliseen osaamiseen sekä työkokemukseen. Täytä työnhakulomake normaalisti. Huomioi hakemusta kirjoittaessasi, että se noudattaa anonymiteetin periaatteita. Esihenkilö valitsee haastateltavat henkilöt anonyymin yhteenvedon perusteella eikä siinä ole nähtävissä hakijan nimeä, ikää, sukupuolta tai äidinkieltä.

title: Head Plant Engineer
description:
Looking for a dynamic leader, for a fast paced and growing company.

Head Plant Maintenance Technician / Engineer opportunity with a family-owned regional company who has been growing successfully since 1934. Ideal candidates will have a minimum of at least 3-5 years plant maintenance and leadership experience. Candidate must have the ability to communicate with all levels of management, manage and support engineering teams and believe in well-defined preventative maintenance programs. Must have the ability to lift, push up to 50 pounds. Flexibility in schedule required.

compensation 90k-110k

Minimum job requirements include knowledge of several of the following areas:

Preventative maintenance procedures

Boilers

Air compressors

Welding and Piping

Hydraulics and pneumatics

Electrical circuitry and PLC's

Electro/mechanical utility and electrical trouble shooting

General equipment and building maintenance.

Experience with air cylinders, solenoid valves, steam traps, motor starters, gear reducers, inverter drives, or industrial laundry equipment is a plus.


RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Perform scheduled preventative maintenance program
  • Work with other associates in a team to accomplish goals
  • Maintain safety and cleanliness standards
  • Assist in other areas and/or departments as needed
  • Supervision of front line maintenance personnel
  • Train and develop existing and new maintenance staff
  • Design, plan, install, and maintain plant systems
QUALIFICATIONS
  • High level of attention to detail
  • Strong communication skills, verbal and written
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule
  • Must have the ability to lift, push, and pull a minimum of 50 pounds
  • Minimum of at least 3-5 years maintenance experience
  • Highly organized
  • Computer literate
  • Associates Degree in Engineering or related field or sufficient experience
BENEFITS
  • Group benefits package (Medical, Dental, Short-term Disability, Vision, Life Insurance, and 401(k) with generous company match
  • Paid Vacation
  • Competitive Salary

COMPANY DESCRIPTION

Capital Textile Service, Inc. is a linen rental supply and commercial laundry company. Our business provides linen, textile, and hygiene services to the hospitality, first class lodging, healthcare, and small business customers.

Our company is dedicated to resource conservation and social responsibility. Part of the quality service we offer our customers is the knowledge that we are helping them achieve their business goals while reducing their impact on the environment.

title: Senior Bid Co-ordinator
description:
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Senior Business Development Co-ordinator to support the continued growth of our Infrastructure & Major Projects division.

This is a key role within one of G&T's most successful sectors, working closely with Partners, Directors and project teams to secure new business opportunities across both the public and private sectors.

The successful candidate will take ownership of the co-ordination and delivery of high-quality bids, proposals, presentations and business development activities. They will also play an important role in opportunity management, market intelligence, client targeting and the ongoing development of bid content and processes.

This role is ideally suited to an individual with several years' experience in business development and bid management within a consultancy, construction, infrastructure or professional services environment, who is looking to take the next step in their career and become a trusted adviser to senior stakeholders.

While the successful candidate will work within established tools and processes, they will also be encouraged to contribute ideas, challenge current ways of working and play a meaningful role in improving the bid process. This is an opportunity to make a genuine impact within a friendly, supportive environment where input is welcomed and valued.
Key Responsibilities

Bid Management & Proposal Development
  • Manage the end-to-end bid process from opportunity identification through to submission.
  • Review tender documentation and client requirements to ensure submissions are compliant and aligned with evaluation criteria.
  • Develop bid plans, submission programmes and responsibility matrices to manage deadlines effectively.
  • Coordinate contributions from multiple stakeholders, maintaining version control and ensuring deadlines are met.
  • Draft, edit and proofread bid responses to ensure clarity, consistency and quality.
  • Produce high-quality submission documents using Microsoft Office and Adobe InDesign.
  • Manage tender portal submissions and maintain relevant supplier registration platforms.
  • Conduct lessons learned reviews and support continuous improvement initiatives.
Business Development Support
  • Maintain and monitor opportunity pipelines, working with sector leaders to track prospects and priorities.
  • Support market research, competitor analysis and client intelligence activities.
  • Prepare capability statements, project case studies, CVs and other business development collateral.
  • Develop compelling presentation materials for client meetings, interviews and pitches.
  • Support the organisation and delivery of client events, networking activities and sector initiatives.
Knowledge Management & Best Practice
  • Maintain and develop the Infrastructure bid library.
  • Ensure content remains current, compliant and aligned with sector priorities.
  • Identify content gaps and work with subject matter experts to create new materials.
  • Monitor frequently asked questions and maintain standard responses across key themes such as ESG, sustainability, health & safety and social value.
  • Promote best practice in bid management and contribute to the enhancement of tools, templates and processes.
You will be a motivated and commercially aware business development professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment. You will be equally comfortable coordinating complex bids, producing high-quality written content and engaging with senior stakeholders.

Most importantly, you will be someone who takes ownership, looks for ways to improve how things are done and is passionate about helping teams win work.

Skills and Experience

Essential
  • Demonstrable experience in business development, bids or proposals within professional services, consultancy, infrastructure, construction or the built environment.
  • Proven experience managing complex bids from inception to submission.
  • Strong understanding of public sector procurement processes and frameworks.
  • Excellent written communication, copywriting, editing and proofreading skills.
  • Strong project management and organisational abilities.
  • Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders and competing deadlines.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Word and PowerPoint.
  • Confident communicator with the ability to build credibility with senior stakeholders.
  • Resilient, proactive and solutions-focused approach.
Desirable
  • Experience within infrastructure, major projects, construction consultancy or engineering sectors.
  • Knowledge of procurement portals such as Ariba, Delta, Proactis and Jaggaer.
  • Adobe InDesign experience.
  • Understanding of client pursuit planning and wider business development practices.
  • Experience supporting interviews, presentations and client engagement activities.
  • In return, we offer you a supportive and collaborative team environment of marketing professionals including BD, communications, digital and design.
  • Support in your personal development through the marketing team CPD programme and the firm’s Learning & Development programme.
  • Hybrid working with most days in the office but with the option to spend some working from home (with flexibility around this when the need arises).
  • A generous benefits package including 27 days annual leave, plus bank holidays and Christmas shutdown, pension plan and more.
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Programme and network of Mental Health First Aiders.
  • Opportunity to join or spectate at a wide variety of subsidised sports and recreational teams including softball, netball, squash, football, cricket and music.
About Us

G&T is an independent construction and property consultancy working across all sectors of the built environment – we help our clients to build everything from offices to schools, airports to power stations. We specialise in Cost and Project Management services as well as offering a range of supplementary services. There are 1,500+ people across our offices in the UK, US and Ireland which are our core markets.

We’ve been around for nearly 190 years and we pride ourselves on being an ethical firm. We support charities and good causes, take our social impact responsibilities seriously and we are on a journey to improve on diversity and inclusion.

We’re also a people-focused business and place emphasis on recruiting and retaining the best talent and then supporting them to grow their career with the firm through continuous learning and development. We’re also quite sporty and sociable with a range of sports teams, socials and activities to get involved with.

title: Associate Power Engineer
description:
Globeleq is a leading developer, owner, and operator of electricity generation in Africa, delivering tailored energy solutions and supporting the region’s energy transition. Since 2002, Globeleq has built a diverse portfolio of independent power plants, currently generating 1,660MW across 18 power plants, in seven countries, with 665MW under construction and more than 2,000MW in development. Globeleq is owned by British International Investment and Norfund, the UK and Norwegian development finance institutions. More details: www.globeleq.com

The Associate Power Engineer will assist in the development and execution of power engineering and project-related tasks within the engineering department. Together with the Engineering Team, the Associate Power Engineer will focus on the development, implementation and maintenance of sound engineering practices through Globeleq’s existing assets, assets under development and assets under construction, with the intention of optimising life-cycle performance. The role will require frequent travel for onsite activities.

1. Grid code compliance support
  • Assist in developing and maintaining wind, solar and battery facility PowerFactory and PSCAD models
  • Assist and perform grid code studies
  • Assist in managing grid code compliance of the Globeleq power plants
  • Assist in analysing power quality data and assist in power quality assessments of the Globeleq assets
  • Assist in improving electrical plant control systems

2. Plant engineering support
  • Assist in studies to identify appropriate changes to improve plant reliability and performance
  • Conduct internal technical audits of Globeleq assets, systems and maintenance plans
  • Assist with transfer of knowledge to the technical teams through coaching and training
  • Support plant technicians in fault finding activities
  • Assist Plant and Engineering teams in root cause analysis investigations into failures
  • Evaluating electrical systems, products, components, and applications by conducting research and applying knowledge of electricity and materials to assist the operation teams
  • Participating in ISO 55 000 related activities

3. Engineering systems development
  • Administer the StationWare configuration management system
  • Assist in developing and implementing engineering systems to improve support to the Globeleq assets

4. Engineering projects
  • Manage engineering projects from conceptual through to operations
  • Confirm system's and components' capabilities of each project requirement
  • Assist in developing technical specifications and scope of work packages for engineering projects
  • Conduct feasibility studies for proposed new capital projects
  • Participate in the evaluation, review and recommendation of suitable suppliers and contractors
  • Assist with the delivery of projects on time, within budget and to agreed contractor quality

And any other duties, as assigned by Power Engineer in line with the role.


1. Very good written communication in English, including writing clear and concise reports
2. Very good verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting to technical audiences and training colleagues
3. Able to establish and maintain professional working relationships with internal and external parties
4. Able to handle multiple projects and prioritise work effectively
5. Responsive to pressure and able to manage changing priorities
6. Must be a self-starter and able to work independently when required
7. Good team player; able to balance team and individual responsibilities.
8. Very good organising skills and attention to detail.

1. B.Sc Eng/B.Eng or MTech in electrical engineering (heavy current) (or NQF equivalent)
2. Ideally 2 years’ experience in power system operation (or similar industrial plant) or experience in power system studies in a consulting role (to internal or external clients). SCADA and PLC experience is also beneficial.
3. Understands LV, MV and HV electrical systems; practical exposure to these would be an advantage
4. Very good MS Word and MS Excel skills; exposure to MS project (or similar) and MS PowerPoint would be an advantage
5. Experience in wind, photovoltaic and battery storage plants would be an advantage
6. Exposure to/knowledge of RMS/EMT dynamic simulations and electrical protection systems
7. Exposure to power system digital simulation packages is required. DIgSILENT PowerFactory and StationWare would be an advantage
8. Able to read and understand the IEC/SANS technical standards
9. Working knowledge of NERSA grid codes would be an advantage
10. Able to read and understand schematics
11. A valid light vehicle driver’s license is a requirement
12. Willingness to travel to site often to do on-site investigations, equipment testing, project execution and commissioning.

title: Accuracy Checking Dispenser (ACD) - Weekend Shifts
description:
Tired of retail pharmacy?

Imagine working in a modern, technology-enabled online pharmacy where you can focus on accuracy, quality and patient safety—without standing behind a retail counter, selling OTC products or being interrupted every few minutes.

No retail counter. No walk-in patients. No OTC. Focus entirely on delivering safe, high-quality pharmacy care.

Modern pharmacy. State of the art renovated premises with onsite Free parking

That's what we're building at Montu.

You will be a central, trusted part of our pharmacy operation at our Winnersh site — the person the team relies on to make sure every medicine that leaves our pharmacy is right.

As an Accuracy Checking Dispenser (ACD), you will be responsible for carrying out the final accuracy check on dispensed prescriptions before they are supplied to patients. You will act as an independent safeguard within the dispensing process, ensuring that medicines are assembled exactly as prescribed and in line with legal, operational and patient safety standards.

Getting it right the first time is non-negotiable. You will be trusted to exercise professional judgement, identify risks before they become incidents, and have the confidence to stop the process whenever something does not look right.

What will you be doing?

  • Carrying out the final accuracy check on dispensed medicines, confirming that the product supplied matches the prescription and accompanying documentation.

  • Verifying the right patient, right medicine, right strength, right formulation, right quantity and right directions, ensuring all labelling is accurate and appropriate.

  • Checking that medicines have been assembled in accordance with legal requirements, SOPs and company processes.

  • Identifying and escalating discrepancies, near misses and potential dispensing errors immediately, supporting a culture of openness and continuous improvement.

  • Maintaining clear, accurate and auditable records of all checks completed.

  • Exercising professional judgement and recognising when concerns fall outside your scope of practice, referring to the Responsible Pharmacist where appropriate.

  • Supporting the safe handling and checking of controlled drugs, unlicensed medicines and high-risk medications, in accordance with relevant legislation and internal procedures.

  • Ensuring appropriate expiry date checks, batch number verification (where applicable), and packaging integrity checks are completed before supply.

  • Working closely with dispensers, pharmacists and the wider pharmacy team to resolve queries efficiently while maintaining independence during the final checking process.

  • Contributing to quality assurance initiatives, investigations and process improvements aimed at reducing dispensing errors and improving patient safety.

  • Supporting and mentoring colleagues, helping to embed a culture of accountability, quality and attention to detail.

  • Remaining up to date with SOPs, regulatory requirements and best practice guidance to maintain competence and ensure the highest standards of checking.

What do you need?

  • An accredited Accuracy Checking Dispenser (ACD) qualification recognised for pharmacy dispensing practice.

  • Significant experience working within a pharmacy environment with a proven track record of conducting final accuracy checks.

  • A detailed understanding of the dispensing process and the critical control points that prevent medication errors.

  • Strong knowledge of pharmacy legislation, SOPs, governance requirements and patient safety principles.

  • The ability to work independently and make sound decisions while recognising the limits of your competence and escalating concerns appropriately.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to maintain concentration and accuracy, even when working at pace.

  • Confidence to challenge discrepancies and halt the supply process when patient safety could be compromised.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

  • A proactive mindset, taking ownership of issues and following them through to resolution.

  • A genuine commitment to patient outcomes — understanding that every prescription represents a person relying on you to get it right.

What we offer:

  • Part-time contract or Locum: Shifts are 8 hours per day + 30 minutes unpaid break, running from 7:30am to 4pm.

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three + 8 bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Private Healthcare Scheme

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

Compensation: £35K – £36K

title: Scheduling Coordinator - (In-Home Care Services) Lafayette LA
description:
The Scheduler is responsible for coordinating staff schedules for In-Home Care Services to ensure consistent and reliable support for individuals receiving services. This position works closely with Coordinators, Managers, and Direct Support staff to manage scheduling needs, address call-ins, and maintain accurate scheduling records. The Scheduler plays a key role in ensuring shifts are covered; leave requests are processed appropriately, and scheduling systems remain accurate and up to date.

This position is scheduled Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM and participates in a rotating on-call schedule, including holidays, to assist with staffing needs.

Key Responsibilities

Scheduling Operations

  • Coordinate daily and future schedules for In-Home Care Services staff to ensure coverage for all assigned clients; including identifying additional staff to train as back up coverage in participant’s home.

  • Receive and manage staff scheduling calls, including call-ins, coverage needs, and scheduling adjustments.

  • Review and prioritize employee leave requests in accordance with Arc of Acadiana policies and operational needs.

  • Contact trained back-up staff for coverage prior to utilizing float staff when shifts become available.

  • Assist with scheduling related to staff training, including new hire training and required program training schedules.

  • Coordinate scheduling needs related to client appointments, including recurring medical appointments when applicable.

  • Perform other related duties and support program operations as assigned by the Program Manager.

Communication and Coordination

  • Communicate scheduling updates and changes to Coordinators and program leadership as needed.

  • Work collaboratively with Coordinators to ensure staff assigned to clients are approved and trained as appropriate.

  • Notify management when shifts cannot be covered, or when scheduling concerns arise that require escalation.

  • Communicate scheduling concerns or recurring staffing challenges to the Program Manager.

Systems and Documentation

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date schedules within the agency’s scheduling software.

  • Ensure employee time off and schedule changes are coded correctly within scheduling systems.

  • Document scheduling calls and requests, including details of the request and resolution.

  • Utilize internal communication tools such as Outlook and system messaging to communicate schedule updates as appropriate.

Coverage and Escalation

  • Coordinate coverage for unexpected absences or last-minute staffing needs.

  • Escalate scheduling issues to management when coverage cannot be secured or when staffing concerns impact service delivery.

  • Assist with troubleshooting scheduling issues and identifying potential coverage solutions.

title: Product Security Engineer
description:
LOCATION - ONSITE: CALMSDEN, CIRENCESTER, UK & IN THE FIELD WHEN NEEDED

THE LAST FRONTIER

The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure.

ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox—an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence—is why we exist.

Our solution is autonomy.

We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.

Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.

THE ROLE
We’re hiring our first Product Security Engineer. Security Engineering at ARD blends sharp technical skill, an attacker's mindset, and tangible real-world stakes. You'll operate across our entire hardware and software product suite — cloud infrastructure, applications, identity systems, and the autonomous products we field — spotting and cutting down the risks that actually matter. The systems we run and the data we hold call for a security approach that's thorough, flexible, and woven into everything we do. Your work will directly underpin the trust partners, customers, and the public place in us, while keeping our teams free to build and ship with confidence. Given how high the stakes are at ARD, this is core to delivering our mission the right way.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Spot, evaluate, and rank security risks across our physical products, systems and infrastructure — separating hypothetical worries from genuine threats to the business

  • Build and roll out practical security controls across cloud platforms, applications, products, and data, and help engineering teams do likewise

  • Build and use threat models to catch architectural weak points, trust boundary gaps, and failure modes before they turn into incidents

  • Own secure-by-design evidence, EN 18031/CRA Annex I assessments, fuzzing/pen-test programmes, the vulnerability register and advisories

  • Work alongside engineering, product, and operations teams as a trusted security partner — offering patterns, guidance, and guardrails rather than acting as a gatekeeper

  • Play a part in detecting, investigating, and containing security incidents, and push for lasting fixes based on what we learn

  • Cut down on manual, reactive security work through automation, better tooling, and secure-by-default habits built into how we develop and run systems

  • Apply technical rigour to assurance work like audits, certifications, and customer security reviews — making sure our controls hold up in practice, not just on paper

WHAT WE VALUE

  • Deep, hands-on skill in one or two security domains — application security, cloud security, identity and access management, cryptography, detection and response, or platform security — backed by real evidence of impact

  • An instinct for trust boundaries, failure modes, blast radius, and attacker behaviour, rather than viewing vulnerabilities in isolation

  • A knack for turning complex security risk into terms that land with engineers, product managers, and senior leadership alike, and for shaping outcomes through persuasion rather than title

  • A risk-based approach — weighing decisions proportionately under uncertainty, and always asking whether the work cuts real risk rather than just checking a compliance box

  • Comfort juggling multiple teams and technical domains at once without losing quality or judgement

  • A history of finding gaps and pushing security fixes through to completion, even in messy or loosely defined problem spaces

BONUS POINTS

  • Time spent in or around regulated, high-assurance, or defence-adjacent settings where security demands are intricate and failure carries real weight

  • Practical offensive security background — red teaming, penetration testing, or adversarial simulation — that shapes how you think about defensive design and threat modelling

  • Awareness of security issues unique to AI or machine learning systems, such as model integrity, data pipeline security, or adversarial ML

  • A hand in building security programmes at scale — security champions networks, secure development lifecycle tooling, or company-wide risk frameworks

  • A background in cloud-native security engineering, especially across AWS, GCP, or Azure, spanning infrastructure-as-code, container security, and cloud identity patterns

  • Some exposure to supply chain security issues, such as dependency management, build pipeline integrity, or third-party component assurance

  • Experience working with classified data, government security frameworks, or cross-domain security requirements

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation

  • Equity — meaningful options as an early employee at an early-stage company

  • Private healthcare, dental & optician

  • Real field exposure — travel to Arctic sites and Outposts when needed (genuinely, not as a gimmick)

  • Mission-driven culture — focus on impact, not hours logged

  • Small team, real ownership — what you build matters and ships
