title: People Services Specialist
description:
Job Title

People Services Specialist

Department

Human Resources-BG-UK

Overview of Department

The people team develops the capabilities, culture and experiences that create a human and commercial edge for Baillie Gifford. We exist to make the firm the world’s most distinctive place to grow a career, investing in our people with the same long-term conviction as our portfolios and continually reimagining how work is done to outpace the industry.

The team supports the full people lifecycle, including people operations, people partnering, leadership, learning and capability development, attraction and resourcing, organisational culture, reward, wellbeing and the end-to-end people experience.

Through this work, we ensure that people and performance are deeply connected and that our colleagues are equipped to deliver long-term value for clients.

Purpose of Role

Our People Services team brings our people strategy to life through the day-to-day moments that matter, resolving colleague queries and delivering the core operational processes that support people throughout their time at the firm.

Supporting around 1,700 colleagues across 11 countries, the team combines responsive support, accurate and consistent operations, sound judgement, strong controls and continuous improvement to make the everyday people experience seamless, scalable and reliable. In doing so, the team is a critical enabler of pace, performance and confidence across the organisation.

As a People Services Specialist, you’ll bring expertise, judgement and ownership to the more complex moments across the employee lifecycle. Acting as a trusted operational partner, you’ll lead specialist and non-standard work, resolve difficult issues and advise on the most effective way to deliver complex people processes.

Alongside operational delivery, our Specialists play a leading role in improving People Services. Drawing on operational insight, you’ll identify where processes, systems, data or guidance are creating friction or risk before helping shape and deliver practical improvements. By turning operational learning into sustainable change, you’ll improve the reliability, effectiveness and experience of People Services over time.

Responsibilities

Service delivery and operational expertise

  • Delivers high-quality people services across the employee lifecycle, taking ownership of more complex, sensitive or specialist operational work, queries and cases within the People Services remit
  • Advises on the operational elements of complex people processes and business changes, helping teams design practical, well-controlled approaches and plan effective delivery across processes, data and systems
  • Provides deeper expertise in one or more areas such as payroll, right to work, visas, benefits, organisational data, compliance or regulated processes, applying sound judgement and resolving exceptions
  • Acts as a visible and trusted face of the People team, providing accessible, knowledgeable and human support to colleagues and managers and helping them understand what is happening, what they need to do and what comes next

Service quality, risk and resilience

  • Ensures people systems, workflows and operational reporting run effectively by investigating and resolving complex or recurring data-quality issues and protecting the integrity of organisational structures, positions, profiles and other critical people data
  • Supports audit, risk and compliance activity by providing evidence, responding to requests, investigating exceptions and addressing control or process weaknesses
  • Coordinates the resolution of more complex operational incidents and service failures, assessing impact, involving the right stakeholders and ensuring lessons are reflected in processes and controls

Insight and continuous improvement

  • Uses case trends, recurring queries, service data and feedback to identify improvement opportunities and strengthen the colleague experience, processes, controls, workflows, templates and knowledge content
  • Partners with the People Services Lead and People Product Lead to diagnose operational problems, translate needs into clear process or system requirements and support the design and adoption of improved ways of working

Team development

  • Builds team capability by sharing specialist expertise, coaching others, improving guidance and embedding clear escalation routes, decision-making principles and quality standards

What success looks like

  • Trusted expertise: Colleagues and managers receive knowledgeable, timely support through complex people processes and have confidence that issues are owned through to resolution.
  • Specialist operational delivery: Complex operational work is delivered accurately, consistently and in line with regulatory, policy and governance requirements.
  • Strong operational control: People data, systems and operational controls are maintained to a high standard, reducing risk and improving service reliability.
  • Continuous improvement: Operational insight is translated into practical improvements that simplify processes, strengthen controls and enhance the colleague experience.
  • Team capability: Specialist knowledge is shared across the team, building capability, consistency and resilience.

Your knowledge and experience

  • Significant hands-on experience delivering People Services or HR operations across the employee lifecycle, with responsibility for complex, sensitive or specialist operational work.
  • Demonstrable expertise in one or more specialist operational areas such as payroll, benefits, right to work, visas, organisational data, compliance or regulated people processes.
  • Strong judgement and problem-solving skills, with experience interpreting policy and resolving complex or non-standard situations.
  • Experience using HR systems and maintaining high-quality people data, with a strong understanding of governance, controls and accuracy.
  • Proven ability to manage queries and operational work from start to finish, coordinating inputs and communicating clearly with everyone involved.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships and provide clear, practical advice to colleagues, managers and stakeholders.
  • Experience identifying and implementing service improvements using operational insight, data and colleague feedback.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly and adapt your approach to different audiences.

The type of candidate we're looking for

We’re looking for someone who combines hands-on operational expertise with sound judgement and enjoys solving complex problems. You’ll take ownership of difficult situations from start to finish, providing trusted advice and helping colleagues and managers navigate unfamiliar or sensitive people processes with confidence. You’ll be comfortable moving between detailed operational delivery, urgent problem-solving and longer-term improvement. You’ll naturally look for opportunities to improve how work is done, using operational insight, colleague feedback and data to identify better ways of delivering services. You’ll balance colleague experience with operational efficiency, compliance and risk, understanding the importance of accurate data, well-controlled processes and clear communication. You’ll build strong relationships across the People team, sharing specialist knowledge, coaching others and helping to embed consistent, high-quality ways of working. Calm, curious and pragmatic, you’ll be motivated by delivering an excellent service today while helping to shape even better services for tomorrow.

Critical skills

  • Systems thinking
  • Improvement mindset
  • Nurture relationships
  • Team working
  • Digital effectiveness (including AI)

​

Additional information:

Instead of a cover letter, candidates are asked to submit a CV and short written responses (maximum 300 words each) to the following questions:

  • Question 1 – Describe a time when you resolved a complex or sensitive operational issue that required sound judgement and specialist expertise.
  • Question 2 – Tell us about a time when you improved a People service, process or operational activity, making it more effective, consistent or reliable.

    Closing Date

    August 18, 2026

    Should you choose to use AI tools to support your application, we ask that you do this thoughtfully. We encourage you to ensure your application reflects your own voice, experience, and motivations. We value authenticity and want to understand your individual strengths and perspectives.


    At Baillie Gifford, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful culture in which each of our colleagues can thrive and develop. We believe that our clients are best served by a diverse workforce with the experiences, ideas and perspectives that this brings.


    If you are currently working at Baillie Gifford as an employee or contractor please apply to this job from the firm's Workday internal career site.

title: TMM Associate - Frankfurt
description:
Working in partnership to build better businesses.


Triton is an investment firm that believes in engaging with boards, managers and employees to build better businesses. We are entrepreneurs who invest capital where we can see an opportunity to create long-term value.

We believe Triton is a great place to work and we want our team to be entrepreneurial, enjoy being part of a collective effort, inspire and challenge each other, and to bring an international mindset.

About Triton

Founded in 1997 and partner-owned, Triton is a leading European mid-market sector specialist investor focused on mission-critical businesses across Business Services, Industrial Tech, and Healthcare. With over 150+ investment professionals across 11 offices, Triton invests through three complementary strategies:

  • Mid-Market Private Equity (TMM): Equity positions of €200–500m+ in companies with enterprise values of €400m–2bn+. The sixth flagship fund (T6) recently closed at €5.5bn, the firm's largest to date.
  • Smaller Mid-Cap Private Equity (TSM): Applies Triton's operational expertise to smaller European companies, targeting equity positions of €30–80m.
  • Opportunistic Credit (TDO): Senior-secured debt in sound mid-market businesses facing temporary headwinds, with new strategies under development including in the CLO space.

Some of Triton’s key differentiators include proprietary deal access through strong local presence, partnerships with global corporates and family-owned businesses, a repeatable investment playbook, and the Accelerator Unit. Acting as Triton's dedicated value creation group with over 50 operational and functional specialists across areas such as Leadership & Culture, Full Potential planning, AI & Digital and Sustainability, this is one of the largest such platforms in European private equity.

Triton's over 300 investors include leading pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, insurers, family offices, and endowments. With key offices in London, Stockholm and Frankfurt, Triton also maintains a broader presence across the Nordics, DACH, Benelux, China, and the US.

The Role

As an Associate at Triton, you will play a key role in the full investment lifecycle—from deal origination and execution to value creation and eventual exit. You will gain unparalleled access to senior management teams and decision-makers, both internally and externally, while taking on significant responsibility from day one.

Working within lean deal teams, you will lead critical work streams and represent the firm in transactions and portfolio company engagements.

This role is highly collaborative and requires strong relationship-building skills. You will engage with C-level executives, board members, industry leaders, LPs, advisers, and peers, expanding Triton’s network and influence.

At Triton, we are hands-on investors. Our team members are expected to shape and execute strategic change at portfolio companies, working directly with leadership to drive growth and operational excellence. International travel and the ability to navigate diverse cultural environments are key to success.

In return, Triton offers a strong support network to develop your investment acumen, mentorship from experienced professionals, and the opportunity to co-invest alongside the fund—directly rewarding you for the value you help create.

Essential Requirements

  • A minimum of 2 years’ experience in investment banking, PE consulting or private equity
  • Proven track record of deal execution roles
  • Strong technical skills including financial modelling
  • Persuasive verbal and written communication in English

Core Competencies

  • Project Execution – Plan, organize, and resource projects effectively to ensure successful execution
  • Growth Mindset – Continuously seek improvement, innovation, and learning from experiences
  • Resilience & Adaptability – Maintain composure under pressure, navigate challenges with a solution-driven approach, and persist through setbacks
  • Risk Awareness – Understand and proactively assess risk exposure to identify potential issues early
  • Strategic Thinking – Question assumptions, challenge the status quo, and seek opportunities to drive innovation
  • Communication & Influence – Articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively, both in writing and conversations
  • Relationship Building – Foster and maintain trusted partnerships built on mutual respect and collaboration
  • Industry Knowledge – Stay informed on market trends, innovations, regulatory changes, and thought leadership
  • Analytical Skills – Gather, organize, and interpret data to uncover insights and patterns
  • Ownership Mentality – Approach investments with a long-term perspective, balancing short-term gains with sustainable value creation
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset – Proactively identify and seize opportunities, challenge conventional thinking, and take initiative in driving impactful outcomes
  • AI and Large Language (LLM) Models Proficiency

Triton is an equal opportunity employer. We recognise that diversity is key to our continued success, and strive to maintain a fair and equitable recruitment process for all applicants.

title: Graduate / Entry Level Mixed Signal IC Layout Designer
description:
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. But we couldn’t do it without our extraordinary workforce – and that’s where you come in. Join our team and help us continue to make Cirrus Logic an exceptional place to grow your career!

Join Cirrus Logic’s Edinburgh team as a Graduate / Entry-level Mixed-Signal IC Layout Engineer and kick-start your career designing high-performance silicon for cutting-edge applications.

To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate understanding of semiconductor physics and manufacturing technologies. We welcome recent graduates as well as candidates with first-level layout experience to support analogue design engineers, and physical design engineers.

You will gain mentorship from technical leaders, see your efforts resulting in silicon designs incorporated into world-class products, and career progression in an environment based around innovation and collaboration.

  • Work closely with design engineers to achieve optimal circuit performance and produce high-quality layout designs
  • Create layout floorplans and provide area estimates with accuracy
  • Provide schedule estimates and updates to senior staff and management with clarity
  • Collaborate with engineers to deliver efficient floorplans and layout designs
  • Contribute to complex IC development projects and prepare documents for knowledge sharing

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electronics/Computer Engineering or related program
  • Knowledge of semiconductor physics
  • Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes
  • Ability to solve layout design problems and provide innovative solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable working in a team environment set-up
  • Proven record of completing tasks on time or ahead of schedule while maintaining quality

    • Preferred Skills and Qualifications:
  • Ability to layout simple to complex analog circuitry in a size/time constrained environment
  • Comfortable with various IC design CAD tools and foundry PDKs
  • Knowledge of analog, digital, and mixed-signal fundamental layout techniques
  • Understanding of ESD, Latch-up, Layout parasitic, EMIR, LDE, DFM and Antenna effect
  • Proficiency in floor planning activities with block assembly, and block-level routing
  • Understand layout matching, isolation, shielding, and the use of dummy devices
  • Demonstrated ability to contribute ideas for improved efficiency and automation of layout tasks

title: Reconciliations Officer
description:

title: Senior Specialist: Knowledge Management
description:
Empowering Africa’s tomorrow, together…one story at a time.

With over 100 years of rich history and strongly positioned as a local bank with regional and international expertise, a career with our family offers the opportunity to be part of this exciting growth journey, to reset our future and shape our destiny as a proudly African group.

Job Summary

Ensures that HC service delivery is governed through robust frameworks, compliant policies, and clearly defined service commitments, while enabling consistent, high quality execution through standardised knowledge assets. Operating as a subject matter expert and trusted partner to HC service leaders, the role translates HC strategy, regulatory requirements, and organisational policies into practical governance mechanisms, measurable SLAs, and accessible knowledge artefacts that enable service excellence, risk mitigation, and improved colleague experience across multiple markets.

Job Description

KEY FOCUS AREAS:

  • HC Service Governance Frameworks
  • Service Level Agreement (SLA) Definition and Performance Management
  • Knowledge Management Standardisation and Enablement
  • Policy, Procedure and SOP Custodianship
  • Cross‑Functional Governance and Stakeholder Engagement
  • Continuous Improvement, Benchmarking and Best Practice Adoption

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

HC Service Governance Frameworks:

  • Establish and maintain HC service governance frameworks that ensure consistent service delivery aligned to Absa policies, regulatory obligations, and pan‑African operating standards.
  • Translate organisational and HC strategic requirements into clear governance principles, controls, and review mechanisms.
  • Monitor adherence to governance frameworks, identifying risks, gaps, and areas requiring intervention.

Service Level Agreement (SLA) Definition and Performance Management:

  • Define, document, and implement SLAs across all HC service lines, ensuring measurable, achievable, and business‑aligned commitments.
  • Monitor SLA performance through agreed metrics, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Conduct regular SLA performance reviews with HC service leaders, recommending corrective actions and improvement initiatives where service commitments are not met.

Knowledge Management Standardisation and Enablement:

  • Design and standardise knowledge management processes across HC, ensuring consistency, usability, and sustainability.
  • Create, curate, and maintain a centralised HC knowledge repository, covering all HC service lines and geographies.
  • Ensure knowledge assets (knowledge articles, FAQs, SOPs, process guides) are accurate, current, and fit‑for‑purpose to improve first‑time resolution and reduce service errors.

Policy, Procedure and SOP Custodianship:

  • Act as custodian of HC service policies, procedures, and SOPs, ensuring effective version control, approval governance, and audit readiness.
  • Coordinate regular policy and procedure reviews to ensure ongoing relevance, regulatory compliance, and alignment with operating models.
  • Ensure changes to policies and procedures are clearly communicated and embedded within HC delivery teams.

Cross‑Functional Governance and Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Facilitate cross‑functional governance forums to review SLA performance, policy compliance, knowledge updates, and operational risks.
  • Build strong working relationships with HC service leaders, centres of excellence, risk, compliance, and technology stakeholders.
  • Influence stakeholders to adopt governance standards and knowledge practices that enhance service consistency and customer experience.

Continuous Improvement, Benchmarking and Best Practice Adoption:

  • Benchmark HC governance, SLA, and knowledge management practices against internal and external industry standards.
  • Identify opportunities for operational efficiency, automation, and service optimisation.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen governance maturity, service performance, and organisational learning.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

Knowledge:

  • Human Capital service delivery models
  • Governance and risk management principles
  • Service Level Agreement frameworks and performance metrics
  • Knowledge management methodologies and tools
  • Regulatory and compliance requirements in a pan‑African context

Skills:

  • Analytical and problem‑solving capability
  • Stakeholder engagement and facilitation
  • Data interpretation and service performance analysis
  • Process design and documentation
  • Written and verbal business communication

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE:

Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s Degree, Advanced Diploma, Postgraduate Certificate, or B Tech [NQF Level 7] in Knowledge Management, Information or Information Systems, Human Resources, Business or Operations Management, Governance, or a related field.

Work Experience:

  • 5–12 years’ experience in a specialised capability relevant to the bank, with a minimum of 3 years’ proven track record in leading people, initiatives, or functional outcomes.
  • Demonstrated exposure to HC service governance, SLA management, knowledge management, process standardisation, quality improvement, and technology‑enabled, data‑driven service delivery.

COMPETENCIES:

Technical Competencies:

  • Knowledge repository and content management systems
  • SLA tracking and reporting tools
  • Process mapping and documentation standards
  • Data analysis and dashboard reporting
  • Microsoft 365 and enterprise collaboration platforms

Behavioural Competencies:

  • Strategic and systems thinking
  • Critical thinking and sound judgement
  • Managing knowledge and organisational learning
  • Influencing and stakeholder alignment
  • Collaboration across functions and geographies
  • Adaptability and continuous improvement mindset
  • Delivery focus with strong accountability

Leadership Competencies:

  • Strategic Thinking
  • Business Acumen
  • Communication
  • Influence
  • Leadership
  • Delivering Results
  • Adaptability
  • Collaboration
  • Decision-Making

Education

Bachelor`s Degrees and Advanced Diplomas: Digital Media, Master's Degree: Marketing

title: Servicerådgivare Solna
description:
Är du en bilentusiast som har erfarenhet av fordonsbranschen, eller en servicerådgivare som är sugen på att ta dig an nya utmaningar? Då kan den här tjänsten vara något för dig!

Arbetet som servicerådgivare kommer ha ett stort fokus på kundkontakt, och kommer även att vara ett återkommande område genom hela arbetet. Uppgifter kan vara: Hjälpa kunder med olika frågor om bildelar, till att rådgiva om olika servicejobb. Sköta administrativa uppgifter som att skapa arbetsordrar, till beställningar av reservdelar.

Om tjänsten:

-Ta emot kunder vid in- och utlämning av fordon -Upprätta kostnadskalkyler och ge prisuppgifter -Kommunicera med tekniker för att följa upp arbetsorder -Säkerställa att rätt reservdelar och tjänster erbjuds -Ha löpande kontakt med kunder för att informera om status -Administrera bokningar, offerter och fakturor

Vi söker dig som:

- God systemvana inom något av följande system: (KOBRA, CABAS, WINASSIST). - Har relativt god kunskap om reservdelar. - Teknisk kunskap om personbilar. - Strukturerat arbete. - Manuellt B-körkort.

Tjänsten är på heltid med arbetstider förlagda under dagtid, måndag till fredag.

Vi är ett bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag nischade inom fordonsbranschen. Vi har nära samarbeten med flera stora verkstäder och bilåterförsäljare i Stockholms län.

Intervjuer genomförs löpande, så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig och välkomna dig till vårt team!

title: Consultant Psychiatrist PAYE
description:
An opportunity to help patients who have run out of options

For many people living with chronic pain, the journey has been long. They have tried multiple medications, procedures and therapies, yet their pain continues to impact every aspect of daily life. By the time they reach us, many are looking for another option where conventional treatment has fallen short.

We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultants specialising in Pain Management to join our clinical team.

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to help shape how cannabis based medicines are used within pain management in the UK.

You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We are looking for experienced Pain Management Consultants with sound clinical judgement, an open mind and a genuine interest in improving outcomes for patients with complex chronic pain. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and patient care.

What you will be doing:

  • Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment.

  • Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management.

  • Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices.

  • Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards.

  • Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists.

  • Participate in ongoing training and professional development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBMPs).

What you need:

  • Full GMC Registration

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

  • On the GMC Specialist Register for Pain

  • Demonstrated interest in alternative therapies

  • Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

Why join us?

  • Highly Competitive Salary: £190,000 - £275,000 FTE, pro rata for part time roles based on experience and hours worked.

  • Flexible Working: Full time or part time options available

  • Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu will cover all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us

  • Private Healthcare

  • Work-Life Balance: No night shifts or on call requirements

  • Cutting Edge Training: Access to CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders

  • Collaborative Environment: Join a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals

  • Personal Growth: Be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK

Training & Development:

  • Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians (sponsored by Montu)

  • Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant).

  • Ongoing support and training on clinical protocols, prescribing practices, and Montu’s system usage

Working arrangements:

  • Remote Role: Flexible working hours and days

  • Session Structure:

  • Standard session length: 4 hours

  • Appointment duration: 15 minutes (new and existing patients)

Montu’s multidisciplinary model allows consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care, while nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks.

If you are passionate about innovative patient care, thrive in a dynamic environment, and are looking to make a real impact in the field of medical cannabis, we would love to hear from you!

Sessions:

Each standard session consists of 4 hours of patient consultations. Clinicians can choose their preferred working days and hours, with sessions spread flexibly if needed.

To support onboarding, clinicians are required to commit to a minimum of 2 sessions per week/ 8 hours initially, to ensure they become proficient with Montu’s platform.

Appointment Durations:

Appointments are 15 minutes in length for new and existing patients as Montu operates a multidisciplinary approach, leveraging a clinical skills mix where nurses and pharmacists handle pre-consultation and follow-up prescribing tasks allowing Consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care.

About MONTU

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines (CBPM). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and offering an exceptional standard of care. Our dynamic and supportive work environment is the perfect place for you to grow professionally while making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

Compensation: £190K – £275K

  • • Pro rata per annum based on experience and hours worked £190K – £275K

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
HEY THERE!

You've run Kubernetes in production long enough to know the difference between using a cluster and owning one. Maybe you're part of a large platform team where you only ever see your slice. Here, you'd see all of it: our Platform Engineering team is small and senior, building and running the infrastructure that Yazio's Backend and Data Engineering teams deploy to every day. We're hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to help us run that platform and push it further toward cloud-native.

Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.

YOUR MISSION

Think of our platform as an internal product, with Yazio's engineers as your users. You'll:

  • Run and evolve our Kubernetes landscape (Amazon EKS, plus on-prem clusters via Rancher). Every deployment at Yazio lands on what you operate

  • Automate deployment and scaling until releases are a non-event, and guide engineering teams in getting the most out of that automation

  • Build out observability so you spot problems before users notice them: metrics, dashboards, alerting

  • Dig into infrastructure-level incidents and turn what you find into fixes that stick

  • Design the abstractions that let Backend and Data Engineers ship without opening a ticket

  • Have a real say in our shift away from the remaining self-hosted infrastructure: what moves to the cloud, what stays and what gets automated away

YOUR PROFILE

You'll thrive here if:

  • You've operated Kubernetes in production for years. Upgrades, capacity planning, debugging the cluster itself, not just the workloads running on it

  • Observability, GitOps and deployment automation are how you work by default, not extras you bolt on later

  • You're at home on a Linux host, and the second time you touch something manual, you automate it

  • You know databases (relational and key-value) and networking well enough to reason through a production issue. You don't need to be a DBA or a network engineer; curiosity covers the rest

  • Small team, changing priorities, nobody handing you a spec: that sounds like your kind of week

  • When you explain a complex technical trade-off, people leave the conversation clearer than they arrived

Bonus points for:

  • Go (a lot of our tooling is written in it, and so is the Kubernetes ecosystem) or Python beyond simple scripting

  • Running self-hosted databases in production, replication and recovery included

  • Deep networking knowledge (TLS, TCP/UDP internals)

  • Operating on-prem Kubernetes with Rancher

OUR CORE TECH STACK

Here's what we currently run in production:

  • Infrastructure & platform: Kubernetes (Amazon EKS and on-prem via Rancher), Docker, Linux-based systems, AWS

  • CI/CD & automation: GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Ansible, GitOps workflows

  • Databases: MariaDB and PostgreSQL

  • Monitoring & observability: Prometheus, Grafana, InfluxDB, Elasticsearch, Graylog

  • Programming: Go, Python, Bash

If you've run Kubernetes on GKE or AKS rather than EKS, the patterns transfer.

WHY US?

  • An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating

  • A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space or work abroad for several weeks per year

  • 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you

  • A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours—no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!

  • A high-impact environment where your work drives real change—short decision-making processes and no micromanagement

  • A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections—from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks

  • Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development

  • A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being—supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender identity, race, religion, age, sexual orientation or ability, feels valued and empowered. We celebrate different perspectives and actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

READY TO JOIN US?

Excited to take Yazio to the next level and help people worldwide lead healthier lives? We’d love to hear from you! Please send us:

  • Your CV in English

  • Any additional materials that showcase your work (e.g., LinkedIn profile, portfolio)

title: Associate, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing Operations, Lilly Medicine Foundry
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.

Organization and Position Overview

Lilly recently announced a $4.5 billion investment to create the Lilly Medicine Foundry, a new center for advanced manufacturing and drug development. The first-ever facility of its kind, combining research and manufacturing in a single location, the Medicine Foundry will allow Lilly to further develop innovative solutions to optimize manufacturing processes and increase capacity for clinical trial medicines, while also reducing costs and environmental impact.

As the Foundry is currently in design and construction (startup phase anticipated completion in 2027), the initial position will be fluid and dynamic as we endeavor to support the delivery of the Foundry, build a new organization, develop and implement the necessary systems and business processes required to support GMP operations, and build the site culture. This will require collaboration, creativity and resilience as the site grows to a full scale GMP manufacturing facility.

Once start up activities are completed, the Quality Assurance Associate, Manufacturing Operations role will perform manufacturing production floor QA support functions which includes day to day Quality oversight of GMP operations, change management and investigation reviews as well as other activities, as assigned.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in creating and maintaining a safe work environment.
  • Foster a strong collaborative quality culture including maintaining open communication and promoting teamwork and employee participation in the work group and with cross-functional teams.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and guidelines to support GMP activities.
  • Review GMP documentation including procedures, deviations, technical reports, change controls, etc.
  • Work cross-functionally with the plant teams to provide operational support, and issue management.
  • Assist with inspection readiness activities.
  • Effectively communicate with internal and external stakeholders.

Basic Requirements:

  • BA/BS degree in Engineering, Science, or other related field and a minimum of 2 years technical and/or quality experience in Biotech or Pharmaceutical FDA regulated industry
  • Understand GMP requirements for early phase development and manufacturing and in application of quality management systems.
  • Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

Additional Preferences:

  • Effective project and time management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize and handle multiple concurrent tasks.
  • Cognitive abilities, which include problem solving, verbal reasoning, attention detail, critical thinking and analytical competencies.
  • Demonstrated strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Effective organization/self-management skills
  • Demonstrated relevant experience in a cGMP facility.
  • Relevant industry experience in high paced working environment.
  • Critical thinking and technical problem-solving skills, including root cause analysis/troubleshooting skills.
  • Flexibility to adjust quickly and effectively to frequent changes and altered priorities.
  • Ability to identify and prioritize issues and develop & implement solutions.
  • High learning agility and ability to deal with ambiguity, uncertainty.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail.

Other Information:

  • Position Location - Initial location: Indianapolis, IN US; Future: Lebanon IN Lilly Medicine Foundry Operations
  • Travel Percentage: 5% - 15%
  • May be required to provide on-call support outside of normal working hours including nights, weekends, and holidays.

title: Global Asset Lead, Iqirvo
description:
Title:

Global Asset Lead, Iqirvo

Company:

Ipsen Biopharmaceuticals Inc.


About Ipsen:

Ipsen is a mid-sized global biopharmaceutical company with a focus on transformative medicines in three therapeutic areas: Oncology, Rare Disease and Neuroscience. Supported by nearly 100 years of development experience, with global hubs in the U.S., France and the U.K, we tackle areas of high unmet medical need through research and innovation.

Our passionate teams in more than 40 countries are focused on what matters and endeavor every day to bring medicines to patients in 88 countries. We build a workplace that champions human-centric leadership and fosters a culture of collaboration, excellence and impact. At Ipsen, every individual is empowered to be their true selves, grow and thrive alongside the company’s success. Join us on our journey towards sustainable growth, creating real impact on patients and society!

For more information, visit us at and follow our latest news on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Job Description:

VP, Global Asset Lead, Oncology

Locations: Cambridge (US) | London (UK) | Paris (France)

Shape the Future of Oncology. Lead an Asset. Change Patients' Lives.

At Ipsen, we are not simply developing medicines. We are redefining what is possible for patients facing some of the world's most challenging cancers.

We are seeking an exceptional VP, Global Asset Lead, Oncology to take ultimate accountability for the vision, strategy, and value creation of a critical global oncology asset. This is one of the most influential leadership roles within our R&D organization, offering the opportunity to drive an asset from development through commercialization while shaping its global impact on patients, healthcare systems, and scientific innovation.

This role demands a rare combination of scientific credibility, strategic excellence, commercial acumen, and inspirational leadership. You will operate at the centre of decision-making, partnering with senior executives and leading a highly matrixed global team to maximise asset value, accelerate delivery, and ensure long-term success across the entire product lifecycle.

If you are an entrepreneurial leader who thrives in complexity, influences at the highest levels, and is motivated by delivering breakthrough outcomes for patients, this is an opportunity to leave a lasting mark on oncology.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the SVP, Oncology Therapeutic Area Head, R&D, the Global Asset Lead is accountable for maximizing and delivering asset value targets.

The successful leader will lead a cross-functional Global Asset Team and define, develop, and execute an integrated asset strategy spanning development, manufacturing, regulatory, market access, and commercial activities throughout the asset lifecycle.

As the strategic leader and ultimate ambassador for the asset, you will drive alignment across functions, influence key stakeholders across the enterprise, and ensure delivery against critical milestones and performance objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Asset Leadership

  • Lead the cross-functional Global Asset Team to build the vision and strategy to maximize value of the Asset.
  • In partnership with the Global Asset Team, you will:
  • Create scientific and commercial value from early development to initial approval, from late development phase to patent expiry, adapted for each asset.
  • Own the overall program strategy, establish project goals and lead a cross-functional team to meet program objectives.
  • Outline an integrated development strategy that shapes the competitive and prescription landscape.
  • Translate strategy into an efficiently executable high-level roadmap with clear priorities.

Operational Excellence & Delivery

  • Oversee operations, ensure strong alignment across all functions, and drive operational excellence in execution, supported by a project manager.
  • Identify opportunities through bold and disruptive leadership, translating vision into robust planning based on internal and external insights.
  • Maintain strong scientific, technical, and clinical expertise in the therapeutic area, critically evaluating relevant medical literature and competitive developments to inform lifecycle management strategy.
  • Set short and long-term product strategy and operational priorities aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Drive and coordinate development, registration, launch, market-facing activities, and lifecycle management initiatives to maximise both short and long-term asset value.

Stakeholder Leadership & Governance

  • Lead communication platforms across key internal and external stakeholders.
  • Maintain visibility and credibility within the therapeutic area among internal and external stakeholders.
  • Serve as spokesperson for the asset, reporting progress, risks, and opportunities to functional and executive leadership teams.
  • Represent the interests of the asset within Ipsen Governance Committees.
  • Define and implement a comprehensive asset communication strategy.
  • Act as a role model and ambassador for the asset and for Ipsen across the scientific community, health authorities, healthcare practitioners, patients, and strategic partners.

Resource & Risk Management

  • Partner with functional leaders to define resource requirements and external needs for the five-year plan, ensuring optimal allocation of investment and capabilities.
  • Ensure comprehensive risk mitigation plans are developed, maintained, and executed.
  • Challenge resource allocation decisions across functions to maximise overall asset value.

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead high-performing, motivated cross-functional teams.
  • Partner with functional leaders to establish objectives for dedicated Asset Team members and assess performance against asset-related goals.
  • Mobilise resources across a complex global matrix through influence, collaboration, and authentic leadership.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Foster a culture of innovation, agility, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive new ways of working through benchmarking, competitive intelligence, bold regulatory strategies, and open innovation partnerships.

title: Butikssäljare 40%, Stadium Lidköping
description:
Vill du jobba i ett team med engagerade kollegor, fyllt med energi? Ser du dig själv som driven, serviceinriktad och kommunikativ? Toppen, då kanske du är vår nästa stjärnspelare! Vi söker en butikssäljare till vårt team.

Stadiums mission är att inspirera till ett aktivt liv för alla. För att kunna göra det måste alla våra medarbetare har roligt på jobbet och drivas av samma sak som oss: att aktivera världen – vad är din drivkraft? Läs mer om våra drivkrafter på vår karriärsida.

Vad gör en butikssäljare på Stadium?Våra kunder ska känna sig välkomna hos oss, de ska bli inbjudna till en kundupplevelse runt hela löparbanan. En upplevelse som kännetecknas av service i världsklass. Som butikssäljare skapar du förutsättningar för våra kunder att hitta de produkter de söker. Den dagliga servicen inkluderar att stå i kassan, personlig försäljning och att se till att butiken är visuellt attraktiv och inspirerande, välfylld med våra produkter. Om du har intresse och kunskap om våra varumärken och produkter, är det ett stort plus.

Vem är du? Vi tror att du delar vårt sätt att tänka och våra övertygelser när det kommer till att se möjligheter i alla utmaningar. Du tycker om att ha mycket ansvar och möjlighet att växa i din roll. För att jobba på Stadium måste du vara minst 18 år. Om du har butikserfarenhet är det ett plus.

Vad erbjuder vi dig?Läs mer om vårt lag på vår Karriärsida, på Instagram WorkatStadium eller på Linkedin.

Klicka på länken här för att komma till ett av våra poddavsnitt och på 15 min få en inblick i hur det är att jobba på Stadium.

Varaktighet/arbetstid Tjänsten är tillsvidare på 40% med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Provanställning tillämpas.

Ansökan Som en del i rekryteringsprocessen kommer du att få en inbjudan till din e-mail till att besvara ett personlighetstest. Det tar ca 15 minuter att besvara testet. Vi kommunicerar mestadels genom mail så se till att hålla koll på din inkorg, håll även koll på skräpposten för säkerhets skull.

Eftersom vi alltid vill göra saker så enkelt som möjligt är det inte säkert att vi väntar till sista ansökningsdag innan vi går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen. Så vänta inte, sök redan nu.

Välkommen med din ansökan. Come join the movement!

Tycker du också att livet är roligare när det rör på sig?

Hos oss på Stadium jobbar lagspelare som brinner för försäljning, sport och sportmode. Energi, mod och laganda är några av de grundstenar som gjort att det lilla familjeföretaget från Norrköping blivit en av Nordens största sportkedjor. Men vi stannar inte där. Genom innovation och enkelhet fortsätter vi att utvecklas med nya koncept, fler produkter och varumärken på marknaden. Tävlingsandan och passionen genomsyrar allt vi gör och vår mission är att inspirera och ge fler människor möjlighet till ett aktivt liv.

Join the movement.

title: Service Delivery Engineer I - Remote US
description:
eGroup Enabling Technologies is a Microsoft Solutions Partner focused on helping organizations modernize, secure, and optimize their technology environments. As a fully remote organization with team members across the United States, we are committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences through technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Our teams partner with clients across cloud, security, infrastructure, collaboration, and managed services to provide strategic guidance and world-class support.

eGroup is seeking a Service Delivery Engineer I to join our Managed Services team. This role is responsible for supporting, troubleshooting, monitoring, and maintaining Microsoft cloud and infrastructure environments for a diverse portfolio of clients.

The ideal candidate combines technical expertise with strong communication and customer service skills. They are comfortable working directly with end users, IT administrators, and business stakeholders while collaborating with internal teams to resolve issues and deliver exceptional service. This position plays a critical role in ensuring the availability, security, and performance of our clients' environments.

This position operates in a shift-based support model. Assigned shifts may include daytime, evening, overnight, weekend, or holiday coverage based on business and customer requirements. Specific shift assignments will be discussed during the interview process.

Key Responsibilities

Incident Response & Technical Support

  • Troubleshoot, resolve, and document technical issues across Microsoft cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Respond to service requests, incidents, alerts, and escalations in accordance with established service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Escalate complex issues appropriately while maintaining ownership and driving resolution.
  • Collaborate with vendors, partners, and internal engineering teams to resolve customer-impacting issues.

Microsoft Cloud & Infrastructure Administration

  • Administer and support Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Teams, Intune, Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), and related technologies.
  • Monitor and maintain cloud and infrastructure environments to ensure stability, performance, security, and compliance.
  • Support license administration, user provisioning, access management, and device lifecycle activities.
  • Assist with deployment, configuration, and maintenance of cloud-based workloads and services.

Customer Experience & Relationship Management

  • Deliver exceptional customer service through clear, professional, and timely communication.
  • Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders by demonstrating technical expertise and accountability.
  • Translate technical concepts into business-friendly language when working with non-technical users.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of troubleshooting activities, resolutions, and environment changes.

Monitoring, Security & Operations

  • Actively monitor client environments and respond to planned or unplanned outage notifications.
  • Support operational processes related to security, compliance, and system health.
  • Assist with administration of Microsoft Defender and security-focused technologies.
  • Identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for proactive remediation.

Continuous Improvement & Team Collaboration

  • Contribute to service improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
  • Maintain and enhance technical documentation, standards, and operational procedures.
  • Participate in knowledge sharing, cross-training, and professional development activities.
  • Stay current on Microsoft technologies, emerging trends, and best practices.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in Managed Services, Technical Support, IT Operations, Consulting, or a related technology environment.
  • 1+ years of experience supporting Microsoft Azure and/or Microsoft 365 environments.
  • Experience administering Windows Server, Windows Desktop, and Active Directory environments.
  • Experience troubleshooting networking fundamentals including DNS, TCP/IP, VPN connectivity, switching, and firewall concepts.
  • Experience using IT service management or managed service provider (MSP) toolsets such as RMM, monitoring, or ticketing platforms.

Technical Knowledge

  • Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud services.
  • Microsoft 365 administration and support.
  • Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Management.
  • Microsoft Teams and collaboration technologies.
  • Microsoft Defender security solutions, including Endpoint, Identity, Microsoft 365, and Cloud Apps.
  • Enterprise identity and access management concepts.
  • Virtualization and cloud-hosted environments.

Professional Skills

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation practices.
  • Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating across distributed teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working for a Managed Service Provider (MSP).
  • Experience with Azure networking and hybrid infrastructure solutions.
  • Experience supporting voice and collaboration technologies, including Microsoft Teams Phone.
  • Experience with PowerShell administration and automation.
  • Experience with Power BI reporting and Microsoft operational dashboards.
  • Experience leveraging automation or AI-enabled tools to improve operational efficiency and support delivery.

Microsoft certifications such as:

  • Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
  • Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
  • Microsoft 365 Administrator Associate (MS-102)
  • Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)
  • Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900)

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
  • Equivalent professional experience may be substituted for formal education.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications are encouraged and supported.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain certifications aligned with business and customer requirements.

Career Growth & Development

At eGroup, Service Delivery Engineers are encouraged to grow their technical expertise, pursue certifications, and build career paths aligned with their strengths and interests.
Typical progression may include Service Delivery Engineer I, Service Delivery Engineer II, and Senior Service Delivery Engineer, with increasing ownership of complex issues, customer environments, mentoring, process improvement, and technical leadership.
As skills and business acumen grow, future opportunities may include Escalation Engineering, Security Engineering or Analysis, Cloud Architecture, Data Center Engineering, AI Architecture, Managed Services Leadership, or Customer Success.

Work Environment

100% remote position within the United States.

Company-provided equipment.

Reliable high-speed internet connection required.

Participation in shift coverage, on-call rotation, holidays, and occasional overtime as required.

Occasional travel for company meetings, training, or team events.

Please complete this candidate questionnaire. It allows us to learn more about our candidates and create customized interview questions. Candidates with completed questionnaires will receive priority review.

Salary: $55,000 base, negotiable based on relevant skills/experience, plus variable-based incentives or commissions

Job Overview

This role is responsible for leading all phases of assigned enterprise IT projects, serving as the single point of contact from concept through final implementation. This role defines project scope, develops detailed work plans and schedules, and ensures alignment with quality standards, budgets, and approved timelines. The individual coordinates across end users, technical teams, client services, and construction partners to integrate enterprise network and IT requirements into major renovations, upgrades, and new developments. Required:

Preferred:

  • Five (5) years of experience leading enterprise scale IT initiatives in a government environment.
  • Experience leading and managing teams to desired outcomes, on schedule, and within budget.
  • Experience managing projects utilizing the SAFe Agile and Tailored Waterfall project methodologies.
  • Experience tracking progress of each project against goals, objectives, approved budgets, timelines, and reporting statuses and variances in scope.
  • Experience identifying complex project risks and leading constructability reviews in relation to enterprise IT projects.

title: specjalista(-tka) ds. monitoringu rozmów ODZ
description:
specjalista(-tka) ds. monitoringu rozmów ODZ

Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę na zastępstwo,
  • pracę hybrydową częściowo w biurze w Poznaniu, ul. Kolorowa 8 i 10 (przy centrum handlowym King Cross) lub Wrocławiu, ul. Robotnicza 11 (przy muzeum współczesnym),
  • pracę na pełen etat (równoczesne zatrudnienie w naszym banku i u outsource’a),
  • zespół/lider: Zespół Monitoringu Rozmów ODZ, Jolanta Gumiela,
  • kwartalny system premiowy,
  • cel: przeprowadzanie weryfikacji rozmów Doradców i udzielanie informacji zwrotnej po odsłuchu.


Na bank cenimy sobie relacje z ludźmi. Szukamy osób, które tak jak my chcą zapewnić najlepszą jakość obsługi w sektorze finansowym - jesteśmy firmą technologiczną z usługami bankowym.

Należymy do pierwszej trójki największych banków w Polsce i jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej Grupy Erste. Nasz dział Contact Center to ponad 1300 osób w 4 miastach w Polsce – Warszawa, Wrocław, Poznań i Lublin. Do komunikacji z klientami wykorzystujemy audio, wideo, messenger, e-mail, czat czy naszego bota.

Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, może wnieść niepowtarzalną perspektywę do naszej firmy.

Aplikuj, jeśli:

  • posiadasz doświadczenie w pracy z Klientem,
  • dobrze odnajdujesz się w środowisku pełnym procedur, regulacji i instrukcji,
  • chcesz podnosić jakość, zwiększać satysfakcję Klientów, efektywność pracy doradców i podnosić bezpieczeństwo procesów realnych przez doradców w obszarze zdalnej sprzedaży i obsługi,
  • lubisz pracować zespołowo potrafisz zadbać o pozytywną atmosferę, chętnie dzielisz się wiedzą i wspierasz osoby z zespołu,
  • umiesz ustalać priorytety oraz kolejność zleconych zadań,
  • posiadasz umiejętność logicznego i analitycznego myślenia,
  • wykazujesz dużą otwartość na zmiany i na zdobywanie nowej wiedzy
  • jesteś komunikatywna/y i lubisz pracować pod presją czasu.



Mile widziane, jeśli będziesz mieć:

  • znajomość różnych metodologii mierzenia wyników jakościowych,
  • znajomość regulacji prawnych i procedur obowiązujących w banku.


Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • regularna weryfikacja rozmów z Klientami banku (telefon, czat, video, mail) w celu zachowania najwyższych standardów jakościowych oraz poprawności realizowanych procesów i zgodności z regulacjami i procedurami banku,
  • realizacja przyjętej liczby odsłuchów w ramach monitoringu rozmów,
  • udzielanie informacji zwrotnej po weryfikacji rozmów,
  • raportowanie statusów prac w ramach monitoringu rozmów,
  • zgłaszanie i rekomendacja usprawnień i zmian w standardach i procesach wynikających z wniosków z weryfikacji rozmów,
  • udział w tworzeniu strategii jakościowej obszaru,
  • współpraca innymi jednostkami Banku w celu zapewnienia spójności i skuteczności działań.


To masz na bank:

  • umowę na zastępstwo,
  • pracę w trybie hybrydowym (lokalizacja na początku oferty),
  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego),
  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego,
  • kartę Multisport,
  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na pracowniczych warunkach,
  • aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary, ćwiczenia, podcasty; inicjatywy w biurach np. mammobus, profilaktyczne badanie wzroku, warsztaty z samoobrony,
  • wyprawkę dla dzieci,
  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, całkowita praca zdalna, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala,
  • platformę ze szkoleniami zewnętrznymi i wewnętrznymi – np. programowanie czy analiza danych lub komunikacja, podejście strategiczne, negocjacje i inne,
  • program poleceń pracowniczych – nagrodę pieniężną za polecenie osoby do pracy w banku.


Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?

Na bank nie wrzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań.
Na początku Twoja przełożona pokaże Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowie na wszystkie pytania..

Dołącz do nas w kilku krokach:

  • Wyślij CV do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu.
  • Spotkaj się (online) z managerem.
  • Wykonaj zadanie merytoryczne/test (w zależności od stanowiska).
  • Pracuj z nami w naszym zespole!


Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania. Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

title: Software Engineer
description:
At Wealth Wizards our vision is a future where everybody in society has access to financial advice and guidance. Our Software as a Service (SaaS) platform provides engaging digital experiences for consumers and powerful tools for financial advisers.

In our cross-functional product teams, Software Engineers work directly with Product Managers and UX Designers to build our customer journeys and services. We are a true Fintech with a strong engineering culture and focus on innovation and agile methodology. We have an excellent Developer Experience and use a modern AWS-based serverless web stack including NodeJS, React, Typescript and IaC.


About the Role:

As a Software Engineer at Wealth Wizards you are empowered to own the full lifecycle of the software you create: designing the system, writing code, building automated tests and running the system in production.

This is an excellent opportunity for a capable Software Engineer to shape the future of the Wealth Wizards platform and help us make financial advice available to everyone.

At Wealth Wizards, we empower our engineering teams to own all aspects of software delivery - designing, building, testing, deploying and running the live service. As a Software Engineer, you will participate actively in the full software delivery lifecycle. You will contribute to design discussions within the team, write code, pair with others, review PRs, solve problems, and ensure a high standard of quality. You will assist in monitoring the services in production.

We believe in investing in our team members' development. As a Software Engineer, you will have regular 1-1s, receive coaching, and support for your career advancement. We are dedicated to fostering the necessary skills and knowledge in our team, individually and collectively.
  • Assist in the successful delivery of software for your team.
  • Work closely with the Lead Software Engineer and the Product Manager.
  • Partner effectively with all team members to deliver against commitments.
  • Collaborate actively in Agile ceremonies and apply Agile delivery principles to your work.
  • Build, support, and maintain products that are continuously delivered into our production environments.
  • Design, implement and document clean, maintainable, and scalable code that adheres to SOLID principles.
  • Contribute to the evolution of existing codebases through pragmatic refactoring and thoughtful extension, ensuring high test coverage and long-term reliability.
  • Participate in technical discussions during task analysis, design meetings, and code reviews.
  • Design and implement non-trivial APIs, backend services, and front-end applications using modern technologies such as TypeScript, React, Node.js and IaC.
  • Contribute to the growth and refinement of our coding standards and engineering principles, applying this knowledge to your code and code reviews.
  • Apply insightful analysis and planning to tackle non-trivial situations.
  • Ensure you build software where all aspects of product delivery are covered, especially non-functional quality attributes such as security, reliability, scalability, maintainability, and accessibility.
  • Adhere to All Information Security policies and procedures.
  • Continually learn about new technology, frameworks and libraries, being open to building with a variety of frameworks and libraries.

  • You have experience with our frontend and backend software development in our tech stack of Node.js, Typescript, Javascript and React.
  • You have experience in developing back-end REST APIs and working with relational or NoSQL databases.
  • Some knowledge of data structures and data-driven design.
  • Experience of modern web frameworks and libraries, such as React Router and Express.
  • Skilled in boosting software delivery productivity and code quality through prompt engineering with agentic coding assistants. Proficient in reviewing AI-generated output for alignment with engineering idioms and team best practices.
  • Exposure to event driven architecture and messaging systems.
  • Source code repositories such as GitLab or GitHub.
  • You have experience with unit and integration testing.
  • Able to identify and mitigate against OWASP top 10 security vulnerabilities.
  • Knowledge and implementation of predefined secure coding practises and secure architecture patterns.
  • Experience in refactoring systems towards a cleaner architecture, using techniques including abstraction and facades.
  • Able to review non trivial merge requests and give feedback to junior and mid level engineers which improves their code quality.
  • Take ownership of a task, analyse it, and solve problems you haven't encountered before.
  • Experience working as a software engineer in a team environment and are open to pair programming.
  • Understand the principles and values of agile practices, you are able to refine user stories into tasks and see the tasks through to delivery.
  • Understanding of how to use telemetry and metrics to triage operational tasks.
  • A desire to work collaboratively in your team, learn from others, and share your knowledge.
  • You exhibit technical curiosity, resilience in problem-solving, and seek feedback early and often.

title: Head of Data Collection (m/f/d)
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your Mission

You will lead Data Collection — the newest production line within Statista’s Data Production division, alongside Modeled Data, Survey Data, and Researched Data. It is our most scalable and most technical production line: it collects third-party data from publicly available sources and exclusive partnerships, and ingests, structures, and harmonizes it at scale for one of the world’s largest business data platforms.

Your mission: Collect customer-valuable third-party data we can sell at scale — free data that complements and contextualizes our portfolio, and exclusive partner data as a value driver.

Your Role

As Head of Data Collection, you will build and lead a production line structured along the data collection workflow — identify & unlock sources, explore sources, extract & ingest data — with three specialized sub-teams:

  • Source Identification & Unlocking — secures the sources that feed the collection line: unlocking access through partnerships and contractual agreements, and running a structured discovery process to identify and qualify the best source for a given data need. Owns the commercial and contractual side of getting to “unlocked” data.

  • Source Exploration — brings the domain expertise to understand an unlocked source: what data it offers, its structure and quality, and which fields are worth retrieving. Translates this into production-ready extraction specifications — the bridge between a raw source and scaled extraction.

  • Source Extraction & Ingestion — builds and operates the scalable, standardized setup that extracts data via partner dumps, scraping, or APIs, and ingests it into our systems — structuring and harmonizing it in the process, steered by KPIs and focused on efficiency and technical excellence. This team wil disciplinarily report into the Head of Data Engineering, but you steer them operationally.

Strategy & Clarity

  • Drive clarity in your production line with respect to strategy, portfolio role, and operating model — your teams and stakeholders always know where you’re heading and why

  • Own the roadmap for Data Collection as the key volume driver of our data portfolio — delivering breadth of coverage at scale and closing gaps we cannot fill otherwise

  • Shape the future direction towards exclusive partner data via revenue-share models — with the potential to shift the production line’s focus towards high-value exclusive data

  • Join the senior leadership circle of the Data Production division — contributing to vision, OKR-setting, and cross-functional alignment

Leadership & People

  • Lead the three sub-teams of the production line — driving performance, professional development, and a culture of ownership across partnership, research, and engineering profiles

  • Provide clarity, prioritization, and motivation — you lead through direction, not micromanagement

  • Build a production line that delivers reliably against operational KPIs: volume, breadth of coverage, and cost efficiency

Partnerships & Commercial

  • Own the partner dimension of the production line — from outreach and qualification to contractual agreements that unlock data access

  • Develop the exclusive partner data model — revenue-share partnerships that turn third-party data into a differentiating value driver for Statista

Production & Operational Excellence

  • Steer production via KPIs with full transparency over sources, pipelines, and output — optimized for volume and breadth of coverage

  • Drive automation and AI adoption across the collection workflow — from source discovery and intelligent extraction to automated structuring and harmonization

  • Relentlessly improve efficiency: standardized setups, scalable processes, and technical excellence over one-off solutions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Align with Production Steering and Business Owners, who steer your portfolio priorities — currently focused on strategic themes such as Social Media, eCommerce, and Marketing-persona fit

  • Partner closely with Data Engineering, whose infrastructure, tooling, and architecture power your extraction and ingestion at scale

  • Collaborate with the other production lines and downstream product teams — your data feeds their use cases and reaches customers through our platform and products

Your Profile

Experience & Track Record

  • 5+ years of experience in data operations, data partnerships, data engineering, or a data-centric business — with a proven track record of leading teams

  • Experience with collecting, structuring, or commercializing third-party data at scale — e.g. scraping/API-based data operations, data partnerships, or licensing models

  • Experience with thinking about and producing data as a product — you understand who uses the data, how, and what makes it valuable

  • A track record of steering operations via KPIs — you know how to run a production setup for volume, coverage, and efficiency

Mindset & Working Style

  • Operator mindset — you think in scale, throughput, and unit economics, and you get energy from making a production machine run better every week

  • Commercial acumen — you are comfortable negotiating with partners and structuring agreements that unlock data access

  • You have a talent for clean, simple concepts with practical impact — you simplify without oversimplifying, and your solutions actually work in production

  • You communicate well — with your teams, your supervisors, and your stakeholders across Data, Product, Tech, and Revenue

Technical Understanding

  • Solid technical grounding — you can discuss scraping, APIs, ingestion pipelines, and data structuring credibly with engineers, and challenge setups where needed (hands-on Python/SQL is a plus, not a must)

  • Practical understanding of AI capabilities in data collection — intelligent extraction, LLM-based structuring and harmonization, and automated quality assurance

Communication

  • Excellent English communication skills — able to lead cross-functional teams, coordinate stakeholders, and represent the production line across organizational boundaries

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

description:

Counselors are responsible for delivering individual, group, and family counseling services to clients with substance use and co-occurring mental health disorders. Core responsibilities include completing required clinical documentation such as psychosocial assessments, Individual Treatment/Service Plans (ITP/ISP), progress notes, and monthly reviews. Counselors actively participate in interdisciplinary treatment team meetings, monitor client progress throughout care, and contribute to discharge planning to ensure continuity of services. They provide crisis assessment, intervention, and de-escalation to promote client and staff safety, while guiding peers to ensure consistent and appropriate responses to critical situations. Counselors develop and implement approved curricula to support group and individual counseling sessions, utilizing evidence-based practices tailored to client needs.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Provide individual, group, and family counseling to address substance use, co-occurring disorders, and mental health concerns.
  • Conduct thorough client screenings and assessments; develop, implement, and regularly update individualized treatment plans based on each client’s strengths, needs, abilities, and preferences.
  • Utilize evidence-based counseling and psychotherapy approaches to evaluate and treat emotional, behavioral, cognitive, and affective conditions.
  • Deliver services via secure distance-based platforms when appropriate, ensuring informed consent, confidentiality, and compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and professional standards.
  • Assess client needs and determine appropriate modalities of care, including crisis intervention, referrals, and coordination with ancillary services (e.g., family support groups, continuing care, medical services).
  • Conduct intake interviews and determine program eligibility and appropriateness for services or referral to external providers.
  • Provide crisis intervention, following WestCare policies and procedures, and take immediate action as needed to ensure client safety.
  • Report unusual incidents, safety concerns, or compliance issues to the Residential Clinical Coordinator, Program Director, Regional Vice President, or regulatory agency as appropriate.
  • Monitor, evaluate, and document client behavior, progress, and participation throughout treatment.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and complete clinical documentation, including progress notes, assessments, and reports in accordance with agency and regulatory standards.
  • Follow all WestCare policies, procedures, and professional standards of practice.
  • Participate in interdisciplinary treatment team meetings, counselor meetings, and discharge planning discussions to support continuity of care.
  • Educate clients and families about recovery resources, relapse prevention, and coping strategies.
  • Support aftercare planning by assisting clients in identifying community resources and ongoing recovery supports.

  • Promote and embody the mission, vision, guiding principles, clinical vision, and goals of WestCare Foundation.
