title: Scientist
description:
Job description

Are you an experienced Scientist with expertise in formulation development, delivery systems, and colloidal chemistry? Randstad Life Sciences is seeking a dedicated R&D Scientist for an exciting consultancy assignment with a global life sciences client based in the Uppsala area.

In this role, you will contribute to the development of novel formulations and support the continuous improvement of existing technical platforms.

The assignment will start in September and last approximately a year.

Interviews are held on an ongoing basis. Please submit your application as soon as possible.

Responsibilities

  • Design and perform formulation trials—including hands-on laboratory work to support delivery system optimization and platform enhancements.
  • Analyze complex data sets, draw scientific conclusions, and draft technical reports and presentations.
  • Present and discuss research findings with cross-functional and global team members.
  • Work closely with senior researchers on study design, troubleshooting, and project execution.
  • Guide and mentor junior laboratory staff in both practical lab techniques and scientific documentation.

Qualifications

  • PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Colloid Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Proven R&D experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology sector, or equivalent research background from academia (Postdoc/Research Assistant).
  • Hands-on experience with the formulation and characterization of nanoparticle systems, combined with a broad understanding of pharmaceutical formulation techniques.
  • Strong track record in experimental planning and report writing. Excellent written and spoken English.

We place great value on personal fit, seeking a highly collaborative, adaptable, and proactive team player who thrives in international environments and enjoys mentoring others.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience working with complex biologics (e.g., hydrophobic proteins and peptides).
  • Familiarity with solid-state characterization or dry formulation methods.
  • Applied knowledge of Design of Experiments (DoE) and light scattering analytical methods.
  • Basic understanding of Swedish.

About the company

Randstad

På Randstad vet vi att alla människor har en plats på arbetsmarknaden. Med verksamhet över hela landet och inom alla kompetensområden hjälper vi människor att hitta ett jobb som känns bra, och där de får möjlighet att växa, utvecklas och uppnå sin fulla potential.

Med närmare 600 000 anställda i 38 länder är Randstad världsledande inom HR-tjänster, med målsättningen att bli världens främsta och mest uppskattade partner på arbetsmarknaden. Genom att kombinera vår passion för människor med kraften i dagens teknologi hjälper vi människor och företag att uppnå deras fulla potential. Vi kallar det Human Forward.

title: Senior Product Manager- Stablecoin Wallet
description:
Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together
Our Meaningful Mission
At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech.Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave, driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognizes and supports global connections.

Who You'll Be Joining
We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners, always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners, treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.Our Core

Commitments — What We Live By
Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:
  • Integrity:We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
  • Outcomes:We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
  • Velocity:We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

Perks of Joining Our Team
We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performance. Our remote-first culture means you have the flexibility to work in your employing country wherever you feel the most focused and productive. This freedom comes with wonderful tailored, location-specific perks designed to support your whole life, not just your work. Think unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! In turn, we expect you to bring high ownership and commitment to your work. This is a place where we value trust and high performance, and we'll provide the environment and support needed for you to excel

About the role
Your ultimate mission is to own the end-to-end stablecoin wallet experience, from the moment a customer funds their wallet to the moment they cash out, and to keep pushing what the wallet can do next. You will own the product vision, feature roadmap, and operational strategy for pay-in and pay-out flows across our stablecoin rails, working across Sendwave and WorldRemit. You will report to the Head of Product, Stablecoin Wallet.

You will achieve this by:
  • Owning the end-to-end stablecoin wallet.Define and execute the roadmap for the full wallet lifecycle: funding (pay-in), holding, and disbursement (pay-out), including onramp/offramp infrastructure and custody considerations.
  • Building new features in the stablecoin landscape.Identify and ship new capabilities as the space evolves, from new onramp/offramp rails and yield or savings mechanics to multi-currency stablecoin support and new partner integrations. You're not just maintaining the wallet, you're expanding what it can do.
  • Driving pay-in and pay-out reliability. Own the CX and operational north star for how funds enter and exit the wallet. Reduce friction, failed transactions, and settlement delays across markets.
  • Running the operational engine.Partner with Compliance, Risk, and Ops to keep the wallet running cleanly day to day: monitoring, incident response, vendor SLAs, and the unglamorous stuff that keeps money moving without drama.
  • Navigating the regulatory landscape.Work with Legal and Compliance to launch and scale stablecoin capabilities within licensing, AML/BSA, and EDD requirements across our operating markets.
  • Driving growth in focus markets.Collaborate with Growth, Marketing, and Engineering to scale funded wallets in Nigeria, Cameroon, and beyond, balancing speed with compliance and reliability.
  • Presenting to leadership. Own regular updates to senior leadership on the state of the stablecoin wallet: performance against targets, key risks, and the case for what's next. You can turn a messy quarter into a clear, defensible narrative.
  • Owning the growth-versus-risk trade-off. Balance the path to our funded wallet target with the regulatory and reputational exposure a stablecoin product carries. You know when to push and when to slow down.
  • Prioritizing ruthlessly.Make hard calls across a fast-moving feature backlog, and ensure this roadmap fits within the broader Wallets & New Products portfolio rather than running as its own island.
  • Partnering with Engineering on system-level trade-offs. Work with Engineering on build-vs-buy decisions, custody and security posture, and vendor risk, and operate within our quality bar rather than around it.

What you'll bring to the table
  • Crypto and stablecoin fluency (required). Direct experience working in crypto or with stablecoin rails. You understand custody models and the operational realities of moving stablecoins at scale, not just the theory.
  • Fiat and stablecoin on-ramp/off-ramp familiarity (required).You know how money actually moves between fiat and stablecoin rails: banking partners, liquidity providers, conversion mechanics, and where these flows tend to break.
  • A pulse on the stablecoin landscape. You actively track where the space is moving (new issuers, chains, regulatory shifts, competitor launches) and translate that into concrete feature bets rather than just staying informed for its own sake.
  • Deep customer empathy.A track record of putting users first, thinking in terms of end-to-end journeys rather than isolated features.
  • Data-informed decision making.Comfortable with SQL and analytics tools to size opportunities, monitor funnel health, and validate hypotheses.
  • Operational rigor. You don't just design the flow, you own what happens when it breaks. Comfortable with incident response, vendor management, and metrics that matter when real money is moving.
  • Masterful collaborator and communicator.Able to flex between a detailed engineering conversation and an executive brief.
  • Proven delivery and resilience.A history of shipping in a fast-paced environment, comfortable with incomplete information and regulatory ambiguity.

Bonus points if you have
  • Product management experience in fintech, payments, or remittance.
  • Familiarity with international payments regulation across emerging markets (Africa in particular).
  • Experience standing up new payment rails or vendor integrations from scratch.
  • A personal connection to or deep familiarity with the immigrant communities we serve.

AI Literacy & Tools
As Zepz continues to build AI into how we work, we expect everyone to engage with it as a core part of their role. For this position we are looking for:
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and how it can be applied in your area of work — from accelerating analysis and insight generation, to improving how we design and deliver processes and communications.
  • Practical experience using AI tools in a professional context — whether to connect information, draft content, build frameworks, or create insights from data. We want people who actively use AI to increase productivity, not those who are waiting to be told to.
  • Strong AI literacy — an understanding of what AI assistants can and cannot do, how to prompt effectively, and how to critically evaluate AI-generated output before using it.
  • Awareness of the ethical considerations and responsible use of AI in the workplace, particularly in the context of sensitive data, customer experience, and compliance.
  • Prior experience using Claude (Anthropic) is a nice-to-have but not essential — what matters most is that you are genuinely engaged with AI as a tool, comfortable experimenting, and eager to share what works with your wider team

If you want to join us in our journey to help break barriers in financial access and improve lives globally, there's no better place or time to join.

Our global team of 800+ people is spread across six continents. We aspire to hire the best mix of people from former Olympians to YouTube influencers and we speak over twenty languages. This incredible diversity isn't a bonus; it's the engine that lets us serve the world.

Ready to Apply? Let’s Go.

You will be responsible for deploying our device management, service activation, and monitoring solutions into communication service providers’ environments, working directly with customers and Engineering teams. Our customers include major telecom operators such as AT&T, Orange, T-Mobile, and Vodafone, and you will work on large-scale deployments involving networks, distributed systems, integrations, and real-world production challenges.

This is not a traditional project management role. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, taking ownership of delivery, and working across customer communication, troubleshooting, solution design, and implementation activities.

In this role, you will

  • Own the technical delivery of AVSystem solutions in customer environments

  • Lead deployments, integrations, configuration, testing, and production rollouts

  • Work directly with customers, Engineering teams, and internal stakeholders as a technical point of contact

  • Troubleshoot complex issues across network, system, and application layers

  • Participate in technical discussions around architecture, integrations, and solution design

  • Translate customer needs into practical technical solutions

  • Support customer onboarding and knowledge transfer

Requirements

We are looking for a technically strong professional with practical experience delivering complex systems.

You:

  • Have 5+ years of hands-on experience in network engineering, system engineering, telecommunications, cloud infrastructure, or similar technical roles

  • Have experience deploying, integrating, or troubleshooting complex systems

  • Understand networking fundamentals at least at CCNA level (TCP/IP protocols, routing and switching concepts, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, security considerations and best practices)

  • Have experience with Linux systems and APIs

  • Are comfortable analyzing logs, configurations, and technical issues

  • Can communicate technical topics clearly with both engineers and customers

  • Enjoy taking ownership of complex deliveries and solving real-world problems

  • Speak fluent English B2/C1

Nice to have

  • Experience delivering solutions for telecom operators (CSPs/ISPs)

  • Knowledge of OSS/BSS, device management, SNMP, MQTT, TR-069/TR-369, or CWMP

  • Experience with PKI, virtualization, cloud environments, monitoring, or automation

  • Understanding of xDSL, xPON, HFC, LTE, OLT/ONT ecosystems

  • Experience with multi-server architectures and load-balanced environments

  • Previous experience coordinating technical projects or delivery activities

What we offer

  • You’ll work on deployments that actually matter – systems managing millions of connected devices across the globe. Real networks, real scale, real engineering

  • You won’t be limited to schedules, status updates, and coordination. You’ll understand problems deeply, influence technical decisions, and see your work running in production environments

  • Expect complex integrations, multi-vendor environments, and challenging customer scenarios – not repetitive tasks or “status update theater”

  • You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers and delivery specialists who value ownership, technical excellence, and practical problem solving

  • Whether you want to deepen your technical expertise, grow towards technical leadership, or develop further in customer-facing engineering, we’ll support your growth

Work model

  • Fully remote or hybrid work (3 days from Kraków office, 2 days remotely) after onboarding (1-2 weeks onsite)

  • Flexible working hours

Perks and benefits

  • A bonus system based on quarterly performance evaluation

  • Private medical care and Multisport card

  • Onsite gym and chillout space

  • Company parking and bike room

  • Complimentary snacks and Good Lood ice cream available daily

  • Relaxed work atmosphere – no dress code, no open space

title: Senior Software Engineer - Enterprise Platforms
description:
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be designing and developing platforms that powers enterprise products at LinkedIn. We are looking for engineers with deep expertise in designing and managing high-throughput, data-intensive systems.

You will be part of the Enterprise Platform (EP) team, which serves as the core platform for every paid product at LinkedIn. This platform sits horizontally across other LinkedIn products offering user and license management capabilities together with identity and access management. From a technical scale perspective, the team owns and handles:

  • Over 200 APIs that support enterprise products and workflows across 50+ code repositories and one Ring 1 service.
  • More than 150 data tables storing 90+ TB of critical enterprise data across Espresso, MySQL, Pinot, Couchbase.
  • Systems that handle 500K+ peak requests per second.
  • Hosted search infrastructure powering enterprise search experiences.
  • More than 160 nearline and offline processing jobs that support not only Enterprise Platform teams but also multiple product organisations across LinkedIn.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

Responsibilities

  • Scale distributed applications, make architectural trade-offs applying synchronous and asynchronous design patterns, write code, and deliver with speediness and quality.
  • Develop multi-tier scalable, high-volume performing, and reliable user-centric applications that operate 24x7.
  • Produce high quality software that is unit tested, code reviewed, and checked in regularly for continuous integration.
  • Identify, leverage, and successfully evangelize opportunities to improve engineering productivity.

Basic Qualifications

  • BA/BS Degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline, or related practical experience.
  • 7+ years experience in software design, development, and algorithm related solutions.
  • 7+ years experience programming experience in Java and/or or any Object oriented language

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of relevant work experience.
  • Expert knowledge of computer science, with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design.
  • Experience with object-oriented design, coding, testing patterns, and programming languages (Java, C++).
  • Proven coding skills in a high level language with interest and ability to learn other coding languages as needed.
  • Experience building web applications and services with IDEs and general development practices.
  • Proven experience in building and maintaining large-scale distributed systems involving high-volume data processing.
  • Expertise building platforms like centralized authorization that is leveraged by multiple teams in building secured product experiences.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, with a focus on data modeling, performance tuning, and operational reliability.
  • Experience with real-time data streaming frameworks (e.g., Kafka, Apache Flink, Apache Beam etc.) and event-driven architectures.
  • Deep understanding of system bottlenecks, data consistency trade-offs, and techniques for ensuring data integrity at scale.

Suggested Skills

title: Head of Commercial - Diagnostic Centres
description:
Job Description:

Head of Commercial - Diagnostic Centres

Location – London (across multiple Outpatient and Diagnostic Centre sites)

Permanent | Full time (37.5 hours)

Competitive salary & excellent benefits package

Closing date for applications –Thursday 17th August 2026

We make health happen

As Head of Commercial for Bupa's London Diagnostic Centres, you will lead the commercial strategy across one of the UK's most prestigious private diagnostics portfolios, encompassing London Medical Centre , Bupa Healthcare Canary Wharf and Basinghall Clinic. This newly created senior leadership role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future direction of our diagnostic services, driving sustainable growth, strengthening our market position and creating new opportunities for patients, consultants and colleagues.

You'll be responsible for developing and executing a commercially ambitious growth agenda, building influential relationships across the healthcare landscape and identifying innovative ways to expand our services. Reporting to the Managing Director and working closely with General Managers and senior leaders across Diagnostics & Secondary Care, you will play a pivotal role in delivering both the London strategy and wider Bupa Health Services objectives.

This is a highly visible leadership position where you'll combine strategic thinking with commercial execution, leading consultant engagement, business development and service innovation initiatives that enhance patient experience, support clinical excellence and ensure long-term success across our diagnostic centres.

How you’ll help us make health happen

As Head of Commercial, you'll be responsible for developing and delivering the commercial strategy across our London Diagnostic Centres, creating sustainable growth opportunities while ensuring an exceptional experience for patients, consultants, GPs and referral partners.

You will:

  • Lead the development and execution of commercial and business development strategies across multiple diagnostic centres.
  • Oversee consultant partnership arrangements
  • Identify and secure new business opportunities, partnerships and revenue streams that support long-term growth.
  • Build, develop and maintain strong relationships with consultants, GPs, referrers, insurers, brokers and other key stakeholders.
  • Create and deliver consultant recruitment and engagement strategies to support business growth and clinical service expansion.
  • Develop pathways and service offerings that improve patient access, enhance outcomes and drive commercial performance.
  • Lead transformation and innovation projects, including digital and AI-enabled initiatives that improve patient and client experience.
  • Analyse market trends, competitor activity and commercial performance to inform strategic decision making.
  • Partner with operational and clinical leaders to ensure commercial objectives align with service delivery and patient care standards.
  • Drive marketing and stakeholder engagement activities in collaboration with internal marketing teams.
  • Establish and oversee engagement programmes, networking events and educational initiatives for consultants and referrers.
  • Lead, motivate and develop a high-performing commercial team, creating a culture of accountability, engagement and continuous improvement.
  • Deliver regular performance reporting and provide strategic commercial insight to senior leadership teams.
  • Ensure all commercial activities operate within relevant regulatory frameworks and Bupa governance requirements.

Key Skills / Qualifications

We're looking for an accomplished commercial leader who combines strategic thinking with strong relationship management skills and a proven ability to deliver growth within a complex healthcare environment.

You'll have:

  • A proven track record of driving commercial growth and business development within the independent healthcare sector.
  • Significant leadership experience managing high-performing commercial, business development or stakeholder engagement teams.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining relationships with consultants, clinicians, referrers and key healthcare stakeholders.
  • Experience working with private medical insurers and a range of healthcare payor groups.
  • A strong understanding of operating within highly regulated healthcare environments.
  • Excellent commercial acumen with the ability to develop and execute growth strategies.
  • Exceptional influencing, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret performance and market data to support decision making.
  • Experience leading change, transformation and service development initiatives.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the confidence to engage senior stakeholders.
  • A collaborative leadership style and commitment to delivering outstanding patient outcomes.
  • An interest in innovation, digital transformation and the application of AI within healthcare services

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to make health happen for our people. Viva is our global wellbeing programme and includes all aspects of our health – from mental and physical, to financial, social, and environmental wellbeing. We support flexible working and have a range of family-friendly benefits.

Joining Bupa in this role you will receive the following benefits and more:

  • Equivalent to 25 days holiday per year, increasing through length of service, with option to buy or sell.
  • Bupa health insurance as a benefit in kind.
  • An enhanced pension plan and life insurance.
  • Annual performance-based bonus
  • Onsite gyms or local discounts where no onsite gym available.
  • Various other benefits and online discounts.

Why Bupa?

We’re a health insurer and provider. With no shareholders, our customers are our focus. Our people are all driven by the same purpose – helping people live longer, healthier, happier lives and making a better world. We make health happen by being brave, caring and responsible in everything we do.

We encourage all of our people to “Be you at Bupa”, we champion diversity, and we understand the importance of our people representing the communities and customers we serve. That’s why we especially encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences.

Bupa is a Level 2 Disability Confident Employer. This means we aim to offer an interview/assessment to every disabled applicant who meets the minimum criteria for the role. We’ll make sure you are treated fairly and offer reasonable adjustments as part of our recruitment process to anyone that needs them.

Please note: We reserve the right to close this vacancy early should we receive a sufficient number of applications. Therefore, if you are interested, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

Full time

title: Physics Expert (Postdoc / Junior professor)
description:
Role Title: Physics Expert (Postdoc / Junior professor)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (US, Canada, UK focused)

micro1 is engaging Physics Experts (Postdoc / Junior professor) to participate in a high-impact project supporting a customer in the science and technology sector. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Critically evaluate and review physics solutions, mathematical derivations, and theoretical arguments generated by researchers or AI platforms.
  2. Detect errors, unjustified steps, missing assumptions, dimensional inconsistencies, and weaknesses in logic or methodology.
  3. Delineate between substantive scientific issues and stylistic or cosmetic matters, providing technically precise written feedback.
  4. Articulate and document the reasoning behind any identified flaws, ensuring actionable guidance for improvement.
  5. Recognize when correct reasoning can be optimized, and offer suggestions to sharpen or clarify the argument.
  6. Utilize LaTeX, SymPy, Python, and Jupyter to independently verify or counter-check scientific claims as appropriate.
  7. Deliver structured feedback designed to support iterative enhancement of submitted work and project outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. PhD in physics and an active record of independent research within a specialized subfield (e.g., High Energy/Mathematical Physics, Biophysics/Statistical Physics, Condensed Matter, AMO/Quantum Optics, Gravitation/Cosmology, Quantum Information, or Optical Materials).
  2. Experience as a postdoctoral researcher, research fellow, junior/assistant professor, or senior research scientist.
  3. Recent (last ~5 years) representative publications in the relevant subfield, with arXiv or DOI links.
  4. Advanced proficiency with LaTeX, SymPy, Python, and Jupyter for theoretical modeling and computational validation.
  5. Demonstrated skill in reviewing the work of others—through peer review, supervision, dissertation committees, or group seminars.
  6. Exceptional written communication skills with the ability to convey nuanced, constructive feedback with technical rigor.
  7. Reliable access to high-speed internet and a computer suitable for rigorous technical work.

title: Är du redo för ett jobb där utveckling och resultat går hand i hand?
description:

Arbetet passar dig som tycker om att vara social, ta initiativ och utvecklas i en miljö där ingen dag ser likadan ut. Du får möjlighet att bygga värdefull erfarenhet samtidigt som du utvecklar din kommunikation, ditt självförtroende och din förmåga att skapa goda kundrelationer.

Du utgår från vårt kontor i Vingåker och arbetar tillsammans med ett engagerat team som stöttar varandra, delar med sig av erfarenheter och firar framgångar tillsammans.

Vem är du?

Skicka in din ansökan redan idag och bli en del av Exaltera Marketing med utgångspunkt i Vingåker. Vi rekryterar löpande och ser fram emot att få lära känna dig.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Om stillingen

Er du nysgjerrig, kreativ og liker å følge med på den nyeste teknologien og takten i KI-utviklingen? Vi søker nå en AI Engineer som vil være med å utvikle agentiske systemer som skaper reell forretningsverdi.

Hos Sopra Steria blir du en del av et inspirerende og inkluderende miljø – et av Norges råeste tech-miljøer – hvor vi kombinerer utfordrende prosjekter med en kultur preget av nysgjerrighet, læring og samarbeid. Her bygger vi KI-løsninger som går fra chatbot til autonom agent – fra pilot til produksjon. Hos oss vil du bidra i varierte oppdrag på tvers av bransjer og sektorer, og være med på å utvikle sammen med noen av Norges fremste fageksperter.

Vi ser etter deg som vet hvordan man får språkmodeller til å slutte å bruke tankestrek.

Ansvarsområder

  • LLM og Agentutvikling: Du vil designe og implementere intelligente agenter ved hjelp av moderne rammeverk som LangGraph og Anthropic Agents SDK. Du bygger systemer som kan planlegge, resonnere og utføre handlinger autonomt.
  • RAG-arkitektur: Du utvikler avanserte RAG-løsninger (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) som kombinerer store språkmodeller med bedriftsdata for å skape presise og pålitelige svar.
  • MCP og A2A-protokoller: Du jobber med Model Context Protocol for standardisert verktøytilgang og Agent-to-Agent kommunikasjon for orkestrering mellom flere agenter.
  • Governance og sikkerhet: Du implementerer guardrails, Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) godkjenningsflyter, og komplett sporbarhet gjennom tracing for alle agentoperasjoner.
  • Prompt Engineering og Evaluering: Du optimaliserer prompts, setter opp evalueringsrammeverk og måler agentytelse systematisk.

I prosjektene våre vil du kombinere denne tekniske kompetansen med evnen til å forstå kundens behov, samarbeide godt med ulike fagmiljøer og levere løsninger som er robuste, optimaliserte og som skaper tydelig verdi for kundene våre.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Høyere utdanning innen IT, datateknologi, maskinlæring eller beslektede fagområder.
  • Teknisk erfaring med språkmodeller og erfaring med API-kommunikasjon.
  • Sterk programmeringskompetanse i Python, med erfaring fra agentrammeverk (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, eller lignende).
  • Kjennskap til RAG-arkitektur, vektordatabaser og embedding-teknologier.
  • Erfaring med skyplattformer som Azure (Azure OpenAI), AWS, eller Google Cloud.
  • Fordel med erfaring fra MCP, A2A-protokoller, eller multi-agent systemer.
  • Vi setter pris på erfaring innen AgentOps, LLMOps, MLOps og selv-hostede modeller.
  • Norsk, minimum B2 nivå.

Personlige egenskaper

  • Du er faglig sterk og har en genuin interesse for KI
  • Du er nysgjerrig, lærevillig og deler gjerne kunnskap
  • Du trives i møte med ulike mennesker og samarbeider tett med både kunder og kollegaer
  • Du kommuniserer klart og skaper tillit i dialog med andre
  • Du jobber selvstendig, men liker også å løse problemer i team
  • Du tar initiativ, er løsningsorientert og bidrar til et positivt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

Hvorfor Sopra Steria?

Hos oss får du jobbe med meningsfulle og varierte prosjekter for noen av Norges største virksomheter. Vi satser på kontinuerlig faglig og personlig utvikling gjennom sertifiseringsprogrammer ,opplæring og støtte fra faglige miljøer. Du vil jobbe i et dynamisk miljø med engasjerte kollegaer, konkurransedyktige betingelser og fleksible arbeidsforhold. Vår kultur bygger på innovasjon og samarbeid. Du trenger ikke oppfylle alle kravene for å være den perfekte kandidaten. Hvis du kjenner deg igjen i mye av det vi beskriver og ønsker å utvikle deg sammen med oss, ser vi frem til å høre fra deg!

Kontaktinfo

Søknadsfrist: 13.09.26

Spørsmål om rollen:

• Stig-Ole Gundersen (Leder, Data Intelligence): stig-ole.gundersen@soprasteria.com


Spørsmål om prosess:

Sopra Steria har kunder og prosjekter som kan kreve sikkerhetsklarering på ulike nivåer. Vi selekterer og inviterer kandidater til intervju fortløpende.

Vi er Norges ledende konsulentselskap innen digitalisering, innovasjon og bærekraft. I Sopra Steria bistår vi våre kunder innen privat og offentlig sektor med å bli fremtidens virksomheter. I en årrekke har vi vært rangert som en av Norges beste arbeidsplasser. Du finner oss i Oslo, Stavanger, Trondheim, Bergen, Drammen, Hamar, Fredrikstad, Kristiansand og Tromsø.

We are Norway's leading consulting company in digitisation, innovation and sustainability and for a number of years have been ranked as one of Norway’s best workplaces. As one of Europe's largest consulting companies, we assist large private companies and public companies in taking digital leadership.

We are committed to creating value for our customers and society and aim to create a better and more sustainable future. In Norway we have offices in Oslo, Stavanger, Trondheim, Drammen, Bergen, Kristiansand, Fredrikstad, Hamar og Tromsø.

We are more than 3300 employees in Norway and had a turnover of more than NOK 5,9 billion in 2024.

title: Associate, Data Quality
description:
Group Overview

The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.

Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.

Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.

The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy & Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all-to-all trading platform.

Founded in London in 1866, the Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,200 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.

About Parameta

Parameta Solutions is home to our data and analytics business.

It is a world-leading provider of OTC market data, offering unbiased data products that facilitate trading, enhance transparency, reduce risk and improve operational efficiency. We help clients to make more efficient investment, portfolio analysis, valuation, risk management and compliance decisions.

Rigorous quality assurance processes ensure the integrity and robustness of our products, which include pricing, reference data and analytical tools for major asset classes and markets.

Our offering includes real-time price information from the major OTC financial and commodity markets delivering high-quality independent data in a number of asset classes including Rates, FX and Money Markets, Volatility, Oil, Energy, Inflation, Credit and Equities.

Parameta Solutions strategy focuses on three pillars. First, it is enhancing its distribution, with 78% of the division’s 2024 revenue originating from third-party channels, and an increasing proportion (22%) being generated from direct channels, such as the cloud. Second, Parameta is offering more innovative products, including evidential data solutions and benchmarks and indices. Finally, the business is expanding its buy-side client base.

Role Overview

Associate, Data Quality

The Associate plays a critical role in maintaining the integrity and reliability of market data across multiple brands and platforms. This position involves real-time monitoring, testing, and escalation of data anomalies, contributing to the overall quality assurance framework of the organization. Candidates should demonstrate the ability or possess experience that qualifies them to perform these duties with little supervision.

  • Focus: Owns complex tasks and optimizes workflows

  • Indicators: Reduced escalations, improved price exception TATs

  • Autonomy: Functional Ownership, owns processes, suggests improvements

  • Decision-making: Makes decisions impacting price quality outcomes

  • Support: Operates independently, informs leadership

Role Responsibilities

  • Independently monitor real-time price validation systems to detect and fix data errors and delays.

  • Use market knowledge to triage anomalies and anticipate the impact of market-moving events to improve data quality parameters

  • Escalate data issues to internal teams (e.g., engineering, analytics, product) and external data providers, ensuring clear documentation of the problem, its impact, and any interim workarounds.

  • Conduct in-depth data analysis and fault diagnostics to identify the root causes of anomalies, delays, or inaccuracies in market data. Apply statistical and technical methods to isolate issues and implement corrective actions that prevent recurrence and improve overall data quality.

  • Collaborate with Parameta Solutions and TP ICAP technical and analytics teams to maintain system functionality.

  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by Data Quality leadership.

  • Participate in system enhancement initiatives by providing detailed feedback on data validation tools and workflows; support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new features, ensuring they meet operational and data quality requirements.

  • Lead incident management and root cause analysis, including documentation and follow-up actions.

Experience / Competences

Associate

  • Ability or experience that qualifies the candidate to perform duties with little supervision

Desired

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • 4+ years of experience in Data Quality operations or a related field

  • Prior experience in a data quality, market data, or operations role.

  • Knowledge of Bloomberg, Refinitiv, and other market data platforms.

  • Exposure to machine learning or automation tools for data validation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Familiarity with financial markets and data flows.

  • Experience with real-time data monitoring tools and QA applications.

  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Not The Perfect Fit?

Concerned that you may not meet the criteria precisely? At TP ICAP, we wholeheartedly believe in fostering inclusivity and cultivating a work environment where everyone can flourish, regardless of your personal or professional background. If you are enthusiastic about this role but find that your experience doesn't align perfectly with every aspect of the job description, we strongly encourage you to apply. You may be the ideal candidate for this position or another opportunity within our organisation. Our dedicated Talent Acquisition team is here to assist you in recognising how your unique skills and abilities can be a valuable contribution. Don't hesitate to take the leap and explore the possibilities. Your potential is what truly matters to us.

Company Statement

We know that the best innovation happens when diverse people with different perspectives and skills work together in an inclusive atmosphere. That's why we're building a culture where everyone plays a part in making people feel welcome, ready and willing to contribute. TP ICAP Accord - our Employee Network - is a central to this. As well as representing specific groups, TP ICAP Accord helps increase awareness, collaboration, shares best practice, and holds our firm to account for driving continuous cultural improvement.

Location

Philippines - Ecoprime Building - Taguig City

title: Youth Arts and Music Instructor
description:
Under the supervision of the Branch Director, the person selected for this position will be responsible for planning and implementing effective and well-rounded age-appropriate group music and art classes for Preschoolers. The instructor ensures classroom efforts in all aspects of programming and implements including classroom curriculum, child records, communicates information to families, and maintains a safe, healthy, warm, engaging, and interactive environment.
Key Functions/Responsibilities
  • Create age-appropriate music lessons that engage the group of children.
  • Create a curriculum incorporating a variety of songs, finger plays, dancing, simple instruments, arts & crafts, and other instructional material/resources.
  • Take a playful and active approach to capture the attention of the children.
  • Must attend staff meetings and required trainings.
  • Notify supervisor of any problems that arise.
  • Perform other duties as designated by the supervisors.
  • Is knowledgeable in and adheres to the rules, regulations, and procedures set forth by the YMCA of Greater Boston.
  • Is active in branch-related activities and communicates regularly with other department staff.

Abuse Risk Management
• Adhere to policies related to boundaries with consumers.
• Complete all required abuse prevention training.
• Adhere to procedures related to managing high-risk activities and supervising consumers.
• Report suspicious or inappropriate behaviors and policy violations.
• Follow mandated abuse reporting requirements.
• Ensure unused rooms and closets remain locked; routinely monitor high-risk locations.
• Respond seriously and confidentially to reports of suspicious and inappropriate behaviors and respond to violations using the organization's procedures and policies.

Core Competencies
· A warm, engaging environment for children, staff and families which meet quality standards.
· A developmentally sound program for children which provides positive channels to grow, learn and develop to their fullest potential.
· Positive program assessments through observations and parent feedback.
· A program which meets community needs consistent with the YMCA mission.
· A classroom team that works coordinated with one another and with children and families as priorities.
Education and Experience:
· 2 Years+ Experience instructing children in Arts or movement related activities.
· First Aid and CPR certified within the first 6 months of employment.
· Excellent skills in working with families, conflict resolution, and community relations.
· Knowledge of group processes with the ability to make contributions to a positive team dynamic
· Commitment to the philosophy and goals of the YMCA.
· Effective leadership skills and crisis management skills.
· Excellent organizational and communication skills.

Physical Demands:
· While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to kneel, reach, bend, push, digital dexterity, balance, crouch, stand, pull, grasp, repetitive motions, stoop, crawl, walk, lift, talk, hear, sit, and sing.
· The employee may occasionally need to exercise these physical labor demands:
· Occasionally lifting up to 20 pounds.
· Specific vision abilities required by this job include:
· Close/far vision, ability to adjust focus, peripheral vision, color perception, depth perception, field of vision.
· Acute hearing is essential to this position.
